title: Senior Data Engineer, Cloudforce One
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>London, UK</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Cloudforce One is Cloudflare’s threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs). Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world’s largest global networks can provide. The team is able to analyze these unique data points, at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.</p> <p>You will join the data science team within Cloudforce One. We power much of the insight and intelligence delivered in Cloudflare’s <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/security-center/cloudforce-one/#analyze-threat-events">Threat Events</a> product, which customers can use to better protect themselves — for example, by <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/realtime-threat-intel-waf-rules/">turning our threat indicators into real-time WAF rules</a>. We own data pipelines that power analysis of Cloudflare’s DDoS and WAF data, including Cloudflare’s quarterly <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/ddos-threat-report-2026-q3/">DDoS Threat Report</a>. We also support internal Trust & Safety initiatives such as identifying and addressing network abuse, and collaborate directly with the Threat Intelligence team.</p> <p>As a Data Engineer, you will build the data foundation that makes this possible: designing and operating the scalable pipelines, analytical data stores, and data marts that turn raw Cloudflare telemetry into trusted, well-modeled datasets for threat researchers, data scientists, analysts, and customers.</p> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Design, build, and operate scalable batch data pipelines on Kubernetes-hosted Airflow and Spark clusters that extract, enrich, and publish threat and abuse signals from Cloudflare’s network and platform telemetry.</li> <li>Build and evolve our data stores in Apache Iceberg (R2) and the curated data marts that serve Threat Events, Trust & Safety initiatives, and Threat Intelligence investigations.</li> <li>Model datasets deliberately — choosing grain, partitioning, and schema evolution strategies that keep data correct, queryable, and cost-efficient.</li> <li>Write and optimize SQL against large-scale analytical data in ClickHouse, balancing completeness, performance, and cost.</li> <li>Make pipelines safe to retry, resume, and backfill, so downstream consumers receive exactly the data we intend to publish.</li> <li>Build data quality checks, reconciliation, and monitoring that catch problems before they reach analysts, detections, or customers.</li> <li>Treat privacy and data minimization as design requirements from the start.</li> <li>Enable Threat Intelligence and Trust & Safety partners with the data they need for tooling and investigations, translating ad hoc requests into reusable datasets.</li> <li>Partner with data scientists to turn exploratory analysis into repeatable, production-quality data products and ML-ready datasets.</li> <li>Raise the team’s engineering bar through code review, testing, CI/CD, and documentation.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience designing, building, and operating scalable production data pipelines.</li> <li>Proven experience building analytical data stores and data marts, including data modeling, partitioning, and schema evolution.</li> <li>Strong Python for data engineering, including testing and maintainable, well-structured code.</li> <li>Strong SQL, including window functions, query optimization, and performance tuning on large datasets.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow in production, including Kubernetes-hosted deployments.</li> <li>Experience with distributed data processing (e.g. Spark or similar) at large scale.</li> <li>Experience with Apache Iceberg (or a comparable open table format) on object storage such as R2 or S3.</li> <li>Experience with ClickHouse or a comparable columnar analytical database.</li> <li>Experience with CI/CD, version control, and containerized deployments.</li> <li>Clear communication and the ability to turn ambiguous requirements from researchers and analysts into well-defined data products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with security, threat intelligence, fraud, or trust & safety / abuse data.</li> <li>Solid understanding of how the Internet works (DNS, HTTP, TLS, BGP).</li> <li>Experience supporting data science or ML workflows (feature stores, training datasets).</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare’s developer platform (Workers, R2, R2 Data Catalog).</li> <li>Trino/Presto or other distributed query engines.</li> <li>Experience using AI-assisted development tools as part of your workflow.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. title: Rückbauingenieur (m/w/d)
description: Beschreibung Rund 800 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter arbeiten in der SIERA Alliance an der Vision für eine bessere Zukunft in den Bereichen Umweltschutz und Klima, Wasser und Ökosysteme, Kreislaufwirtschaft, städtische Nachhaltigkeit und Infrastruktur sowie Impact-Technologie . Dafür sorgt unsere offene Kultur mit kurzen Wegen und schnellen Entscheidungen. Dein Herz schlägt für Nachhaltigkeit? Unterstützung aller Projektbeteiligten und Gewährleistung eines reibungslosen, termingerechten und budgetkonformen Projektablaufs. Überwachung des Projektfortschritts, Sicherstellung der Einhaltung rechtlicher und technischer Standards sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit den zuständigen Behörden. Entwicklung umweltfreundlicher Lösungen unter Beachtung höchster Sicherheits- und Nachhaltigkeitsstandards sowie Integration moderner Technologien in die Projekte. Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sind vorhanden. Außerdem erwarten Dich flache Hierarchien in einer Unternehmensgruppe in Familienbesitz. Du bist ein Familienmensch? Bei uns hast Du flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten. Bei uns erwarten Dich attraktive Büroräume mit modernster Ausstattung in hervorragender Lage zu ÖPNV. Notebook und Smartphone gehören zur Grundausstattung. Wir bieten Dir eine umfassende Einarbeitung, Fortbildungen sowie ein Mentoringprogramm. Bei uns hast Du sehr gute, individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. title: Senior Solution Architect (m/w/d)
description: Als Senior Solution Architect (m/w/d) gestaltest und überwachst du maßgeblich die Implementierung technischer Lösungen, die sowohl unseren Geschäftsanforderungen als auch den Bedürfnissen unserer Kunden gerecht werden. Du schlägst die Brücke zwischen Business und Technik, entwickelst eine klare technische Vision und Architektur für Projekte und stellst sicher, dass diese mit unserer Unternehmensstrategie, IT-Standards und Best Practices übereinstimmen. Dabei integrierst du verschiedene Systeme und Anwendungen in ein stimmiges Gesamtbild und gestaltest die zukünftigen Portfolio-Elemente und Services aktiv mit. Was dich bei uns erwartet Du übernimmst die technische Gesamtverantwortung für komplexe Lösungen und begleitest deren Umsetzung über den gesamten Lifecycle hinweg. Du entwickelst und kommunizierst eine klare, zukunftsorientierte Architekturvision und stellst sicher, dass Lösungen mit unserer Unternehmensstrategie, den IT‑Standards und Best Practices im Einklang stehen. Du integrierst unterschiedliche Systeme, Plattformen und Anwendungen zu stabilen, wartbaren und skalierbaren Gesamtlösungen. Du gestaltest aktiv neue Portfolio‑Elemente, Services und Architekturleitlinien und hast dabei gleichermaßen Kundenbedürfnisse als auch Business‑Ziele im Blick. Du arbeitest eng und partnerschaftlich mit Business‑Stakeholdern, Entwicklungsteams, Operations, externen Partnern und Kunden – von der Ideenphase bis zum Rollout. Du führst Architektur‑Reviews durch, triffst fundierte Technologieentscheidungen und sorgst für Qualität in Bezug auf Skalierbarkeit, Sicherheit und Wartbarkeit. Du erkennst Risiken frühzeitig, sprichst sie offen an und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungs‑ und Entscheidungsgrundlagen. Du beobachtest Technologietrends, bringst neue Ideen ein und hilfst dabei, Best Practices im Team und im Unternehmen zu etablieren. Darauf freuen wir uns Mehrjährige, fundierte Berufserfahrung in Softwareentwicklung, Systemintegration oder IT‑Architektur, idealerweise in komplexen Projekt‑ oder Produktlandschaften. Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, des Ingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation – wichtiger als der Abschluss ist uns deine praktische Erfahrung und deine Haltung. Sehr gute Kenntnisse in IT‑Architekturen, insbesondere: Infrastrukturen Microservices und verteilten Systemen Cloud‑nativen Technologien Datenbanken und Integrationsmustern Erfahrung mit Patterns & Anti‑Patterns sowie mit Private‑ und Public‑Cloud‑Plattformen. Sicherheit im Umgang mit agilen Methoden (z. B. Scrum, Kanban), DevOps‑Prinzipien und sauberem Requirements Engineering. Ein gutes Verständnis für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und die Fähigkeit, technische Entscheidungen mit Business‑Mehrwert zu verbinden. Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, Struktur, Entscheidungsfreude und die Fähigkeit, auch komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich zu vermitteln. Sehr gute Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse. Freude daran, Wissen zu teilen, andere zu stärken und gemeinsam bessere Lösungen zu entwickeln. Unsere Benefits Flexibilität ist unser Motto - Office, remote, Homeoffice oder Workation in der EU? Entscheide selbst! Familienfreundlich - Wir bieten flexible Arbeitszeiten für die optimale Work-Life-Balance. Gut versorgt am Arbeitsplatz - Bei uns erhältst du selbstverständlich kostenlos Kaffee, Tee, Limonade, frisches Obst und die Möglichkeit, in unserer modernen Cafeteria zu kochen. Nachhaltige Mobilität - Mit dem JOB-Ticket sowie JobRad inkl. Fahrradgarage unterstützen wir umweltfreundliche Mobilität und bieten dir die Möglichkeit, dich aktiv fortzubewegen. Deine Entwicklung im Fokus - Dafür bieten wir dir maßgeschneiderte Entwicklungsmaßnahmen und regelmäßige Mitarbeitergespräche. Technik, die sich nach dir richtet - Wähle dein bevorzugtes Gerät (MacBook oder Windows‑Laptop) und erhalte zusätzlich ein Firmenhandy für moderne, mobile Zusammenarbeit. Teamspirit und Spaß - Freue dich auf Team- und Firmenevents, bei denen du deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen besser kennenlernen und gemeinsam Spaß haben kannst. Fit und aktiv bleiben - In unserem hauseigenen PUMPWERK kannst du dich fit halten, an Kursen teilnehmen oder deinen eigenen Kurs gestalten. Und das sogar in deiner Arbeitszeit, denn eine Stunde pro Woche darfst du für Sport nutzen! Deine Gesundheit zählt - Ergonomisches Arbeiten mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen, regelmäßige Gesundheitstage, unser hauseigener Fitnessraum, Karenztage und Besuche der Betriebsärztin sorgen für dein gesundheitliches Wohlbefinden. Interessiert? EWERK lebt von Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit ganz verschiedenen Geschichten und Perspektiven. Alle personenbezogenen Formulierungen in der Stellenanzeige sind daher geschlechtsneutral zu betrachten. Potenzial ist bei uns willkommen, unabhängig von Identität oder Hintergrund. Fragen zur Stelle? title: Visiting Associate - 6-12 months
description: About First Momentum Ventures We're engineers at heart and investors by choice. That's why, what started in 2019 as a campus spin-off, we've grown into one of Europe's leading pre-seed funds , backing 50+ deeply technical startups reshaping industries from new industrials to novel computing. With our €35M+ second fund in full swing and Fund III on the horizon , we're hiring a Visiting Associate to join our investment team and contribute to deal flow, technical evaluation, and portfolio projects. Our aim is to be the #1 destination for deeply technical founders in Europe . We believe great teams create the future, and we're here to back them early and support them deeply . We aren't just capital providers; we invest in incredible individuals and view EQ as our greatest competitive advantage over traditional funds. The same applies to our own team: we win as a team (not individuals), believe in high agency & independence, and have every team member participate directly in the fund's economic upside. The Role As a Visiting Associate , you'll be a full member of our investment team with real ownership from day one and direct exposure to how the venture capital world truly operates. This role is designed for people with 1–3 years of professional experience who want to break into the venture ecosystem and accelerate their career. It's the perfect launchpad for ambitious talent aiming to become a Chief of Staff at a leading European startup , land a full-time VC role , or start their own company down the road. Whether you're coming from consulting, a fast-growing startup , or hold a master's degree with several internships in the startup ecosystem, we're looking for Europe's most driven young professionals to join us in building the leading pre-seed tech-focused venture fund in Europe . Tasks Find the most promising tech founders in Europe: Take the lead in sourcing high-potential pre-seed startups, running first calls independently, and developing your own conviction about which founders and ideas are truly exciting. Gain full exposure to the investment process: Work side-by-side with our investment team through the entire deal flow, from first contact and due diligence to investment committee and closing. You'll play a key role in evaluating opportunities and shaping investment decisions. Lead deep-dive research: Explore emerging technologies and market trends every week. Conduct sharp, data-driven analysis and present insights that influence our investment theses and strategic direction. Drive impact in portfolio projects: Support our portfolio founders hands-on, from building their go-to-market motion to automating workflows with AI and optimizing operations. Requirements You have 1-3 years of work experience in the startup ecosystem, consulting, or a technical role. You bring strong analytical capabilities and can move from technical papers to business models to founder conversations with ease. You work with extreme ownership and high agency, spotting opportunities, designing a plan, and executing without waiting for permission. You're genuinely curious about deeply technical domains. Whether you have an engineering background or just love learning how breakthrough technologies work, you're energized by technical depth. You communicate clearly and convincingly in both German and English, whether you're pitching a deal to partners or giving feedback to founders. Benefits Real ownership, not busy work : You'll make independent calls on deals, lead founder conversations, support DD processes end-to-end, and help drive critical projects for our portfolio companies. Technical depth you won't find elsewhere : Most of our team are engineers and scientists, which lets you develop a genuine understanding of breakthrough technologies, not just assessment skills. Exceptional colleagues who challenge you : Work alongside a team that values rigorous debate, mutual support, and winning together. You'll become part of the First Momentum family, even beyond your time with us. Full venture stack visibility : See everything from AI-powered sourcing to automated portfolio support. Gain the whole picture of how a leading European Deep Tech fund operates. Full flexibility with a remote-first culture balanced by regular in-person gatherings across Europe. Competitive pay: The compensation package will be adjusted to your professional experience and will be well above an internship salary. The perfect launchpad for your next move : Whether you're heading toward a full-time VC role, a Chief of Staff position in our portfolio, or eventually starting your own venture, this position sets you up for what's next. We're looking for candidates available for 6-12 months, starting soon or in January 2027 if preferred. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Regional Sales Director, Startups – AI & Digital Natives (East)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: NYC, Boston, Atlanta, Miami OR Carolinas</strong></p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare's North America Startups segment is growing its U.S. East go-to-market team. The goal is to win the fastest-growing AI-native and digital native companies early and grow with them as they scale. A new generation of companies is building AI models, agents, AI apps and developer tools, and many of them can go from seed funding to global scale in under two years. Cloudflare wants to be the platform they build, run and secure on from their first line of code through their IPO.</p> <p>As the Senior Regional Sales Director, Startups – East, you will lead the managers and Account Executives (AEs) covering venture-backed AI and digital native companies across the eastern U.S., including New York, Boston, the DC area, Atlanta and Miami. You'll own revenue, hiring and Cloudflare's reputation in the East Coast startup and venture community, while keeping the Cloudflare culture. This role suits builders who like speed, technical buyers and the challenge of turning fast usage growth into lasting, multi-million-dollar customer relationships.</p> <p>You'll set strategy for the region and lead a team that sells to founders, CTOs and heads of engineering and infrastructure. Your team will:</p> <ul> <li>Move fast deals forward without losing sight of the long-term account</li> <li>Turn companies already on Cloudflare's free and pay-as-you-go plans into committed contracts</li> <li>Work with Product, Developer Speedboat, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success and the Cloudflare for Startups program to make Cloudflare the default choice for AI-native builders</li> </ul> <p>Success means startups that love Cloudflare and recommend it, have grown alongside us from early stage to scale, and run their most important workloads on our Developer Platform, AI products, application security and network.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Drive revenue growth</strong> across new customers, expansion and conversion of pay-as-you-go accounts to contracts. Build a sales motion where usage growth opens the door to the next use case.</li> <li><strong>Lead a team of Regional Sales Directors</strong> and their Startup Account Executives. Also lead indirectly, the Solutions Engineers, Business Development Reps, Customer Success and Field Marketing teams who support startup accounts.</li> <li><strong>Build the East Coast startup sales team.</strong> Work with your Ecosystem and Recruiting to hire people who are technical, sharp about the business and comfortable talking with founders and engineers.</li> <li><strong>Spot breakout companies early.</strong> Use funding rounds, usage data, hiring and developer adoption signals to find likely winners, then win them before they lock into AWS, GCP, Azure, Vercel or other platforms.</li> <li><strong>Make venture investors a growth channel.</strong> Build relationships with VC firms, accelerators and startup programs across the East Coast, working with the Cloudflare for Startups and Workers Launchpad teams to bring in companies at the earliest stages.</li> <li><strong>Help shape the product roadmap.</strong> Bring what AI-native customers need back to Product and Engineering, and run design-partner relationships with leading startups that influence what Cloudflare builds next.</li> <li><strong>Adapt our sales process for startups.</strong> Use and influence Cloudflare's sales methodology for faster deals with technical buyers. Bring discipline to forecasting usage-based revenue, contracts sized for growth and expansion planning.</li> <li><strong>Balance short-term and long-term revenue.</strong> Close fast deals while also building multi-year relationships with companies expected to become tomorrow's large enterprise customers. Work with Enterprise leaders on clean handoffs when accounts move to that segment.</li> <li><strong>Represent Cloudflare in the East Coast startup scene</strong> at founder events, AI meetups, investor portfolio sessions and developer communities.</li> </ul> <h2>What You'll Bring</h2> <ul> <li>12+ years of sales experience, including 3+ years managing managers (second-line leadership), with a track record of beating targets in a high-growth segment</li> <li>Experience selling cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, application security or data and AI infrastructure to startups, digital natives or high-growth tech companies</li> <li>Proven success in usage-based businesses, including converting product-led or pay-as-you-go customers to committed contracts and expanding from there</li> <li>Credibility with technical buyers: comfortable at the whiteboard with CTOs and founders talking about how their AI systems are built, latency, how they scale and what it costs per request or token</li> <li>Strong ties to the East Coast venture and startup community</li> <li>A history of hiring and developing great AE managers and AEs, and building a team people want to join</li> <li>Disciplined forecasting and pipeline management in fast-moving, high-volume deal environments</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity and the drive to build processes, programs and playbooks where none exist</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,1,0">For New York City and Boston based hires: Estimated annual salary of $418,000 - $575,000 OTE</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: (Senior) Consultant (m/w/d) Data Management & Data Governance

title: Market Researcher
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Turn market signals into GTM strategy for Marketing. Notion is a collaborative AI workspace for teams and companies, operating in a market where AI is changing how teams evaluate software and get work done. This role will help Marketing understand how customers, competitors, and the broader market are responding, including shifts in brand perception, then turn that understanding into sharper messaging, growth strategy, and audience strategy. You’ll own the market research relationship with GTM partners across global markets and regional teams, and expand Notion’s thought-leadership research capability through original work on topics like AI transformation and ROI. This role is based in New York City or San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE - Build a trusted market research practice and become a standing strategic partner for GTM planning, brought into launch planning early enough to shape the work. - Own brand tracking as a clear input into how Notion understands awareness, consideration, and perception, and translate those signals into sharper messaging and GTM priorities. - Connect customer, competitive, product, and top-of-funnel research across global markets to inform growth strategy and audience strategy. - Raise the bar for Notion’s research capabilities across decision support and thought leadership, building original studies on topics like AI transformation and ROI that give Marketing and Sales a credible point of view in the AI landscape. - Use AI as a research collaborator and workflow layer to connect data, scale analysis, surface patterns, and make insights easier for stakeholders to use, while improving the quality of decisions, not just the speed of delivery. SKILLS YOU’LL BRING - Strong quantitative research craft, including the ability to design and run research sprints, surveys, and MaxDiff studies, and to choose the right method for the decision at hand. - Deep understanding of brand tracking and top-of-funnel research, with the judgment to place those signals in the broader customer, competitive, and product context. - Strategic judgment: you can challenge the brief, connect market and product data, and turn ambiguous evidence into a clear recommendation that changes GTM priorities. - Experience working across global markets and regional teams, flexing across Product, Creative, and GTM while distinguishing local context from patterns that should shape broader strategy. - AI fluency and systems thinking: you use AI and data workflows thoughtfully to connect research infrastructure, scale insight delivery, and make the broader team more effective Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. title: Senior Software Engineer, R2 Metadata
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations | <strong>Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA or London, UK</strong></h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a massively successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <p>R2 is Cloudflare's object storage platform, offering developers durable, reliable storage that integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare's global network and Developer Platform. The R2 Metadata team owns the metadata layer that underpins every R2 operation, every object put, get, list, and delete flows through the systems we build and operate.</p> <p>R2 is growing rapidly, and the metadata layer must evolve to keep pace. The team is responsible for designing and operating the metadata systems that track every object in R2, building and shipping developer-facing features, and ensuring the reliability and performance of these systems at global scale.</p> <p>You'll be joining a team that operates at the intersection of distributed databases, large scale storage infrastructure, and edge computing;  building systems that need to be correct, fast, and reliable.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Design and implement features in a metadata system, backed by a distributed SQL DB,  that serves every R2 API operation, ensuring correctness, performance, and compatibility with the S3 API surface.</li> <li>Build and operate production services on Cloudflare Workers and Kubernetes that handle high throughput metadata operations with strong consistency and durability guarantees.</li> <li>Own the schema, data model, and query patterns for a metadata layer managing billions of objects across multiple distributed database clusters.</li> <li>Own projects end to end; from design docs and schema changes through implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring.</li> <li>Participate in oncall rotations, drive incident resolution, and write postmortems that improve reliability.</li> <li>Use AI tools extensively to accelerate development, debugging, and operational tasks. We expect engineers to leverage AI as a core part of their workflow.</li> <li>Collaborate across teams (storage infrastructure, networking, other platform teams) to coordinate capacity planning, API contracts, and cross cutting initiatives.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Strong programming skills in TypeScript, Go, or similar languages.</li> <li>Experience with distributed databases; schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and understanding consistency/performance tradeoffs at scale.</li> <li>Experience building or operating large scale distributed systems with strong reliability requirements.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud infrastructure concepts such as object storage, edge computing, or service oriented architectures.</li> <li>Understanding of reliability and observability practices: monitoring, alerting, performance tuning, and incident response.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain technical decisions clearly and coordinate across teams.</li> <li>Comfortable working with AI coding tools as part of a daily development workflow.</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, or edge computing platforms is a strong plus.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation</strong></h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Equity</strong></h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Time Off</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Notre mission est de fournir des fonctionnalités essentielles et abstraites pour le Cloud, en appliquant les meilleures pratiques de développement d'ingénierie logicielle pour unifier, sécuriser et optimiser nos plateformes.</p> <p>Tu rejoindras une équipe à taille humaine, composée d'ingénieurs passionnés. Nous sommes fans de développement logiciel, d'Infrastructure as Code, de culture DevOps/SRE, d'automatisation, de veille technologique... et bien sûr, de sport !</p> <h3><strong>Périmètre et missions d'un Platform Engineer</strong></h3> <p>En tant que <strong>Platform Engineer</strong>, tu joueras un rôle central dans l'autonomisation des équipes de développement grâce à l'ingénierie de plateforme. Tes missions s'articuleront autour des piliers suivants :</p> <h4><strong>1. Ingénierie Logicielle & Abstraction Cloud</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Utiliser les meilleures pratiques de développement (Software Engineering, Software Architecture) pour concevoir du code propre, robuste et maintenable créant des couches d'abstraction au-dessus du Cloud.</li> <li>Développer et industrialiser des API, outils internes et modules d'infrastructure en Python et Go.</li> <li>Consommer et orchestrer des services Serverless (Google Cloud Functions, Google Workflows) et moderniser l'outillage de déploiement.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>2. Infrastructure as Code & Automatisation DevSecOps</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Concevoir, tester et déployer l'infrastructure de manière cohérente et automatisée avec Terraform.</li> <li>Construire et optimiser des pipelines CI/CD modernes (de préférence avec GitHub Actions) intégrant les standards de sécurité DevSecOps dès la conception.</li> <li>Automatiser les tâches récurrentes par du scripting (Python, Bash) afin de réduire l'effort manuel et maximiser la fiabilité.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>3. Intégration Transversale & Excellence Opérationnelle</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Réseau, Sécurité et Bases de données pour garantir des intégrations fluides, performantes et sécurisées.</li> <li>Rôle de Run Captain: prendre en charge le support de niveau 2/3, l'analyse des incidents et le traitement des demandes de service pour assurer la stabilité opérationnelle.</li> <li>Contribuer à la définition et au respect des SLO/SLI ainsi qu'à la démarche de réduction du MTTR en automatisant la résolution des problèmes récurrents.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>4. Accompagnement, Partage & Culture Produit</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Rédiger une documentation technique propre et des guides utilisateurs pour faciliter l'adoption des services de plateforme.</li> <li>Sensibiliser et former les équipes techniques aux bonnes pratiques d'utilisation des composants développés.</li> <li>Participer à l'animation collective via la gestion agile de nos livrables dans JIRA et promouvoir le partage de connaissances au sein de l'équipe.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Ce dont tu auras besoin pour réussir</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Expérience & Dév :</strong> Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en développement Python avec une solide maîtrise des pratiques modernes de génie logiciel.</li> <li><strong>Expertise Cloud :</strong> Fortes compétences et expérience avérée sur Google Cloud Platform (GCP).</li> <li><strong>Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD :</strong> Maîtrise de Terraform et très bonne pratique des pipelines CI/CD (idéalement GitHub Actions).</li> <li><strong>Scripting & Serverless :</strong> Bonne connaissance de l'automatisation (Python, Bash) et de l'architecture Serverless / événementielle.</li> <li><strong>Soft Skills & Esprit d'équipe :</strong> Accompagnement continu dans le développement de tes compétences (diversité des projets, certifications, formations internes et externes…).</li> <li><strong>Package de rémunération description: <h2><strong>About Decathlon</strong></h2> <p>Decathlon aims to become the best sports digital platform and open ecosystem in the world. We want to enable customers to experience Decathlon through many local sport-centric experiences by connecting many third-party actors and services, in a secure and performant way.</p> <p>Our digital teams bring together more than 5000 collaborators are united to build and scale digital products with the aim to always deliver the best value to our users. extraction and manipulation.</li> <li>Experience with demand forecasting and inventory optimisation software/tools is a plus.</li> <li>Experience with Generative AI is a plus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Soft Skills</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen attention to detail.</li> <li>Strong communication and collaboration skills to work <li>Experience in demand forecasting, inventory optimisation, or supply chain analytics.</li> <li>Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools.</li> <li>Previous experience in the retail or e-commerce industry is a plus.</li> <li>Experience in implementing Generative AI to enhance forecasting, alongside optimising business or organisational processes for product delivery.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Technical Environment</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Execution Engine: Databricks, AWS EKS, Sagemaker</li> <li>Payload: Python, Spark, Scikit-Learn, Tensorflow / Pytorch, Pyspark </li> title: Principal Network Architect, Backbone Network
description: <p><strong>Firmus Technologies</strong></p> <p>Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific. </p> <p>Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.</p> <p>At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers</p> <p><strong>Firmus AI Cloud</strong></p> <p>Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.</p> <p>It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As Principal Network Architect, Backbone Connectivity at Firmus, you will lead the architecture and technical assurance of the backbone connectivity platform that underpins the Firmus AI Factory ecosystem and Firmus AI Cloud. The role directly reports to the Network Engineering team as a principal technical lead and acts as a dedicated support of the Head of Connectivity as the primary technical authority for backbone architecture. You will translate Firmus’s connectivity strategy into a scalable, resilient and vendor-neutral architecture, define the standards and design patterns that guide implementation, and ensure the backbone network positions Firmus as a leader in AI-ready connectivity, with focus on building and evolving Firmus’s national and international backbone across terrestrial and subsea networks, optical transport, IP backbone, data-centre interconnection and partner connectivity.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":120}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The role directly reports to the Network Engineering team as a principal technical lead and acts as a dedicated support the Head of Connectivity as the primary technical authority for backbone architecture. You will translate Firmus’s connectivity strategy into a scalable, resilient and vendor-neutral architecture, define the standards and design patterns that guide implementation, and ensure the backbone network positions Firmus as a leader in AI-ready connectivity.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":120}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">This role is responsible for the technical integrity of the backbone architecture across the full lifecycle, from concept and design assurance through delivery readiness, operational resilience and continuous improvement. You will work across carriers, subsea operators, terrestrial fibre providers, data-centre partners and internal engineering teams to ensure Firmus’s network connectivity is high-performance, secure, operationally robust and ready to scale with the company’s AI infrastructure growth.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":120}"> </span></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As Principal Network Architect, Backbone Connectivity, you will own the technical architecture of Firmus's backbone network and act as the principal technical adviser to the Head of Connectivity, while operating as a senior technical lead within the Network Engineering team. You will convert the Firmus Connectivity Strategy into an integrated, executable backbone architecture spanning subsea and terrestrial fibre, optical transport (DWDM/OTN), IP/MPLS and segment routing, data-centre interconnection and partner connectivity. You will define the reference architecture, standards and reusable design patterns that guide engineers and partners, ensuring every AI Factory and Firmus AI Cloud service attaches through resilient, diverse and scalable backbone nodes free of unmanaged common-mode failure.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":120}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Working across carriers, subsea operators, terrestrial fibre providers and data-centre partners, you will set minimum resilience profiles, validate physical-route and shared-risk-link-group diversity, and provide independent technical assurance that designs can be delivered, operated and scaled safely across their full lifecycle. You will act as technical design authority in vendor and technology selection for backbone and subsea services, lead complex backbone changes and cutovers, mentor the engineering team, and benchmark Firmus's designs against leading global operators and hyperscalers — keeping Firmus at the forefront of AI-ready network connectivity.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":120}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">What </span><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">you’ll</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing"> bring</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">You are, first and foremost, an accomplished network architect for large-scale, mission-critical connectivity infrastructure. You bring deep expertise in national and international backbone design across terrestrial long-haul fibre and subsea systems, including landing-station connectivity, cable-landing diversity, and terrestrial route and duct engineering. You are fluent in optical transport (DWDM/OTN, coherent and client-side optics, ROADM and amplification/regeneration planning) and in IP backbone design, including IP/MPLS, segment routing, EVPN, traffic engineering, peering, transit and internet exchange, and high-capacity data-centre and customer interconnection. You understand how to design resilient, diverse networks free of unmanaged common-mode failure, using SRLG analysis, engineered failure-state capacity and physical-route evidence to prove your claims rather than assert them.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":120}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Across the delivery lifecycle, you are equally at home leading architecture and design reviews, carrier and technology-vendor governance, technical evaluation of backbone and subsea services, change control, cutover planning, and operational-readiness and handover to network operations. You have authored or materially shaped reference architectures, design standards, reusable patterns and architecture decision records at a hyperscale operator, carrier, or equivalent, and you know how to keep an architecture modular and vendor-neutral so the business can flex across managed services, wavelengths, dark fibre and subsea assets as demand and economics change. You are comfortable engaging carriers, subsea consortia, internet exchanges and major equipment vendors, and you can drive value engineering and sustainability outcomes without compromising resilience or performance.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":120}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Above all, you have the temperament of a senior technical leader operating across geographies: strong systems thinking, calm judgement under delivery and incident pressure, the confidence to challenge design and vendor assumptions constructively, and the communication skill to carry a room of network engineers, a customer technical review, and an executive readout with equal clarity. You bring commercial awareness, comfort operating across cultures and time zones, and a genuine passion for building AI-ready network connectivity that performs reliably from day one and positions Firmus as a leader in the field.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":120}"> </span></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Skills & Experience</strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The ideal candidate will bring a strong technical foundation in network and connectivity engineering, ideally with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or a related discipline, together with more than 12 years of progressive experience designing and operating large-scale backbone networks across carrier, hyperscale, cloud or specialist AI infrastructure environments. They will have led technical evaluations of carriers, subsea operators and equipment vendors, defined the technical sections of RFPs and evaluation criteria, and worked effectively across the design-to-operate interface with Network Engineering, Data Centre and Operations teams.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":120}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Experience authoring or contributing materially to global backbone reference architecture, minimum standards or interconnection strategy at a hyperscale, carrier or AI infrastructure operator is a strong differentiator, as is experience delivering into APAC markets — particularly Indonesia, Australia and Singapore — under diverse regulatory, licensing and provider conditions. title: Senior Finance Business Partner
description: <p><strong>About Us</strong></p> <p>Ocado Technology builds the systems behind some of the world’s most advanced grocery fulfilment: the Hive grid, thousands of bots, robotic picking and automated frame loading, all run by software our Product & Engineering teams write every day. More and more of that software is now built with AI.</p> <p>That makes finance here far from routine. Cloud and AI are among our fastest-moving costs, and how we capitalise engineering time directly shapes our P&L. Decisions made by engineering leaders this quarter show up in our cash flow next quarter. We want someone who’ll help make those decisions, not just report on them.</p> <p><strong>Are you our person?</strong> You’re curious about how things work, commercially sharp, and happy to challenge the way things are done when you can see a better way. You can juggle competing priorities and build trust at every level, from engineers to VPs. And you’re comfortable with AI: Claude is an official member of the team here, and you’ll work alongside it every day.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>In this role, you’ll report to the Head of Finance and have real autonomy. We’ll give you the problem, not a checklist. You’ll use AI as a core part of how you work: building tools, automating reporting and analysing data so your time goes on insight, not reconciliations. In this team, building a tracker in Claude or querying data yourself in Looker is normal. You will partner with: Product & Engineering VPs and leaders, Procurement, Treasury, Group Accounting, the Shared Service Centre, and Commercial Finance colleagues across Ocado.</p> <p>The exact mix will flex with your experience, your interests and the team’s priorities, but you’ll be working across:</p> <ul> <li>The P&E cost base: Partnering Product & Engineering leaders on budgets, outlooks and month-end, and helping them understand what drives their costs and where the opportunities are.</li> <li>Technology spend: Getting ahead of some of our fastest-moving costs, such as cloud, software and AI, and helping the business balance P&L impact against cash.</li> <li>Investment and accounting judgement: Making sure we treat engineering investment correctly, from capex and capitalisation to how costs are allocated across the business.</li> <li>Decision support: Turning messy questions into short, clear recommendations for senior finance and technology leaders.</li> <li>How finance works: Building tools, automating processes and finding better ways of doing things, and shaping the team as it evolves</li> </ul> <p><strong>About you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Qualified accountant (ACA / ACCA / CIMA or equivalent) with 2+ years post-qualification experience including time in commercial finance or business partnering </li> <li>Confidence to take the lead: you set your own priorities, chase answers down and drive work through to a decision without waiting to be asked</li> <li>Hands-on use of AI tools in your work, with examples of something you’ve automated, built or rethought</li> <li>Strong modelling, budgeting and forecasting skills, and a solid grasp of P&L, capex and cash</li> <li>The ability to explain technical costs in plain English to engineers and finance leaders alike, and to challenge constructively</li> <li>Curiosity about how technology businesses work. Experience with cloud costs, capitalisation of development spend or SaaS/tech finance is a plus, not a requirement</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer</strong></p> <p>We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Time to recharge</strong>:<br>25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more – and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.</li> <li><strong>Health & wellbeing</strong>:<br>Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.</li> <li><strong>Family-first policies</strong>:<br>22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave</li> <li><strong>Financial support</strong>:<br>Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE), and interest-free loans for train tickets.</li> <li><strong>Commuter perks</strong>:<br>Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.</li> <li><strong>Exclusive discounts</strong>:<br>15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month).</li> </ul> <p></p> <p>#LI-JK3</p> <p>#LI-HYBRID</p> <p></p> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior General Ledger Accountant / Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/f)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:  </strong></p> <p>The International Accounting team at Planet is seeking a versatile Senior GL Accountant to maintain our books and become a key part of our global Finance team. In this pivotal position, you will serve as a core financial anchor, managing critical workflows that directly support our expanding international footprint and global operational success. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, curious, collaborative, and analytical, bringing a strong work ethic to solve complex financial challenges. By driving rigorous accounting standards and cross-functional alignment, you will help power Planet's mission with a robust operational finance foundation. Ideal candidates are proactive problem-solvers who thrive in dynamic, cross-border team environments.</p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin manufacturing office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage day-to-day closing and reporting activities including journal entries and reconciliations for Fixed Assets and Inventory in our Berlin Manufacturing site to ensure books are maintained in accordance with U.S. GAAP and HGB.</li> <li>Maintain the Fixed Asset Register (FAR), tracking capital expenditures, asset additions, disposals, transfers, monthly depreciation runs, and Construction in Progress (CIP) balances with operational stakeholders.</li> <li>Review and clear consolidated transfer orders between international subsidiaries, managing asset movements between locations for both PBC and GmbH entities.</li> <li>Maintain costs, prepayments, and accrued payables associated with satellite materials, launch, and build processes across inventory, WIP, and internal fixed asset materials.</li> <li>Support physical count / cycle count programs and analyze inventory adjustments.</li> <li>Partner with Berlin Operations to establish scalable cost accounting workflows, standard costing methodologies, and manufacturing time-tracking for our local production line.</li> <li>Serve as the dedicated backup for US cost accountants during time-off and high-volume periods.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>4+ years of relevant cost accounting experience in a manufacturing or high-tech operational environment.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration (or a relevant German <em>Ausbildung</em>, e.g., <em>Industriekaufmann/-frau</em>, with specialized focus on accounting/controlling).</li> <li>Experience with inventory controls, Fixed Assets and multi-entity global structures.</li> <li>Proficiency with modern ERP systems and advanced capability in Excel or Google Sheets.</li> <li>Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Professional working proficiency in German</li> <li>Working knowledge of both US GAAP and German GAAP (HGB)</li> <li>A passion for Fixed Assets & Inventory GL Accounting</li> <li>Direct hands-on experience with NetSuite ERP/Oracle <br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.</p> <p><strong>Export Control Requirements:</strong></p> <p><em>Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span data-contrast="none"><strong>About the Company</strong></span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none"><strong>Affinidi </strong>is a technology company dedicated to changing data ownership for good. We empower businesses and individuals with control and ownership of their data, with a comprehensive approach to managing their holistic identity – accounting for all aspects of their digital footprint while ensuring privacy and security. </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Affinidi’s technology enables users to benefit from decentralised digital identity solutions. We believe that everyone has the right to own and control their data, and we are committed to creating a trusted digital credentials ecosystem that empowers businesses and individuals to securely exchange data and services across borders and industries.</span></p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span data-contrast="auto">We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager (Technical) who wants to help define how trust is built into the next generation of AI systems. At Affinidi, we’re building the Trust Fabric product suite to give AI agents verifiable identity, policy guardrails, and real-time observability, so organisations can move from promising proofs of concept to secure, governed production deployments with confidence.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">This is a role for builders. You’ll work side by side with engineering to turn ambitious ideas into real, high-impact products, fast, iteratively, and with strong product judgment. You’ll take on complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t come with a playbook, bring structure to what matters, and help the team move with clarity, speed, and conviction. architectural, and operational landscapes of the Defence sector.<br><br><br><strong>What You Will Be Doing</strong></div> <ul> <li><strong>Serving as the primary technical point of contact</strong> Elastic.</li> </ul> <div><br><strong>What You Bring</strong></div> <ul> <li><strong>A track record of success in a technical presales role</strong> within the UK Public Sector, specifically working officials.</li> <li><strong>A willingness to travel 30% within the region</strong> to visit customer sites, secure facilities, and occasionally travel internationally.</li> </ul> </div> </div> </div> title: Senior Manager CMI Europe

This role is vital because it brings the consumer's voice into every strategic choice, from brand positioning to innovation and execution. In this role you will translate complex market and consumer data into clear, actionable opportunities that drive better food experiences in kitchens across Europe. Your work will help the business anticipate shifts in taste, nutrition, and consumer needs, ensuring Flora Food Group stays one step ahead. What you'll do Lead the European consumer and market insights strategy, identifying and delivering against the key questions that drive growth. Partner with senior marketing and cross-functional leaders to shape strategy and commercial decisions with clear, evidence-based consumer perspectives. Build and manage a focused learning agenda aligned with Flora's six strategic growth priorities, supporting innovation and market acceleration. Integrate qualitative and quantitative data, market intelligence, and emerging technologies to create a holistic view of consumer behaviour. Lead a lean, high-impact insights team, optimizing resources and fostering curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning. Performance You will own the quality and impact of consumer insights that shape European business decisions, driving measurable growth. Success will be tracked by how insight influences priority decisions, the delivery of learning agendas on time, and early involvement in innovation projects. You will lead the adoption of AI and advanced analytics to improve decision speed and quality, ensuring research budgets deliver maximum return on investment. Care You will report to the Global Insights Vice President and lead a dedicated European insights team. Collaboration across marketing, innovation, research and development, and other functions will be key to embedding consumer centricity throughout the organisation. Your leadership will ensure sustainable, responsible use of data and technology, building long-term capabilities that support Flora Food Group's mission to create better food for diverse communities. Passion As a food lover and consumer champion, you will bring relentless curiosity and empathy to your role. You will connect deeply with evolving food culture, nutrition trends, and consumer needs, inspiring your team and partners to innovate with confidence. Your passion for integrating taste, nutrition, functionality, and reliability will raise the bar for how insights drive meaningful consumer experiences. About you You have significant senior experience in consumer and market insights, ideally within food, beverages, or fast-moving consumer goods. You excel at influencing senior stakeholders and shaping brand, innovation, and commercial decisions through integrated insight and strong storytelling capabilities. You have e xperience operating across countries and cultures and yo ur strategic mindset combines human understanding with advanced analytics and emerging technologies like AI. You thrive in complex, matrixed environments and build trust across diverse teams to prioritise impactful work. You are genuinely interested in food culture and have a relentless curiosity about consumer behaviour and how future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences. Where this could lead to This role typically leads to broader leadership positions within global consumer insights or commercial strategy, expanding your influence across more markets. Over time, potentially shaping Flora Food Group's global approach to consumer understanding and innovation, driving long-term growth and transformation. title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description: About HappyRobot HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $150M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide. Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Application Security Engineer to help secure our product and platform through hands-on security architecture and engineering. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and compliance teams, taking ownership from identifying risks through designing, implementing, and rolling out solutions. We’re a lean security team, so your work will span security reviews, vulnerability management, platform hardening, automation, incident response, and compliance engineering. Alongside finding and fixing vulnerabilities, you’ll identify opportunities to prevent entire classes of risks through shared security controls and centralized enforcement. You’ll help decide where these investments matter most and build solutions that teams can adopt as the company grows. What You’ll Do Design and implement shared security controls that prevent entire classes of vulnerabilities and centralize enforcement across applications and services. Partner with engineers on architecture and threat modeling, translating risks into concrete designs for authorization, service identity, tenant isolation, and data protection. Build security controls and secure defaults into application frameworks, service templates, and infrastructure modules, making them straightforward for teams to adopt. Develop automation that connects security tools with engineering workflows, adds context to findings, and automates remediation where appropriate. Own vulnerability management across internal findings, automated tooling, external assessments, and researcher reports. Review code, perform targeted security testing, and manage vulnerabilities through verified remediation. Use recurring findings to identify where a shared control or architectural change would prevent similar issues. Support the compliance team by implementing technical controls, automating procedures, and validating that controls operate as intended. Help investigate security incidents and use the findings to improve architecture, controls, and detection. What We’re Looking For 5+ years of experience in application security, product security, or software engineering with substantial security ownership. Strong understanding of web, API, and distributed-system security, including authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, and sensitive data handling. Experience taking security controls from architectural design through implementation and adoption across multiple services or teams. Ability to design defense in depth, establish clear trust boundaries, and limit the impact of compromised components or credentials. Strong coding skills: you can review production code, contribute fixes, and build maintainable tooling and shared security components. Experience integrating security tools into engineering workflows and using context and automation to reduce manual work. Sound technical judgment, clear communication, and the independence to take an ambiguous problem through to a working solution. Why join us? Work closely with engineers building AI systems used in critical enterprise operations. Own substantial security projects and help shape a growing security program. Have the autonomy to design solutions, implement them, and see their impact in production. Join a company backed by leading investors. Competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Our Operating Principles Extreme Ownership We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us. Craftsmanship Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching. We are “majos” Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego. Urgency with Focus Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy. Talent Density and Meritocracy Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win. First-Principles Thinking Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible. The personal data provided in your application and during the selection process will be processed by Happyrobot, Inc., acting as Data Controller. By sending us your CV, you consent to the processing of your personal data for the purpose of evaluating and selecting you as a candidate for the position. Your personal data will be treated confidentially and will only be used for the recruitment process of the selected job offer. In relation to the period of conservation of your personal data, these will be eliminated after three months of inactivity in compliance with the GDPR and legislation on the protection of personal data. If you wish to exercise your rights of access, rectification, deletion, portability or opposition in relation to your personal data, you can do so through ----- subject to the GDPR.
