title: Placement Agentic Software Engineer - 2027
description: Join Instil’s agentic product development team for your placement year and learn to build software the way it will be built in the agentic age: engineers owning the problem, the architecture and the key decisions, with AI agents accelerating everything in between. About the role At Instil, agentic product engineering is how we deliver. Our teams work alongside an agentic workforce that generates requirements, builds across parallel workstreams, runs continuous quality and security checks or monitoring systems in production. The result is software that ships faster, with lower risk. The agents do a lot, but people stay firmly in charge - orchestrating. We own the problem, the architecture and the key decisions. That is the skill set we will help you build from day one. As a placement student you will join a delivery team working on real client products for organisations ranging from ambitious start-ups to global brands. You will learn the fundamentals of great software engineering and, alongside them, how to direct, review and get the best out of AI agents. What you'll do You will work across our full delivery lifecycle, supported by experienced engineers and mentors. Plan: take part in discovery with clients, help shape requirements and use agents to turn ideas into rapid prototypes and a backlog ready to build. Build: write, review and test production code, directing agents across parallel workstreams and learning to judge when their output is right and when it is not. Ship: help release software to production, design for observability and use agents to monitor systems, analyse issues and drive improvements. Along the way you will: Learn to make sound technical decisions and explain them clearly Build good habits in security, testing and code quality, so speed never comes at the cost of trust Work directly with clients and colleagues as part of a collaborative, multi-disciplinary team Share what you learn, as our ways of working with agents are evolving all the time What we're looking for We care more about how you think than what you already know. Essential: Currently studying towards a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline, with a placement year as part of your programme Solid programming fundamentals in at least one modern language, such as TypeScript, Python, Java, Kotlin, or C# Hands-on experience with AI coding tools, Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor or similar, through projects, hackathons or coursework Strong problem-solving skills and the judgement to question an answer rather than simply accept it Clear communication skills and an enjoyment of working in a team Nice to have: Side projects, open source contributions or a portfolio that shows what you have built An interest in cloud platforms, security or web and mobile development What you'll get A structured placement programme combining engineering fundamentals with hands-on training in agentic development A mentor and regular feedback throughout your year Real client work from your first weeks, not just internal projects Access to the latest AI tools and the time to learn them properly A collaborative culture where people share knowledge openly A head start into your final year – and a strong foundation for a graduate role Placement details Duration: 12 months Start date: June/July 2027 Location: Belfast Working pattern: Hybrid – at least 3 days per week in our Belfast Office Right to work: Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK Eligibility: Open to students in their penultimate year of an undergraduate or integrated master’s degree, with a placement year as part of their programme Why Join Instil? At Instil, we believe great work starts with happy, motivated people. That’s why we’ve built a benefits package that supports your wellbeing, growth, and life outside of work, because when you thrive, so do we. Recognition That Matters: A discretionary annual performance bonus that rewards your impact and contribution to our success. Flexibility Built In: Flexible working arrangements and summer hours, because life isn’t 9 to 5, and balance matters. Financial Security: A highly competitive pension scheme with generous employer contributions, private healthcare, and life assurance for peace of mind. Health & Wellbeing: Employee Assistance Programme, mental health support, cycle-to-work scheme, and regular social events to keep our culture vibrant. Time to Recharge: 35 days holiday, enhanced maternity pay, and family-first policies so you can focus on what matters most. Learning Never Stops: From courses to certifications, we’ll invest in your development so you can keep growing and shaping what’s next. Community & Culture: Opportunities to volunteer, give back, and be part of initiatives that make Instil a truly inclusive and connected workplace. And that’s just the start, drop us a note to find out more. Please note: We offer flexible hybrid working, but candidates should be based in Northern Ireland and able to attend our Belfast office when required. Company Description Instil has been delivering world-class software engineering and technology solutions for over 20 years, trusted by global brands to solve complex challenges and drive innovation. From modernising legacy systems to building cutting-edge applications, we help our clients navigate an ever-changing digital landscape with confidence and agility. We’re proud to be an award-winning employer , reflecting how our people are at the heart of everything we do: Recognised as a Great Place to Work® for three consecutive years, and in 2024 ranked in the Top 20 Best Workplaces in the UK for medium-sized companies . Winner of Company of the Year at the Digital DNA Awards 2022 , celebrating excellence in Northern Ireland’s tech sector. Driven by a love for technology and a commitment to excellence, we bring together people who want to make a difference. We’ll support your journey, because your success is part of ours. #LI-PR1 #InstilCareers Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Security Engineer
description: Who we are Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables. We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi . The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level. We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years. The role We're hiring our first dedicated Security Engineer to protect our technology and our customers' data. You'll work across the systems behind TabPFN, from cloud infrastructure and software to enterprise deployments. You'll work with engineers to understand risks, design secure systems and build the tools to protect them. The role spans cloud and product security, incident response, and technical work with customers and auditors. We're looking for a strong infrastructure engineer who wants to focus on security. Your experience could come from platform engineering, SRE, backend development or a security role. What you'll do - Review system designs and code, identify security risks, and help engineers address them throughout development. - Build security controls and automation for our cloud infrastructure, software and deployment pipelines. - Improve identity and access management for people and services, including permissions, secrets and access changes. - Assess vulnerabilities, coordinate penetration tests and work with engineering teams to prioritise and deliver fixes. - Develop detection and recovery capabilities, investigate incidents and lead the technical response with engineering teams. - Support customer security reviews and the technical controls for SOC 2 and ISO 27001. Our Operations team coordinates the audit programme. What we're looking for - Hands-on experience building and running cloud infrastructure, including GCP or AWS, IAM, CI/CD and containers. - Experience writing and maintaining infrastructure as code and automation in a team. - An interest in security that you've put into practice through work, personal projects, CTFs or relevant training. - Sound judgment about which risks need attention first, and an interest in the breadth of the role, including audits and customer conversations. - The ability to explain a risk clearly and work with other engineers to address it. - Practical use of AI tools to improve engineering workflows. - Based in Berlin or Freiburg, or willing to relocate. We consider remote work within the EU by exception. What sets you apart - Experience in cloud or application security, penetration testing, or acting as your team's security contact. - Work on container and software supply-chain security. - Experience supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits, or taking responsibility for security at a smaller company. Life at Prior Labs You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right. Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together. Our Commitments The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are. title: (Senior) Account Executive, DACH (f/m/d)
description: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next. Our Commercial Development team is seeking a (Senior) Account Executive, DACH (f/m/d). This role will be crucial in managing the entire sales cycle, from finding a potential client to finalising the deal. In close collaboration with the SDR and CSM team, you will be key in driving growth of our customer base and market revenue. Your responsibilities Here's a bit more of what you can expect: Qualifying inbound leads, as well as reaching out to your own list of leads. Presenting solutions to prospects via discovery and demo calls, tailoring them to their specific needs in order to clearly communicate value. Maintaining relationships with prospective customers and the multiple stakeholders within their organisations to guide them through contract negotiations and signing Creating a great onboarding experience for customers by guiding them through the sign-up process and seamlessly introducing them to Customer Success Managers. Staying current on company developments through inter-departmental relationships (marketing and product etc) and keeping yourself up to date on market trends. Accurately reporting and tracking your activity in our CRM system About you We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in the role: You have proven experience as Sales Manager or Account Executive, preferably in the B2B Software as a Service (SaaS) or FinTech field, and ideally in a full sales-cycle and/or solution sales capacity You are fluent (C2) in German and English (C1) In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for: Ownership - You take full responsibility for your pipeline, your targets, and your deals — from first touch to close. You drive momentum, solve problems proactively, and keep pushing even when it gets tough. Structured Selling - You bring the method to sales - value-based selling, or your own proven system. You communicate clearly, lead discovery with purpose, and close with control. You know when to challenge, when to listen, and how to create urgency. Customer Empathy - You take the time to understand what matters to each prospect — their pain points, context, and goals. You don’t just pitch features; you connect the dots. You’re consultative, curious, and focused on delivering real value. Resilience - You thrive in high-volume, fast-paced environments without losing quality. When deals fall through or the workload spikes, you stay focused, bounce back fast, and keep standards high. You're hungry, coachable, and resilient. Team Player - You’re not just here to hit quota — you bring energy, support your peers, and contribute to a positive, high-performance culture. You share what works, collaborate across teams, and care about how we win, not just that we win. About Moss Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work. Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star. We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA : playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect: Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos. Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits. title: Junior Electrical Engineer
description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind. The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end : requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in production. You’ll work closely with Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Software and the Production team. As Filics moves from prototypes to series production, your designs need to work reliably at scale , not just in the lab. What you’ll do Take full ownership of a complex PCB project and get it running in as few revisions as possible Design high-power and high-speed circuits and make sure they work together at system level Design for EMC, manufacturability and testability, and take boards through EMC testing and certification Bring new technical approaches to the team, for example a new converter architecture that enables higher charging power in a smaller package Introduce useful processes from your experience, such as simulation workflows that validate a layout before it goes to production Help with board bring-up and debugging together with Embedded Software, and support Production with clear documentation and training Take over ownership of existing boards so the team shares responsibility About you Several years designing electronics in an R&D environment at a smaller hardware company driven by innovation (e.g. robotics, e-mobility, aviation, autonomous vehicles, motion control) A proven record of taking PCBs within a larger system from requirements to a validated product Strong skills in schematic design and PCB layout (Altium, KiCad, OrCAD or similar) Hands-on debugging experience with an oscilloscope, logic analyzer, VNA or spectrum analyzer, plus soldering Experience with designs that went through EMC testing or CE certification An innovator’s mindset: you have built something new or significantly improved an existing concept Basic simulation know-how (e.g. LTspice, ANSYS, thermal/EM/tolerance analysis); deeper experience is a strong plus Basic experience with Linux and embedded software You work independently, take ownership and thrive without rigid structures What Filics offers Real ownership of your designs, from first draft to series production Space to innovate and a wide range of technical challenges, from power electronics to high-speed design A small, high-caliber team with close collaboration across disciplines Fast growth: one year at Filics teaches you what usually takes many years at a large company An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly Sound like you? title: Working Student, Revenue Engineering (m/f/d)
description: At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team. Are you ready to join us? ABOUT THE TEAM Revenue Engineering sits within Data & Insights Operations and exists to close the gap between our Data Production & Insights teams and our Revenue teams. We do this in two ways: by bringing product expertise directly into client conversations (for example through strategic pitch support), and by bringing our data and insights teams closer to the customer through programs like Voice of Customer (VoC), where we analyze signals such as customer feedback forms and support tickets submitted by our CSMs. Alongside both, we run a tool that automates our competitor research and content, and the team keeps that tool sharp and its outputs trustworthy. As a Working Student on this team, you'll get a front-row seat to how a data company turns customer signal and market knowledge into commercial impact, working across all three areas rather than being boxed into just one. YOUR JOB As Working Student in Revenue Engineering, you help turn customer signals and market knowledge into commercial impact and keep our Data & Insights teams closely connected to our customers. • Analyze customer feedback forms and support tickets from our Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to find recurring themes, then turn them into structured summaries our Data Production and Insights teams can act on • Maintain and improve how we track and report on Voice of Customer signals over time • Support strategic Salesforce case requests by researching market and product angles and turning our data capabilities into clear talking points and visuals for clients • Review pitch materials for quality before they go to our Sales and Account teams • Keep our automated competitor research tool accurate by fact-checking its outputs against internal standards, flagging gaps and covering missing topics through targeted manual research • Build reports, presentations and data visualizations in PowerPoint and Excel, and support data cleaning and quality checks across team deliverables YOUR SKILLS • Enrolled student in business administration, economics, data science, communications, social sciences or a related field • Genuine interest in how customer insights, market research and data drive business decisions • Confident with Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Think-Cell is a plus • Strong written and spoken English; other languages are a plus • Curious and detail-oriented, able to work independently and reliably, and a team player who enjoys both analytical and client-facing tasks Available 15 to 20 hours per week, with a flexible schedule that fits around your studies What we offer In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! description: Wij zijn op zoek naar een test engineer met een brede technische interesse die techniek graag combineert met organiseren en samenwerken. Hoe mooi is het om als eerste een installatie aan te zetten en te testen of alles werkt zoals bedoeld en voldoet aan de verwachtingen van de opdrachtgever? Je werkt met uiteenlopende systemen, zoals camerasystemen, branddetectie, luchtbehandeling, voedingsverdeelkasten, verlichting, netwerken en waterinstallaties. Kortom: een compleet technisch gebouw, waarbij jij helpt om alles goed en aantoonbaar werkend op te leveren. Dit wordt jouw baan Je brengt samen met de testmanager in kaart wat er getest moet worden, stelt testplanningen en -protocollen op en bewaakt de voortgang. Je bereidt onder andere FAT-, PAT- en iFAT-testen voor, zorgt dat de juiste mensen, systemen en componenten beschikbaar zijn en begeleidt de daadwerkelijke testuitvoering. Bevindingen leg je zorgvuldig vast en je bewaakt dat deze worden opgevolgd. Je hoeft daarbij niet vanaf dag één specialist te zijn in alle systemen. Je werkt samen met ervaren testmanagers, testcoördinatoren, engineers en technische specialisten en krijgt de ruimte om je inhoudelijk verder te ontwikkelen. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Hier zit je op je plek Je wordt onderdeel van de vakgroep Technische Installaties binnen het cluster Ontwerp van Dura Vermeer Infra Landelijke Projecten. Samen met circa 140 collega's werk je aan de grootste multidisciplinaire infrastructurele projecten van Nederland, zoals tunnels, bruggen, sluizen, energieprojecten, waterzuiveringen en hoogspanningsinstallaties. Binnen het project werk je nauw samen met collega's uit ontwerp, uitvoering en projectbeheersing. Je krijgt veel ruimte om richting te geven aan het testproces en kunt daarbij terugvallen op ervaren collega's en technische specialisten. Afhankelijk van het project werk je op locatie, vanuit een Dura Vermeer-kantoor of vanuit huis. Als eerste opdracht voorzien we een rol op het project Landstations, waarbij we de locatie realiseren waar de wind energie vanuit windparken op zee wordt omgezet naar het landzijdige nationale elektriciteitsnet. Je werk daarmee direct mee aan de verduurzaming van onze elektriciteitsvoorziening. Dit breng jij mee Een hbo / wo opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in elektrotechniek, werktuigbouwkunde, industriële automatisering of een vergelijkbare richting; Een brede interesse in technische installaties en de motivatie om verschillende systemen te leren doorgronden; Je kunt technische tekeningen en documentatie lezen of bent gemotiveerd om dit verder te leren; Je werkt gestructureerd en kunt technische informatie vertalen naar een praktische aanpak; Je communiceert makkelijk met verschillende partijen en vindt het leuk om techniek en coördinatie te combineren; Ervaring met testen, commissioning, FAT/SAT of technische projectcoördinatie is een pré. Dit bieden wij jou Het salaris voor deze functie ligt tussen € 4.291,63,- en € 5.364,54,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring. Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra). 43 verlofdagen volgens de Cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen; Een laptop en een smartphone; Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap; Je hebt de keuze tussen een mobiliteitsbudget, NS Business Card of een elektrische leaseauto ; Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike; Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar bijvoorbeeld ook op het gebied van vitaliteit; Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland; Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibelwerkenbeleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical; Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de vijf weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%. title: HR Business Partner / Senior HR Advisor
description: HR Business Partner Contract: Full-time, Permanent Location: Breda, North Brabant | Hybrid working, combining office and home Salary: Up to €6.000 per month, depending on experience, plus company benefits The opportunity Kinly is a leading global provider of audio-visual and unified communications solutions, helping organisations create secure, flexible and engaging workplace and meeting experiences. We are looking for an HR Business Partner to join our collaborative local and global HR team in Breda. This is a broad, hands-on HR role that could suit either an existing HR Business Partner looking for their next opportunity, or an experienced HR Advisor ready to take the next step into a Business Partner role . Primarily supporting our Netherlands business, you will partner with managers and employees across a wide range of people matters, from employee relations and performance to organisational change, engagement and talent. You will also support smaller employee populations across Central Europe, giving you the opportunity to broaden your international HR experience and develop your knowledge of HR practices across different countries . You will also manage and develop the HR Advisor based in Breda. What you'll be doing Partnering with managers: Providing practical HR advice, coaching and constructive challenge on people and organisational matters. Employee relations: Managing employee relations cases including performance, grievances, disciplinary matters and employment terminations. Performance and talent: Supporting performance management, talent and development activity and coaching managers through key people processes. Works Council: Building an effective relationship with the Dutch Works Council (OR) and supporting consultation and information processes. Sickness absence: Managing long-term sickness absence cases in line with the Dutch Gatekeeper Improvement Act (Wet verbetering poortwachter). Engagement and workforce insights: Using HR data and employee feedback to identify trends and support actions around engagement, retention, absence and turnover. HR projects and change: Supporting regional and global HR initiatives, organisational change and continuous improvement. Recruitment and onboarding: Partnering with Talent Acquisition and managers to support recruitment, onboarding and the employee experience. International HR: Providing practical HR support to smaller teams across Central Europe, working with regional HR colleagues and local specialists where required. HR operations: Supporting payroll checks, HR reporting, compliance and the consistent application of HR policies and processes. People management: Coaching and developing our HR Advisor in Breda. What we're looking for We are interested in hearing from established HR Business Partners as well as experienced HR Advisors who are ready to progress into a broader Business Partner role . Ideally, you will bring: Strong, practical HR experience gained in the Netherlands, operating at Dutch HBO level or equivalent. Good working knowledge of Dutch employment law and sickness absence management. Experience handling employee relations matters and advising managers with confidence. Practical experience working with a Dutch Works Council. Experience of performance management, organisational change and stakeholder management. Strong communication, coaching and influencing skills. An analytical approach, with the ability to turn HR data and emerging issues into practical actions. Fluency in both Dutch and English , written and spoken. An interest in developing your international HR experience and supporting colleagues across Central Europe. Experience supporting employees in other European countries, particularly Germany and/or Switzerland, would be an advantage, but is not essential . Experience with SAP SuccessFactors would also be useful, but isn't required. Why this role? This is an opportunity to take ownership of a varied HR remit while being part of a wider international HR team. You'll have the chance to build on your HR Business Partnering skills, manage and develop an HR colleague and broaden your experience beyond the Netherlands through exposure to HR matters across Central Europe . Whether you're already working as an HR Business Partner or are an experienced HR Advisor looking for the opportunity to make that next career move, we'd be pleased to hear from you. Inclusion and accessibility Kinly is committed to providing equal opportunities in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, gender identity, pregnancy, colour, race, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, religion or any other protected characteristic. If you require reasonable adjustments during the interview process, please let our Talent Acquisition team know when your interview is scheduled. title: Afstudeerstage AI Adoption
description: Wil jij helpen om AI van technologie naar dagelijks werk te brengen? Bij HG geloven we dat technologie mensen sterker maakt. Daarom hebben we de afgelopen periode een stevig fundament gelegd voor AI binnen onze organisatie. Microsoft Copilot is geïntroduceerd, er zijn verschillende AI-initiatieven gestart en steeds meer collega’s ontdekken wat AI voor hun werk kan betekenen. De volgende stap is opschalen. Want AI beschikbaar maken is één ding. Zorgen dat mensen het daadwerkelijk goed gebruiken, er nieuwe vaardigheden mee ontwikkelen en hun manier van werken aanpassen, is waar de echte transformatie plaatsvindt. Als afstudeerstagiair AI Adoption help je ons om die volgende stap te zetten. Je komt terecht in een internationale organisatie waar samenwerking, initiatief en nieuwsgierigheid centraal staan. Je begint dus niet vanaf nul. Je bouwt verder op wat er al staat en helpt ons te ontdekken welke aanpak nodig is om AI-adoptie verder te versnellen. Je combineert onderzoek met praktijk. Je analyseert hoe AI wordt gebruikt, vertaalt data naar concrete acties, ontwikkelt en geeft trainingen voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus en helpt collega’s om AI steeds beter toe te passen in hun dagelijkse werk. De exacte onderzoeksopdracht bepalen we samen, zodat deze aansluit bij jouw opleiding, interesses en afstudeereisen. HG is een compacte, snelgroeiende en internationale organisatie waar je direct de impact van je werk ziet. Dit vraagt om eigenaarschap, initiatief en een pragmatische, resultaatgerichte houding. De cultuur is open en stimuleert het delen van ideeën, constructieve samenwerking en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Alles wat we doen is gebaseerd op onze kernwaarden: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected. Wat ga je doen? Binnen HG zijn de eerste stappen in AI-adoptie al gezet. Er is dus een fundament om op voort te bouwen. Tijdens jouw stage help je ons om naar brede, structurele adoptie te gaan. Concreet ga je onder andere: Praktische en inspirerende Copilot-demo’s geven aan verschillende groepen medewerkers. Bestaande adoptiedata analyseren en vertalen naar inzichten en concrete acties om gebruik en impact te vergroten. Onderzoeken waar adoptie achterblijft en welke interventies kunnen helpen om medewerkers verder te brengen. AI-trainingsprogramma’s ontwerpen en uitvoeren voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus, van collega’s die net beginnen tot ervaren gebruikers. Trainingen, workshops, oefeningen en praktische hulpmiddelen ontwikkelen waarmee medewerkers AI direct in hun eigen werk kunnen toepassen. De Copilot Academy op ons intranet verder ontwikkelen en actueel en relevant houden. Medewerkers meenemen in de bredere AI-transformatie en concreet maken wat AI voor hun eigen werkzaamheden betekent. Het AI Champions-programma ondersteunen en verder helpen ontwikkelen. Feedback en behoeften van medewerkers ophalen en vertalen naar verbeteringen in trainingen, communicatie en andere adoptie-initiatieven. Onderzoeken welke activiteiten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan meer gebruik, betere AI-vaardigheden en waarde voor de organisatie. Jouw onderzoek en werkzaamheden helpen HG om AI niet alleen beschikbaar te maken, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van de dagelijkse manier van werken. Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met onze AI Transformation Lead en hebt veel contact met collega’s uit verschillende afdelingen binnen de organisatie. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van zowel de menselijke als bedrijfskundige kant van AI-transformatie. Omdat HG actief is in meer dan 45 landen, werk je bovendien in een internationale omgeving waarin verschillende functies, perspectieven en niveaus van AI-volwassenheid samenkomen. “We beginnen bij HG niet meer vanaf nul met AI. Er ligt een fundament en steeds meer collega’s werken ermee. De interessante vraag is nu: hoe zorgen we dat AI voor veel meer mensen écht onderdeel wordt van hun dagelijkse werk? Ik zoek iemand die het leuk vindt om daar samen met mij de volgende stap in te zetten.” – Els Marchal, AI Transformation Lead Wie ben je? Je volgt een relevante hbo-opleiding, zoals Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, ICT, Business Informatics, Data & Business, Human Resource Management, Learning & Development, Communicatie of vergelijkbaar. Je hebt interesse in AI én de manier waarop mensen nieuwe technologie adopteren . Je vindt het leuk om voor groepen te staan en anderen iets nieuws te leren. Je kunt complexe onderwerpen op een eenvoudige en praktische manier uitleggen. Je werkt zelfstandig en gestructureerd. Je bent nieuwsgierig en stelt kritische vragen. Je vindt het interessant om data te analyseren en inzichten te vertalen naar concrete acties . Je kunt goed schakelen tussen verschillende doelgroepen en niveaus van AI-ervaring. Je vindt het leuk om trainingen, materialen en nieuwe manieren van leren te ontwikkelen. Je durft initiatief te nemen en ideeën in de praktijk uit te proberen. Ervaring met tools zoals Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT en Power BI is een pre. Belangrijker is dat je nieuwsgierig bent naar AI en enthousiast wordt van de vraag: hoe zorgen we ervoor dat mensen AI daadwerkelijk goed gaan gebruiken? Wat bieden wij jou? Een afstudeeropdracht met directe impact op de organisatie. Intensieve begeleiding door de AI Transformation Lead. Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap. De kans om ervaring op te doen met AI-adoptie en organisatieverandering . Praktijkervaring met het ontwikkelen en geven van AI-trainingen, demo’s en workshops. De mogelijkheid om met echte adoptiedata te werken en te onderzoeken welke interventies daadwerkelijk effect hebben. Een actieve rol binnen het AI Champions-programma. Werken aan actuele AI-vraagstukken binnen een internationale organisatie. Een hybride werkomgeving vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Almere. Een informele en betrokken werksfeer waarin samenwerking centraal staat. Stagevergoeding van €450,- bruto per maand (obv 32 uur). Aan het einde van je stage heb je niet alleen een sterke afstudeerscriptie, maar ook praktische ervaring opgedaan met AI-adoptie, training en organisatieverandering binnen een internationale organisatie . Je hebt zelf trainingen en demo’s gegeven, met echte adoptiedata gewerkt en gezien wat ervoor nodig is om medewerkers daadwerkelijk mee te krijgen in een AI-transformatie. Wij zijn HG! Bij HG, een toonaangevend Europees merk in specialistische reinigings- en onderhoudsproducten, geloven we dat een huis een plek moet zijn waar je zorgeloos kunt leven. Met aandacht voor de plek waar je woont en voor de spullen die je omringen. Daarom ontwikkelen wij onze producten zo dat ze veilig doen wat ze beloven. De missie van HG is om jou te helpen optimaal van je huis te genieten, zonder je zorgen te maken over wat er mis kan gaan. Dit realiseren wij met onze zeer effectieve, veilige en specialistische reinigingsoplossingen, gecombineerd met deskundig advies. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Almere zetten wij ons dagelijks in voor superioriteit, innovatie, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid. Met een sterke aanwezigheid in Europa en daarbuiten blijven wij continu investeren om een nog grotere impact te maken. HG doet wat het belooft. Nog vragen? Onze collega Ilse de Groot (Corporate Recruiter) neemt alle tijd om antwoord te geven. title: Post-doctorant(e) en IA agentique correcte par construction (SoS)  - CDD de 12 mois
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en IA agentique correcte par construction (SoS) pour rejoindre le département INFRES de Télécom Paris. Contexte scientifique : les cadres de vérification existants supposent généralement des modèles finis et précisément définis, dont les actions et les relations de transition sont connues. Ces hypothèses sont difficiles à maintenir dans les systèmes modernes d’IA agentique, où les actions peuvent être générées dynamiquement, les environnements peuvent évoluer et les informations sur le système peuvent être incomplètes. Le projet Sound or Silent (SoS) vise à combler cette lacune en étudiant une nouvelle approche d’IA agentique correcte par construction. L’idée centrale consiste à intégrer le raisonnement stratégique et la vérification formelle directement au processus décisionnel des agents autonomes. Au lieu de vérifier un agent uniquement après son développement ou de surveiller son comportement après l’exécution, SoS étudie la possibilité de produire des actions formellement certifiées conformes à une spécification donnée. Selon cette approche, une action candidate n’est exécutée que s’il est établi qu’elle appartient à une stratégie garantissant les propriétés requises. Si une telle garantie ne peut être établie, l’agent s’abstient d’agir. Atteindre cet objectif exige d’étendre les techniques de vérification stratégique à des environnements ouverts, évolutifs et partiellement spécifiés, et d’étudier des notions de correction adaptées à une information incomplète. Le projet explorera également une architecture associant un composant génératif non fiable, chargé de proposer des actions ou des stratégies candidates, à un noyau de vérification formelle de confiance, chargé d’en contrôler la correction. Une attention particulière sera portée à l’expressivité des modèles formels sous-jacents, au coût de calcul de la certification et au compromis entre garanties formelles et capacité des agents à accomplir des tâches utiles. Les travaux associeront des développements théoriques à la réalisation et à l’évaluation expérimentale de prototypes, dans des scénarios de planification autonome, d’agents d’IA utilisant des outils et de coordination multi-agents. L’objectif général est de poser les fondements de systèmes d’IA agentique dont l’autonomie est encadrée par des garanties stratégiques formellement vérifiables. Vos missions principales seront de : Mener des travaux de recherche sur l’IA agentique correcte par construction Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat Contribuer au rayonnement scientifique de Télécom Paris Vous devrez être titulaire d’un doctorat ou d’un diplôme équivalent et disposer de solides connaissances en méthodes formelles, logique et vérification de modèles. Une expérience dans les systèmes multi-agents, les logiques stratégiques, la vérification à l’exécution ainsi que dans le développement d’agents fondés sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM) sera également attendue. Vous devrez maîtriser le développement logiciel et l’implémentation d’algorithmes, ainsi que la démarche de recherche scientifique, notamment la formulation de problématiques, la conception d’expériences et l’analyse de leurs résultats. Une excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, sera indispensable. Enfin, vous devrez faire preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe, de qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles ainsi que d’un esprit de synthèse. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers). Vous bénéficierez de : 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT) flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service) télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75% Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne... A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé Informations diverses : Date limite de candidature : 15 janvier 2027 Type d'emploi : CDD de 12 mois Description de poste détaillée ici Rémunération : 36 000 euros brut/an Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuel et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. title: Ingénieur.e de recherche pour le pilotage de l'activité hospitalière (H/F) - CDD 14 mois
description: ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation. Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient. Ce poste, ouvert au sein d’IMT Mines Albi, est rattaché au Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) qui compte à ce jour environ 70 personnes. Le centre s’intéresse à la cinétique des organisations et au développement de solutions d’aide à la décision dans des contextes hétérogènes, collaboratifs et incertains. Ceci est mis en pratique par la représentation, la modélisation et l’analyse des données de ces organisations afin de formaliser de la connaissance conduisant à la prise de décision dans des contextes hétérogènes, collaboratifs, incertains et/ou perturbés. Le CGI est structuré selon quatre axes de recherche appliquée : Axe FLOWS : Systèmes logistiques flexibles pour un monde durable ; Axe DISCS : Systèmes numériques pour la gestion des crises et la sécurité ; Axe WHOPS : Systèmes organisationnels pour la santé et le bien-être ; Axe TRACE : Résilience territoriale, agilité et économie circulaire. Huit expertises scientifiques et techniques sont au cœur de ces axes de recherche : Ingénierie systèmes, Ingénierie des modèles, Théorie de la décision, Recherche opérationnelle, Technologies immersives, IA générative, IA symbolique, et IA connexionniste. Les chercheurs et ingénieurs du CGI exploitent et contribuent particulièrement aux paradigmes scientifiques suivants pour réaliser les projets de recherche ou formation : l’Internet Physique, la Physique des Décisions, les Jumeaux Numériques Organisationnels. Le poste à pourvoir concerne l'un des projets de recherche de l'axe WHOPS. Le but de ce projet est de répondre à un besoin exprimé par l'Agence Régionale de Santé (ARS) et un hôpital de la région parisienne. La personne recrutée sera intégrée à une équipe de chercheurs en ingénierie organisationnelle pour la santé, ce qui garantira un accompagnement visant une montée en régime rapide et un suivi régulier des activités de l'ingénieur(e) recruté(e). DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : Le contexte général du projet concerne le pilotage des capacités hospitalières et l'anticipation des tensions sur l'offre de soins. Il s'agit d'un enjeu majeur pour les établissements de santé, les institutions en charge de la planification de l'offre de soins, et plus largement, pour l'ensemble des professionnels impliqués dans l'orientation des patients. L'objectif général du projet est de développer et expérimenter, en s'appuyant sur des données réelles provenant du système d'information d'un hôpital, des outils innovants d'analyse et de prévision-prédiction de l'activité hospitalière, essentiels pour améliorer l'anticipation et le pilotage des capacités (ressources humaines et lits). Parmi les outils et solutions envisagés, un intérêt particulier porte sur les principes du jumeau numérique asynchrone permettant l'analyse rétrospective des parcours patients et la simulation "in silico" de scénarios prospectifs. D'autres outils et techniques, concurrents ou complémentaires, notamment à base de projections statistiques et d'intelligence artificielle, devront aussi être explorés. De manière générale, l'ingénieur(e) de recherche recruté(e) interviendra sur les développements et les travaux de recherche visant l'objectif général du projet. Plus précisément, la mission consiste à : Analyser les données associées aux flux de patients et les déterminants organisationnels et médicaux influençant les durées de séjour et l'occupation des lits ; Développer des modèles permettant d'estimer et d'anticiper l'évolution des taux d'occupation des capacités hospitalières ; Développer des outils d'aide à la décision destinés aux professionnels hospitaliers et aux acteurs de la régulation ; Produire une méthodologie reproductible et transférable à d'autres établissements ou territoires de soins ; Documenter tous les travaux de développement dans des dossiers techniques à destination d'autres développeurs. Rédiger des notices d'utilisation pour les utilisateurs finaux des modules ou application. Rédiger ou participer à la rédaction de publications scientifiques pour valoriser les travaux réalisés. Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables : Méthodologies de recherche et développement, incluant notamment les étapes de spécification des besoins, d’analyse de la littérature, de conception de solutions logicielles et organisationnelles, d’expérimentation, de validation, et de dissémination des résultats. Connaissances fondamentales des langages, outils et méthodes de traitement et d'analyse de données ainsi que des notions en interfaçage utilisateur. Compétences en simulation à événements discrets à l'aide d'outils du commerce (Witness, FlexSim, AnyLogic, …) ou à l'aide de bibliothèques de développement (SimPy, SimJulia, Salabim, …). Connaissances générales du système de santé français et si possible expérience (stage, emploi) en milieu hospitalier. Capacités et aptitudes : Communication, écoute, pédagogie, et interaction avec des chercheurs du CGI comme avec des professionnels de santé à l'hôpital. Esprit d'équipe, collaboration, force de proposition, synthèse, rigueur technique et scientifique, autonomie. PROFIL RECHERCHE : Le(la) candidat(e) devra être titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur ou d’un Master M2. Son domaine d’activité se situe en génie industriel, en informatique ou en sciences de données et en intelligence artificielle. description: Joining Mines Saint-Étienne means committing to an institution where science and innovation build a more sustainable future. It is a school of excellence where everyone has the opportunity to unlock their full potential and contribute to tackling the challenges of tomorrow. Ranked among the top engineering schools in France and recognized worldwide, our school, a member of the Institut Mines-Télécom , educates the talents of tomorrow while actively addressing major industrial, digital, and environmental challenges. By joining us, you become part of a community of 528 members of staff, 2,500 students and take part in an ambitious project: combining academic excellence, cutting-edge research, and positive societal impact. The Institut Mines-Télécom brings together France’s leading Grandes Ecoles to tackle major industrial, digital, energy, and environmental challenges. With its eight public Grandes Écoles and two affiliated Graduate Schools, it is the leading public institute dedicated to engineers and managers. Together, we imagine and build a sustainable future by educating the leaders who will shape tomorrow’s transitions. 🎯 What we expect from you ? The Flexeo technology enables the development of individual electronic devices on ultraflexible substrates. Within the Flexeo3D project , the objective is to integrate these devices into stretchable matrices to develop wearable prototypes for augmented perception. The postdoctoral researcher will contribute to the development of a complete, autonomous system integrating sensors, a microcontroller, a power source and sensory-feedback actuators, in close collaboration with two PhD students working on sensing and haptic feedback technologies. The ultimate goal is to integrate the system into an ergonomic, breathable wearable sleeve. A key challenge is the development of flexible and stretchable interconnections between system modules. Particular attention will be paid to investigating optical communication channels as a potential solution for data transmission. This will involve a state-of-the-art review, the design and fabrication of dedicated test structures, and the evaluation of optical bus communication technologies. Building on the developed integration technologies, the researcher will contribute to the realization of a fully functional wearable demonstrator, in close collaboration with the researcher responsible for the electronic system design. Experimental work in the laboratory and technological development are essentialand will partly be conducted in our cleanroom and our prototyping Platform (ID-Fab) These efforts will contribute to the creation of radically new demonstrators, opening new avenues for exploration in augmented 🔍 What we are looking for ? A person with a PhD or Master's degree in Engineering Sciences, physics and material science. The ideal profile we would like to recruit is the following: Knowledge · Engineering sciences, optics and optoelectronic devices. · Thin-film fabrication processes · 3D design. Experience and practical skills · Hands-on experience in guided optics and optical/optoelectronic devices. · Practical experience in experimental development, prototyping and laboratory work. · Experience with stretchable devices would be an advantage. Personal qualities · Resourceful, pragmatic and curious, with a hands-on mindset (mandatory). · Autonomous and proactive, with the ability to work in a collaborative R&D environment. · Good scientific communication skills. If you feel that your background and skills are a good fit for this position, even if you do not meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply ! 🌍 Why join Mines Saint-Étienne ? We support each of our employees on the path to excellence, with the conviction that together, we can have a lasting and significant impact on our world. Joining Mines Saint-Etienne is the opportunity to find: • A stimulating environment: Cutting-edge experimental resources, a welcoming working environment and a solid international network (T.I.M.E., EULIST). • A real impact: Contractual research projects worth €11 million/year, mainly with industrial partners, A science culture centre, La Rotonde , which has been committed to science outreach for 25 years, welcoming over 50,000 visitors per year. • An incomparable quality of life: 49 days of paid leave, partial remote working, 75% reimbursed public transport, financial support for carpooling and cycling and a social barometer where 83% of employees praise the quality of life at work. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, Denver, Seattle, </p> <h4><strong>About the Department</strong></h4> <p>The Technical Account Team plays a crucial role in ensuring a seamless experience for Cloudflare users, ranging from individual developers to Fortune 500 enterprises. As the primary technical point of contact, you will manage support interactions, troubleshoot issues, drive escalations, and advocate for customer needs. </p> <p>You will act as an architectural governance partner, continuously mapping customer environments against industry best practices and Cloudflare's Well-Architected framework. By proactively identifying security gaps, single points of failure, and performance bottlenecks, you will prevent incidents before they impact production. </p> <p>Working closely with Account Teams, Product, Engineering, and partnering with Customer Support, you will align technical solutions with customer roadmaps and business objectives. This role requires a mix of technical expertise, customer service excellence, and strategic problem-solving to ensure high customer satisfaction and retention.</p> <p>For TAMs specializing in Network Services, you will focus on optimizing customer Cloudflare configurations, ensuring the reliability and security of their network infrastructure.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> satisfaction, delivering world-class technical support and advocacy.</li> <li>Provide actionable customer feedback to Product and Engineering teams to help shape product improvements.</li> <li>Maintain a comprehensive understanding of customer environments and Cloudflare deployments, ensuring proactive issue resolution and long-term optimizations.</li> <li>Develop and maintain a rolling Technical Risk & Gap Register for each enterprise account, tracking architectural drift, legacy configurations, and emerging security threats, while prioritizing remediation paths with customer stakeholders. </li> <li>Conduct Quarterly Support Reviews, including SLA adherence, incident reviews, and deep-dive analysis of top ticket drivers, as well reviewing future-state resilience, capacity planning, and proactive feature adoption. </li> <li>Act as a point of escalation during business hours and provide backup support for global TAMs in other time zones.</li> <li>Partner with the account team to drive strategic customer engagements, including technical planning, roadmap alignment, and incident response.</li> <li>Partner with Cloudflare’s Threat Intelligence and Product teams to proactively evaluate customer environments against newly discovered vulnerabilities (Zero-Days, emerging DDoS vectors), ensuring defensive configurations are deployed ahead of potential exploits. </li> <li>Ensure timely resolution of support tickets, working with backend teams as needed.</li> <li>Establish continuous drift-detection workflows to ensure customer configurations don't deviate from established security baselines, compliance standards, or optimal performance thresholds. </li> <li>Travel up to 25% of the time to support customer engagements.</li> <li>Ability to work one weekend per month.</li> <li>Utilize AI-powered analytics to conduct proactive configuration health checks and architectural reviews, identifying systemic risks and providing strategic infrastructure optimization recommendations.</li> <li>Streamline the creation of technical documentation—including HLDs, LLDs, and post-incident reports—by leveraging AI workflows to ingest and summarize technical data, ensuring consistent, high-quality deliverables.</li> <li>Deploy AI-assisted incident management tools to enhance communication precision, including real-time impact assessment, automated status updates, and rapid synthesis of complex technical event details.</li> </ul> <h4>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h4> <p>We are seeking a highly motivated customer-focused technical expert with the following skills and experience:</p> <h4><strong>Technical Expertise</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of networking concepts, including Layer 7 technologies and routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, IPSec, and GRE.</li> <li>Experience with security technologies (Firewalls, IPS, DDoS mitigation, WAF).</li> <li>Knowledge of system integration, multi-vendor environments, and data center deployments.</li> <li>Proficiency in diagnostic and troubleshooting tools (traceroute, WireShark, dig, cURL).</li> <li>Familiarity with the OSI Model, proxies, application & network security.</li> <li>Passion for Cloudflare’s products and a strong desire to help customers succeed.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Customer & Business Acumen</strong></p> <ul> problem-solving skills, ability to work independently, and handle multiple priorities.</li> </ul> <p>This role is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of Cloudflare’s Enterprise customer title: Sales Manager, Iberia - Digital Natives

title: Senior Systems Engineer, Network Protocols & Distributed Systems
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong> London, Lisbon, or Austin - (Hybrid)</p> <p>Join the team helping shape the future of the Internet. We’re building high-performance systems that handle a <em>quarter of the Internet’s traffic</em>. Our work influences open standards (like QUIC, MASQUE, and ECH), involves close collaboration with the IETF, and pushes the boundaries of what's possible in networking and security.</p> <p>You don’t need to be an HTTP or cryptography expert to join — we’re looking for excellent engineers who love tough problems, want to learn deeply, and are excited to contribute to one of the most technically demanding areas of infrastructure.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and operate systems that terminate HTTP and TLS at Internet scale</li> <li>Migrate core infrastructure from NGINX to a next-gen Rust-based proxy</li> <li>Measure and improve protocol performance across real-world traffic</li> <li>Contribute to open source and industry standards</li> <li>Learn from and work alongside some of the leading engineers in this space<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>You might be a good fit if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have solid systems programming experience (Rust, C, or similar)</li> <li>Thrive in complex technical domains and enjoy learning new things</li> <li>Care about building reliable, secure, and performant software</li> <li>Are motivated by impact — technical, operational, and on the Internet itself</li> <li>Come from a background that’s underrepresented in tech — we value diverse perspectives<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Perks include:</strong><strong><br></strong>Flexible work hours • Take-what-you-need vacation • RSUs • ESPP • Meaningful technical challenges every day</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €54,000 - €75,000.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

<li>Build reproducible benchmark harnesses measuring TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token. Validate architecture choices under representative traffic and consistent GPU budgets.</li> <li>Collaborate with GPU kernel and platform engineers to trace bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.</li> <li>Produce design documents, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.</li> </ul> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Strong engineering skills in Python and PyTorch.</li> <li>Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer inference.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack, such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or an equivalent internal system.</li> <li>A strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks involving KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.</li> <li>Ability to quantify trade-offs among latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost.</li> expert parallelism.</li> <li>Strong communication and collaboration skills across research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8, INT8, INT4, NVFP4, MXFP4, AWQ, GPTQ, or SmoothQuant.</li> <li>Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with.
