Adoption has grown 4–6x in the last year. It's a small team, so you'll have a big surface area and real ownership from day one.</p> <p>As a Software Engineer, you will help build and operate internal platforms that help Cloudflare engineers develop, deploy, and run software safely and efficiently. You’ll work across developer tooling, CI/CD, GitOps, and AI-assisted development, including MCP servers, agents, evals, and context engineering.</p> <p>You’ll also help govern and enforce Cloudflare’s Engineering Codex by turning engineering standards into automated guardrails, paved paths, and actionable feedback.</p> <h3>What You’ll Do</h3> <p>- Build developer productivity tools, MCP servers, and AI agents.</p> <p>- Automate Engineering Codex controls through CI/CD checks, templates, and policy-as-code.</p> <p>- Monitor Codex adoption, improve controls, and support remediation and exception workflows.</p> <p>- Improve GitOps, developer experience, platform security, and reliability.</p> <p>- Partner with product teams on architecture and platform adoption.</p> <p>- Respond to and prevent incidents affecting internal platforms.</p> <h3>What We’re Looking For</h3> <p>- Experience with TypeScript, Go, or Bash.</p> <p>- Strong debugging and source-control skills.</p> <p>- Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, or developer platforms.</p> <p>- Ability to break down complex problems and evaluate trade-offs.</p> <p>- Clear communication and a strong focus on developer experience.</p> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <p>- Experience with AI agents, MCP, evals, or LLM-based tooling.</p> <p>- Experience with policy-as-code or compliance automation.</p> <p>- Background in platform engineering or developer productivity.</p> <p>- Experience operating distributed or Kubernetes-based systems.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. The Role Bitstack runs dozens of interconnected backend services on Google Cloud. As the engineering team grows, we want every engineer to be able to test their changes end to end, quickly and independently, before they reach our shared environments. As part of the Infrastructure team, you will build a local test environment for our backend engineers and QA. The goal is simple: anyone can start our backend services and their dependencies on their own machine with a single command, reproduce real business scenarios and test asynchronous flows end to end. You will own the project from the initial assessment through to company-wide adoption. What You'll Be Doing 1. Assessment & Recommendation Learn our stack (Go and Python services, Bazel, Docker, Kubernetes, GCP) and map how our services depend on each other. Evaluate the test tooling and emulators already in our codebase, as well as the tools available on the market. Recommend an approach, and record your tooling choices and trade-offs in a decision log. 2. Building the Local Environment Start with a pilot cluster of interconnected services and get it running locally with a single command. Solve the real problems as they come up: configuration and secrets, service-to-service authentication, cloud dependencies (Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, databases, caches) and async workers. Scenarios, Data & Adoption Build seed data and scripts so that any user state, limit or time-based event can be reproduced and reset on demand. Work with backend engineers and QA as your first users, gather their feedback and fix what breaks. Write documentation clear enough for a new engineer to get set up on their own, and support the team through the switchover. By the end of the internship, you will turn your decision log into a recommendation report and hand over a tool the team will keep maintaining. You will gain hands-on experience with a production-grade microservices architecture on Google Cloud, and see how a platform tool is designed, built and adopted by an engineering team. You will learn how infrastructure decisions are made and documented, and work closely with backend, QA and infrastructure engineers, with mentoring from a DevOps engineer throughout. Hands-on experience with Docker and a working knowledge of Kubernetes. Comfortable with Linux and scripting (shell, Python or similar). Previous experience with a cloud provider, through an internship, a project or coursework. GCP is a plus. Experience with Go, Bazel or Docker Compose is a plus, but not required. Curious and autonomous: you like to understand how a system fits together before changing it. Able to explain technical trade-offs clearly, in writing and to the engineers who will use what you build. Fluent in English. French is a plus. Based in Paris or happy to relocate for the internship. title: Head of Security Engineering
description: We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger. At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries. The team You'll join the Security team will lead Ledger's security engineers, and stay hands-on. You lead the Blue team that defends Ledger's corporate, development and production environments. Your team threat-models and risk-assesses every feature, app and service Ledger builds or uses, runs the company's material security controls, and is the expert escalation on critical cyber incidents. What you’ll be doing Lead the Blue team defending Ledger's corporate, development and production environments: priorities, planning, hiring and reviews, while staying hands-on yourself. Run threat modelling and risk assessment for every new feature, application and service Ledger builds or adopts, internal or third-party, and turn the findings into owned, prioritised engineering work. Own and run the company's material security controls: cloud guardrails and access control, identity, endpoint protection, CI/CD and release integrity (code signing, protected pipelines), change control on production, and secrets management. Bring offensive knowledge to the team's work and partner closely with the Red Team: design controls the way an attacker would approach them, turn Red Team findings into owned engineering work, and have fixes re-tested by the Red Team or external testers. Act as Tier 3 experts on critical cyber incidents with Security Operations: deep technical analysis, containment and recovery. Secure the use of AI coding assistants and agents in engineering, with clear rules on access, data and approvals. Own the engineering roadmap for security tooling and controls, report progress to the CSO, and give Legal the technical facts it needs for regulatory reporting. Coach the team and keep a clear on-call and review rhythm. What we’re looking for 10+ years in security engineering, including 3+ years leading a team, and still hands-on. Hands-on threat modelling and risk assessment of applications, services and cloud architectures. Offensive security knowledge and techniques (penetration testing, red teaming or exploit development), enough to think like an attacker when designing defences. Hands-on credibility in cloud, application and product security, with strong infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar) and Kubernetes security. Experience owning and operating security controls at company scale: identity, endpoint, CI/CD, secrets and cloud access. Incident response experience as a senior technical escalation on serious incidents. Ability to work with Product, Engineering and Legal; fluent English is a must, French a plus. At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to: Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance. Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work. Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation. Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee. For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information. We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior People Operations Generalist (m/f/d)
description: Senior People Operations Generalist (m/f/d) Standort: München Bei der Viessmann Generations Group sind unsere Mitarbeitenden die Grundlage unseres Erfolgs. Als Senior People Operations Generalist (m/w/d) bei der Viessmann Generations Group verbindest du operative HR-Expertise mit Freude an Prozessverbesserung und Automatisierung. Du sorgst dafür, dass People Operations heute verlässlich funktioniert und morgen noch besser wird. So schaffst du die Grundlage dafür, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden in jeder Phase ihrer Zusammenarbeit mit uns gut begleitet werden. Über uns Viessmann wurde 1917 gegründet und ist seit über einem Jahrhundert ein führendes Industrieunternehmen im Bereich Klimatechnologien. 2024 brachte das Familienunternehmen sein Climate Solutions Geschäft mit Carrier Global zusammen, um eine transatlantische Partnerschaft mit weltweit einzigartiger industrieller Reichweite zu schaffen. Die Viessmann Generations Group verkörpert seitdem die Weiterentwicklung hin zu einem globalen Ökosystem mit dem gemeinsamen Leitbild: Lebensräume für zukünftige Generationen zu gestalten. Durch strategische Investments, Partnerschaften und philanthropisches Engagement unterstützt die Viessmann Generations Group Unternehmer:innen und Initiativen, die sich den zentralen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit stellen. Die thematischen Investitionsfelder reichen von der Vermeidung, Reduktion und Speicherung von Treibhausgasen über die Verbesserung von Luft- und Wasserqualität und Ernährungssicherheit bis hin zur Förderung von Gesundheit, Bildung, Wissenschaft und dem Schutz demokratischer Werten. Der Viessmann Way beschreibt, wie wir arbeiten, führen und gemeinsam Wert schaffen – ob als Teammitglied, Unternehmer oder Partner in unserem Ökosystem. Der Viessmann Way ist kein Regelwerk, sondern ein Kompass: ein lebendiges Set an Prinzipien, geformt durch unternehmerisches Handeln und ausgerichtet auf unser langfristiges Leitbild. Deine Chance Als Senior People Operations Generalist (m/w/d) bei der Viessmann Generations Group bringst du deine operative HR-Expertise in ein werteorientiertes Umfeld mit klarer Mission ein. Als Teil unseres People Operations Teams übernimmst du Verantwortung für zentrale People-Prozesse und entwickelst sie weiter – vom Vertragsmanagement über Payroll und HRIS-Datenverwaltung bis zu Prüfungen und internem HR-Controlling. Du verbindest Sorgfalt, Diskretion und Verlässlichkeit mit einem vorausschauenden Blick auf Systeme und Automatisierung. Damit gestaltest du eine positive Employee Experience und eine People-Funktion, die technologische Kompetenz mit einem klaren Blick für die Bedürfnisse unserer Mitarbeitenden verbindet. Dich erwartet ein kollaboratives Team, das Vertrauen, Fairness und hohe Qualität schätzt. Wenn du gerne Verantwortung übernimmst und Abläufe für Menschen einfacher und besser machst, findest du bei uns den passenden Gestaltungsspielraum. People-Prozesse optimieren & automatisieren Du betreust das HRIS-System (HiBob) und stellst eine reibungslose Automatisierung der People Operations sicher. Du förderst die Automatisierung durch den Einsatz der Google Suite einschließlich Apps Script, AI Studio, NotebookLM und weiteren KI-Lösungen. Du steigerst Effizienz und Compliance durch datenbasierte Verbesserungen der People-Prozesse. Operative Exzellenz & Compliance sicherstellen Du stellst sicher, dass alle People-Prozesse mit dem deutschen Arbeits-, Steuer- und Sozialversicherungsrecht, unseren Compliance-Vorgaben und branchenüblichen Best Practices im Einklang stehen. Du verantwortest das Vertragsmanagement, Vertragsänderungen und die Mitarbeiterdokumentation. Du stellst gemeinsam mit unserem externen Payroll-Dienstleister regelkonforme und korrekte reguläre und außerplanmäßige Gehaltsabrechnungen sowie die damit verbundenen Aufgaben sicher. Employee Journey gestalten Du betreust den gesamten Employee Lifecycle – vom Onboarding bis zum Austritt. Du bist eine vertrauensvolle Ansprechperson für People-Richtlinien, Mitarbeitendenbelange und Compliance-Fragen. Du übernimmst eigenverantwortlich einzelne Sonderprojekte entlang des Employee Lifecycle. Beziehungen & HR Leadership stärken Du arbeitest eng mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen, darunter Führungskräfte, Mitarbeitende und externe Partner. Du unterstützt Führungskräfte dabei, durch bewährte People-Praktiken eine leistungsstarke Unternehmenskultur aufzubauen. Warum wir? Bei uns trifft die langfristige Perspektive eines Familienunternehmens auf den Gestaltungsspielraum einer Organisation im Wandel. Du kannst eigene Ideen einbringen, moderne HR-Systeme und KI-Anwendungen im Alltag nutzen und die Weiterentwicklung unserer People Operations aktiv mitgestalten. Dabei siehst du unmittelbar, wie dein Beitrag den Arbeitsalltag unserer Mitarbeitenden verbessert. Dich erwarten kurze Entscheidungswege, gegenseitiges Vertrauen und ein Team, das Wissen teilt und sich unterstützt. Dein Profil Relevante Erfahrung: Du bringst mindestens vier Jahre Erfahrung in People Operations oder HR-Administration mit, insbesondere in vorbereitender Payroll, Vertragsmanagement und Employee-Lifecycle-Prozessen. Fundiertes Fachwissen: Du bist versiert im deutschen Arbeitsrecht und mit angrenzendem Steuer- und Sozialversicherungsrecht vertraut, insbesondere im Zusammenhang mit Payroll. Die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Payroll-Dienstleistern, Krankenkassen und Behörden gehört zu deiner täglichen Praxis. System- und Prozessverständnis: Du hast Erfahrung mit HRIS-Systemen und bereits erfolgreich Prozesse optimiert und Automatisierungen umgesetzt. Erfahrung mit HiBob und Google Workspace sowie ein gutes Verständnis weiterer People-IT-Systeme und KI-Anwendungen sind ein starkes Plus. Sicherer Umgang mit Daten und Office-Anwendungen: Du beherrschst insbesondere Excel und Word und arbeitest sicher mit Formeln, Vorlagen, Auswertungen und strukturierter Dokumentation. Eigenverantwortung und Sorgfalt: Du arbeitest proaktiv, präzise und zuverlässig. Du beherrschst wiederkehrende, standardisierte Abläufe und hast zugleich den Anspruch, sie weiterzuentwickeln. Diskretion und ein verantwortungsvoller Umgang mit vertraulichen Informationen sind für dich selbstverständlich. Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau. Führungserfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Freude an Zusammenarbeit: Du kommunizierst klar und empathisch, handelst pragmatisch und verbindest effiziente Prozesse mit einem Blick für die Bedürfnisse der Mitarbeitenden. Du arbeitest selbstständig, bringst dich aber auch gerne in ein Team ein, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt, und bereicherst jedes Meeting nicht nur fachlich, sondern auch durch deinen persönlichen Humor! Warum wir? Bei uns trifft die langfristige Perspektive eines Familienunternehmens auf den Gestaltungsspielraum einer Organisation im Wandel. Du kannst eigene Ideen einbringen, moderne HR-Systeme und KI-Anwendungen im Alltag nutzen und die Weiterentwicklung unserer People Operations aktiv mitgestalten. Team & Personnel Leadership: Provide direct disciplinary, operational, and technical leadership across the customer service department, establishing a positive, high-performing culture and inspiring high employee engagement. Data-Driven Operational Excellence: Deep familiarity with service analytics, workforce management software, and core CS metrics (CSAT, NPS, FCR, SLA, AHT). title: Senior Projectmanager
description: Jouw Missie bij CCS Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam. Voordelen voor de sollicitant Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar). Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks. En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch? Een voorbeeld van je werkdag Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen. Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant. Wie jij bent De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten: · Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten; · Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope; · Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat; · Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig; · Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift; · Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch; · Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties; · Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica. Wat bieden wij jou? Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij: · Salaris : We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis; · Middelen : Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon; · Werkdagen : Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur; · Vergoeding voor thuiswerken : Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten; · Workation : Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken; · Leuke teamactiviteiten : Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night; · Vakantiedagen : Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen; · Groei en ontwikkelin g: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS; · Vakantiegeld : Jaarlijks 8,33%; · Voordelen : Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer. Waarom CCS? Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Advocaat-stagiaire Banking & Finance
description: Het team en de functie Binnen ons Banking & Finance team werken we op dit moment met zeven advocaten. We begeleiden transacties, adviseren over financieel toezichtrecht en staan cliënten bij in procedures over onder andere zorgplicht en verhaal. Dat doen we voor banken, verzekeraars, fondsen, leasemaatschappijen, factoraars en grotere bedrijven. Samen met ons Herstructuring & Insolventie-team staan we ook bedrijven met een herstructureringsvraagstuk en hun stakeholders zijn. Ons team wordt erkend als toonaangevende praktijk in de internationale ranglijsten Legal500 en Chambers and Partners. In het afgelopen jaar heeft ons team voor meer dan EUR 8 miljard aan financieringen naar closing begeleid. Ter ondersteuning en uitbreiding van onze praktijk zijn we op zoek naar een juridisch medewerker en/of beginnend advocaat-stagiair. Als juridisch medewerker begin je in eerste instantie op fulltime basis, met de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar de functie van advocaat-stagiaire. title: Data Analyst (EN)
description: Help launch our new temping product and drive commercial impact! At YoungOnes, data is at the start of every decision. Our Data & RevOps team has a seat at every table and takes a leading role in where the company goes next. Two years ago we rebuilt our data environment in Databricks from scratch, and it is fully ready for the future. There are few better environments to work in. We are looking for a Data Analyst with a focus on product, who also supports our marketing and commercial teams with deeper analyses. Someone with experience who is ready to take responsibility, and who does not stop at a report but actively steers on the outcome. What will you do? Your main focus is product. Next to that, you support marketing and the commercial teams, which keeps your work varied. Product In the flexible work market, companies used to choose between temping (uitzenden) and freelancers. Since last year we have been bringing a new proposition to market that sits in between: non-service temping. It combines the legal certainty of temping with the flexibility and personal control of freelancing, all through our platform. This is an important step in our strategy towards one app for work. Take the lead in tracking the progress of this new proposition; Define the KPIs and funnel that show whether the proposition is working; Analyse the full journey of workers and clients, from onboarding to repeat shifts; Spot problems early and actively steer where you see them; Translate insights into concrete improvements together with product and development; Work in a select team that operates as a startup within the company. Commercial & marketing support Next to product, you are the analytical sparring partner for our commercial teams and marketing. You go beyond the standard reports and dive deeper when questions get complex. Deliver deeper analyses for the commercial teams, for example on client potential, retention and growth opportunities; Support marketing with insight into campaign results and ROAS. This role is diverse, but above all it gives you a lot of freedom to take initiative and make an impact. Your team You will join an effective Data & RevOps team with 3 Analysts, 2 Engineers, a Performance Manager and 2 Process aAnalysts. You report to the Head of Data. The data itself is interesting: we support a two sided marketplace with workers on one side and clients on the other. AI is built into the design of how we work and makes the technical side of your job more simple. We use Genie within Databricks, which fully understands our data environment, Claude to connect multiple systems, and Gemini for quick support on smaller tasks. What are we looking for? We are looking for someone who: Has at least 3 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst or Commercial Analyst; Has experience tracking and steering product performance, and/or with commercial or marketing analytics; Is strong in SQL and familiar with Python/PySpark and a visualisation tool such as Power BI or Amplitude; Has experience with Databricks, or is eager to work in it; Uses AI tooling naturally to work faster and smarter; Takes ownership and dares to make choices and influence stakeholders; Communicates clearly with both technical and non technical colleagues; Is already residing in the Netherlands and is allowed to work in the country and speaks fluent English (Dutch is a plus); We are not looking for someone who only delivers reports. We want someone who takes the lead, sees problems before others do and makes sure something is done about them. What do we offer? A gross salary between €4,300 and €6,100 based on full-time employment; 25 vacation days, 6.5 ADV days and 1 additional holiday per calendar year, based on a 40-hour workweek; 8% vacation pay, a pension plan, and (if you live more than 10 km from the office) a travel allowance; We prioritize mental well-being in collaboration with our partner OpenUp; Great perks such as: a yearly fitness budget, a freshly prepared healthy lunch every day, snacks, biweekly afternoon drinks, XL borrels every three months, sport tournaments, and much more; A leading role in a new proposition that is key to our strategy; One of the best data environments to work in, with Databricks and AI built in; A company that is truly data driven, where your insights shape decisions; A high level of autonomy, freedom and responsibility. YoungOnes is a place where you learn fast, build fast and see results fast. Ready to take the lead? Then we would love to hear from you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Data Analist (NL)
description: Bouw mee aan onze nieuwe propositie en maak commerciële impact! Bij YoungOnes staat data aan de wieg van elk besluit. Sinds afgelopen jaar zetten wij een propositie in de markt die daar tussenin zit: non-service uitzenden. De juridische zekerheid van uitzenden, met de flexibiliteit en eigen controle van freelancing via ons platform. Dit is een belangrijke stap in onze strategie naar one app for work. In de lead zijn bij het tracken van de voortgang van deze nieuwe propositie; De KPI's en funnel definiëren die laten zien of de propositie werkt; De volledige journey van workers en opdrachtgevers analyseren, van onboarding tot herhaalde shifts; Problemen vroeg signaleren en actief bijsturen waar jij ze ziet; Inzichten samen met product en development vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen; Werken in een select team dat functioneert als startup binnen het bedrijf. Commerciële & marketing ondersteuning Naast product ben jij de analytische sparringpartner voor onze commerciële teams en marketing. Je gaat verder dan de standaard reports en duikt de diepte in wanneer vragen complex worden. Diepere analyses leveren voor de commerciële teams, bijvoorbeeld op klant-potentie, retentie en groeikansen; Marketing ondersteunen met inzicht in campagneresultaten en ROAS. De data zelf is ook interessant: we ondersteunen een two-sided marketplace met workers aan de ene kant en opdrachtgevers aan de andere kant. AI zit in het ontwerp van hoe we werken en maakt de technische kant van je werk eenvoudiger. We werken met Genie binnen Databricks, dat onze data omgeving volledig snapt en kent, met Claude om meerdere systemen aan elkaar te koppelen en met Gemini voor snelle ondersteuning bij kleine taken. Wat zoeken we? We zoeken iemand die: Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring heeft als Data Analist, Product Analist of Commercial Analist; Ervaring heeft met het tracken en sturen van product performance, en/of met commerciële of marketing analytics; Sterk is in SQL en bekend is met Python/PySpark en een visualisatietool zoals Power BI of Amplitude; Ervaring heeft met Databricks, of daar graag mee aan de slag wil; AI tooling vanzelfsprekend inzet om sneller en slimmer te werken; Eigenaarschap pakt, keuzes durft te maken en stakeholders weet te beïnvloeden; Helder communiceert met zowel technische als niet technische collega's; Al in Nederland woont en hier mag werken. We zoeken geen profiel dat alleen reports oplevert. We zoeken iemand die de lead pakt, problemen eerder ziet dan anderen en zorgt dat er iets mee gebeurt. Wat bieden wij? Een bruto salaris tussen €4.300 en €6.100 op basis van een fulltime dienstverband; 25 vakantiedagen, 6,5 ADV-dagen en 1 extra feestdag per kalenderjaar, op basis van een 40-urige werkweek; 8% vakantiegeld, een pensioenregeling en (als je meer dan 10 km van het kantoor woont) een reiskostenvergoeding; We hechten veel waarde aan mentaal welzijn, in samenwerking met onze partner OpenUp; Geweldige extra's zoals: een jaarlijks fitnessbudget, elke dag een vers bereide gezonde lunch, snacks, tweewekelijkse borrels in de middag, XL-borrels om de drie maanden, sporttoernooien en nog veel meer; Een leidende rol in een nieuwe propositie die cruciaal is voor onze strategie; Een van de beste data omgevingen om in te werken, met Databricks en AI ingebouwd; Een bedrijf dat echt datagedreven is, waar jouw inzichten besluiten vormen; Veel autonomie, vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. description: Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it. Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing. We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics. Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale. Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation. You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows. WHAT YOU'LL DO Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain WHAT YOU'LL NEED 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflows Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainability Experience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutions Deep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional: Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2. Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions. In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud. WHY CATAPULT? We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life. We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance. Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness. We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better. Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do. All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Enterprise Solutions Consultant (New York, NY)
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline. - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path. - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate. - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps. - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - 8–15+ years of experience selling technical products to technical buyers - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles. - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room. - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working. - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria. - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve. - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles. NICE TO HAVES - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions. - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals. - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software. - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion. title: Senior Backend Developer
description: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end. We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all. Why this role exists Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries. The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now. This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it. What you will own Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket. The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent. The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current. Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms. The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns. The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team. Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built. How we work We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here. We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard. Your first year In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival. By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team. Who we are looking for You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load. You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache. You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies. You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end. You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong. You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises. You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over. English is your working language. German is a plus. What makes you stand out You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax. You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model. You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama. You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it. The team We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action. We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you. The facts Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith Pensum: 100% Start: As soon as possible Language: English; German a plus Process: A 20–30 minute screening call, an in-person interview in Zürich on your career so far, a focused technical interview with the team (where we may work through a real quinn problem together), and reference calls How to apply Apply with your CV and two short paragraphs: why this role, and why now. If you have something you shipped and are proud of, a system, a module or a write-up of a hard problem, include it. It tells us more than a CV does. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Software Test Engineer 80–100%
description: As our Software Test Engineer at machineMD in Bern, you’ll bring your engineering skills to a practical challenge: making complex systems easier to test. You’ll design and build test automation, connect tools and technologies, and explore how agentic workflows can improve the way we work. Our existing infrastructure gives you a starting point, with the freedom to extend it and introduce new approaches. You’ll work alongside developers, requirements engineers, and testers, taking responsibility for solutions from design to daily use. About machineMD We’re on a mission to radically improve the measurement of brain function through standardized, automated, quantitative exams. Our signature product, neos™, is the world’s first non-invasive neuro-ophthalmoscope for fast, automated assessment of eye movements and pupils. Founded at the University Hospital of Bern, Switzerland, we’ve grown into a startup of 25 engineers, clinicians, scientists, and specialists working side by side. We aim to bring the diagnostic quality of highly trained specialists into secondary and primary care settings everywhere. The Role You’ll help us understand how neos™ behaves when its components work together—and where they fail. You’ll design and build the test systems, agentic workflows, and tooling that make complex behaviour reproducible and failures easier to diagnose. You’ll work alongside developers and use the domain expertise and manual testing provided by requirements engineers and testers. Pragmatic Improvements – assess our current testing setup with the team, identify the biggest weaknesses, and tackle them step by step. Build on what works, try useful approaches, and let a broader test concept grow from the improvements you put into practice. Engineer the Next Generation of Test Automation – build intelligent, agent-powered systems that redefine how complex software is tested. Go beyond UI testing, architect autonomous workflows, experiment with cutting-edge AI technologies, and turn bold ideas into production-ready solutions. Own the test automation stack. Build, break, innovate. Test Infrastructure – build on and improve our physical and software-based test environments. Introduce tools and setups where they make testing more effective, and keep them documented so tests remain repeatable and usable by others. Coordination & Code Quality – work hands-on with developers to implement automation, coordinate contributions, and review the quality of test code. Connect individual improvements so our testing becomes more consistent and easier to extend over time. Verification & Validation – contribute to V&V plans, protocols, reports, and evidence, and coordinate activities with the relevant specialists. Help keep testing, requirements, and documentation aligned in a medical device environment. What We Look For Experience Solid practical experience in software engineering, including designing, implementing, debugging, and maintaining software. You can understand existing codebases and develop clear, well-structured solutions that others can maintain and extend. Experience with some of our core technologies (Python, C#/.NET, C++ and Flutter/Dart) is a plus. Python and pytest are particularly useful for test automation, and you’re willing to learn the technologies needed for the task. Practical experience developing automated tests across different system levels, with the programming skills to implement, understand, and review test code. Experience building or integrating agentic workflows is a plus. Experience with verification and validation of medical devices or familiarity with ISO 13485 is a plus. Qualifications Solid software testing fundamentals at ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent knowledge, including test planning, test design, and requirements coverage. Vocational training or a higher degree in computer science, software engineering, medical informatics, or a related technical field. Fluent English (minimum strong B2, ideally C1); German or French language skills are a plus for on-site collaboration. Eligibility to work in Switzerland (Swiss/EU/EFTA work permit). How You Work Systems Thinker – you want to understand how neos™ works as a whole, from its software and hardware to the tests and data behind it. You choose practical improvements as our product and testing continue to develop. Curiosity & a Detective’s Instinct – you notice when something doesn’t quite add up and enjoy following the clues. You question assumptions, explore unusual scenarios, and keep digging until you can explain and reproduce what you’ve found. Close the Gaps – you enjoy getting your hands dirty and following a problem across disciplines. When progress depends on something outside your usual remit, you’re willing to learn and lend a hand. Collaborative Spirit – you work closely with colleagues, share what you know and what you’re unsure about, and address difficult topics openly. You listen with curiosity, give and receive candid feedback, and make room for different perspectives. Shaper Mentality & Growth Mindset – you want to shape how testing works, take responsibility, and build missing skills quickly. You’re curious about neurodiagnostics and ready to learn from experts and real-world use cases. Working at machineMD Located in Bern, Switzerland, we thrive on collaborative, in-person energy, while offering the flexibility you need to do your best work. Available for roughly 80% of your time on-site in Bern and committed to our weekly anchor day on Monday. We are united by the Four Pillars of Integrity: Radical Responsibility, Feeling Our Feelings, Candor and Clear Agreements. These are not just words on a wall; they guide how we: Own our choices (Radical Responsibility) Name and honour our emotions (Feeling Our Feelings) Speak and listen with honesty (Candor) Make and keep clear commitments (Clear Agreements) Living these principles keeps us “whole”, fully alive, and brimming with the energy needed to build world-class diagnostic tools. Life’s too short to work on boring stuff. If you want to connect ideas, people, and technology to advance brain diagnostics at the frontlines in a dynamic startup environment, let’s talk! How to Apply Send your CV and a short note about a project or task from your career that you enjoyed a lot, and explain why. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, age, background, or orientation. Direct applications only. No recruiters, please. We’re excited to meet you! title: Staff Cloud Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.</span></p></div><p>Are you interested in pioneering and breaking new ground in large-scale financial data processing? Then this role might be for you. Join the Ripple Treasury Reconciliation team where you’ll be solving complex problems and having fun while passionately discussing (and arguing) with your team members!</p> <h1>About the Reconciliation team</h1> <p>Ripple Treasury Reconciliation platform sits at the heart of how the world's largest financial institutions and enterprises close their books and bring more control to their financial processes. Our vision is to create a completely new user experience with financial tools that have no equals on the market. With users first in mind and driven by technology.</p> <p>As part of Ripple, we're backed by the scale and ambition of a company reshaping global finance, giving our team the resources to modernize the mission-critical product while still moving with the speed and ownership of a smaller engineering group. If you want your code to directly touch how billions of transactions get reconciled every day, this is that kind of role. </p> <h1>What we are looking for</h1> <p>We are looking for a Staff Infrastructure Architect to own the infrastructure of our growing Reconciliation platform.<strong> </strong>You'll set the direction, architecture and design for our platform, focusing on performance, stability, security and how to integrate newer technologies. You will also be setting the technical direction and standards for our team while working alongside senior infrastructure engineers who own day-to-day execution and operational work.</p> <p>This is a hands-on architecture role, not a pure strategy or management position. You'll write core foundational code and build reference implementations, but the bulk of routine implementation work belongs to the team. Your value is in judgment: knowing where to invest based on business direction, designing for scalability and lower long-term maintenance burden, and raising the technical ceiling of the team.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Set and own infrastructure architecture direction. </strong>Drive architecture, scalability, and performance decisions across the platform. </li> <li><strong>Provide technical leadership and mentorship</strong> to senior infrastructure engineers by reviewing designs, unblocking hard problems, and playing a key role in deepening the team's expertise.</li> <li><strong>Establish infrastructure standards and patterns</strong> for the team to create a high benchline for quality, performance and maintenance of the system.</li> <li><strong>Stay hands-on</strong>: prototype, build critical-path components, and get into the code where it matters while routine implementation and day-to-day operational work is owned by the senior engineers.</li> <li><strong>Make and be accountable for infrastructure tradeoff decisions</strong> with long-term cost, scalability, or maintainability implications.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>8+ years of hands-on experience designing and owning large-scale distributed infrastructure, including a track record of owning architecture decisions yourself, with 4+ years serving as a technical lead and mentoring engineers.</li> <li>Deep expertise with AWS & Kubernetes. Minimum 5+ years experience with each.</li> <li>Expertise in Linux and Windows server environments, with strong experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure.</li> <li>Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and ArgoCD, and scripting languages including Bash and Python.</li> <li>Experience with data infrastructure and processing technologies such as Spark and MSSQL. Experience building the systems that power high-volume transactional workloads, ideally in finance space. Cybersecurity experience is a plus.</li> <li>A track record of building infrastructure that scales, stays available, and remains secure, using Agile practices to ship reliably.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You work openly and collaboratively with diverse teams, and you're energized by driving engineering excellence through better standards, processes, and shared knowledge.</li> <li>You welcome constructive feedback, actively inviting debate and rigorous discussion around your architectural ideas to deliver optimal outcomes.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><em>This role is architecture-led, not implementation-led — we're looking for someone who has owned and been accountable for infrastructure design decisions, not someone whose primary experience is executing infrastructure designed by others. This is also a technical leadership role, not a people-management position. </em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>WHO WE ARE:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Do Your Best Work</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Take Control of Your Finances</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Employee giving match</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Mobile phone stipend</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Take Care of Yourself</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">R&R days so you can rest and recharge</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Benefits listed above are for full-time employees. </em></span></p> <hr> <div><em>Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Customer Success Manager
description: monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition. About The Role As a Customer Success Manager, you are responsible for the business objectives your customers set to achieve through their AI transformation journey. This is not the SAAS CSM role we know. Rather than driving adoption and holding the relationship, you reverse-engineer the use cases a customer already runs on the platform and agentify them: you take an existing business process and drive it into the AI era, placing the right AI capabilities in the right places so humans and applied AI work together. You build beside the customer’s own team until the workflow runs. It requires a can-do mindset, strong business acumen backed by technical fluency. Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our Munich office. What You’ll Do Translate use cases: Inventory the use cases an account already runs and agentify them, placing the right AI capabilities in the right places so humans and agents work together. Diagnose workflows: Map where decisions get made and work moves forward, and turn it into a sequenced transformation plan with the customer’s executives and process owners. Build beside the customer: Run working sessions where the customer’s own team builds the workflow, and stay in the room until it runs. Route by account maturity: Use the account maturity audit and Path A readiness to decide what gets built beside the customer and what becomes a scoped engagement. Partner on services: Source engagements for Deployment Strategy with the business context established, and stay connected through delivery so every build lands back into the account plan. Forecast outcomes: Forecast credit burn against entitlement at business-unit level, and diagnose any shortfall: an unbuilt workflow, an unadopted one, or a process that never changed. Advise on governance: Own the permissioning, data boundaries, agent oversight, and approvals that move agents from pilot to production. Lead change with sponsors: Hold the relationships with the sponsors who drive change, tie every workflow to the outcome they need to show, and lead the operating-model shift that makes it stick. Prepare renewals: Evidence delivered outcomes on the T-120/90/60/30 cadence, and surface risk and expansion signals to the Account Owner early enough to act. How Success Is Measured The core success component is our ability to drive business outcomes for our customers through the different monday.com layers of operations. But when breaking it down to the actual day2day we can find : * Retention of all paid components: seats, AI credits, and services. * AI consumption growth: adoption of AI capabilities into new and existing use cases, measured as credit burn against entitlement across the account. * Growth in new AI capabilities usage that drives commercial growth. What We’re Looking For 3+ years of professional experience Experience in customer success, consulting, solutions, or a similar customer-facing role in SaaS, ideally with enterprise accounts. Ability to diagnose how a business process really runs and redesign it with AI and humans working together. Hands-on experience building workflows, automations, or AI agents, and comfort building alongside customers rather than only advising. Credibility with multiple business owners and executives, not only IT or platform owners. Strong commercial and analytical skills: tying usage to business outcomes, forecasting consumption against entitlement, and making a renewal case with evidence. Working knowledge of applied AI governance topics such as permissioning, data boundaries, platform automation, LLMs and agent oversight. Clear communication and the ability to lead change with sponsors across a customer organisation. Experience with high-paced operations and large enterprise customers is an advantage. description: Nous recherchons un.e stagiaire Assistant.e – Analyste éthique et positionnement (financements institutionnels et partenariats avec le secteur privé) / basé.e à Paris. La mission principale du stage est de venir en appui à l’équipe de l’Institut sur ses projets de recherche et d’analyse sur des sujets liés à l’actualité géopolitique, ainsi qu’à l’éthique des financements institutionnels et des partenariats avec le secteur privé. Le stage vise à développer une capacité d’analyse critique et de raisonnement éthique appliqué : comprendre les tensions entre principes et réalités opérationnelles, identifier les risques et les dilemmes et contribuer à l’élaboration de recommandations utiles à la décision. Activité 3 – Contribuer à la formation interne et aux relations externes de l’Institut - Participer à la préparation et à l’animation de séquences de formation et à la présentation de travaux de l’Institut auprès des équipes internes. Grosser unternehmerischer Gestaltungsspielraum bei kurzen Entscheidungswegen und flachen Hierarchien. Mittelfristige Perspektive auf eine unternehmerische Beteiligung. Treuer, breit abgestützter Kundenstamm. Eingespieltes Fachteam und partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit dem Verwaltungsrat.
