description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover. Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale. About the team Join the AI team at Prosus, a global technology group with businesses in food delivery, e-commerce, classifieds, travel and payments. We build LCM, the Large Commerce Model: our own foundation model, trained on billions of transactions and interactions from proprietary data across the portfolio. LCM already powers search, recommendations and marketing in production at iFood. We are extending it across our companies around the world and to businesses outside the group, while broadening its capabilities in agents and real-time prediction tasks. Your work will shape what LCM learns next and feed directly into products used by millions of people. About the role Evaluation is the core of everything we do. We build from the evals: we define how success will be measured before developing a capability, and use the results to guide training, model selection and deployment. We already have hundreds of evaluations spanning domain knowledge, commerce and gaming, with plans to expand their coverage, depth and scale. This work builds on ProLLM, the public benchmarking platform we ran for real-world use cases until our coding assistant benchmarks became saturated. Since then it has been a private benchmarking platform for Prosus companies. We plan to open it again to publish our commerce benchmarks, covering both agentic and decision-making tasks. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to own the development of these evaluations and the platform that runs them. The work involves defining meaningful tasks, curating evaluation data, implementing reliable scoring, investigating model behaviour and making results useful for research and product decisions. In our flat team of around 30 engineers, you’ll work directly with applied scientists, training engineers and domain experts. You’ll help teams contribute evaluations and build the infrastructure and automation needed to run them throughout model development. In the first three months, we expect you to take technical ownership of part of the evaluation platform, deliver a set of new or improved evaluations with curated data and calibrated difficulty, and work with scientists to use them in a training or release decision. What the role involves Design evaluations with scientists and domain experts, translating intended capabilities into representative tasks, datasets and success criteria. Cover current applications and capabilities we want future models to acquire. Curate evaluation data and calibrate task difficulty, so that evaluations are neither saturated nor out of reach and still separate models of different quality. Work with domain experts on sourcing, annotation and review, within data provenance, permitted use across companies and privacy requirements. Own the development and operation of the evaluation platform across training checkpoints, deployed models and external baselines. Support distributed execution, reproducible configurations, trace inspection and comparison of results, while managing runtime and cost. Develop programmatic checks, outcome-based scoring and LLM-based graders. Calibrate automated judgments against expert reviews, investigate disagreements and test whether graders reward superficial answers or reject valid solutions. Analyse model outputs and agent trajectories, including tool calls, environment state and task outcomes. Distinguish model failures from problems in the evaluation, quantify uncertainty and explain what changed between versions. Maintain versioned tasks, datasets, graders and environments, with protected held-out tests and contamination checks. Expand coverage as models improve, retaining useful regression tests and adding harder tasks where existing tests no longer distinguish performance. Prepare commerce benchmarks for public release on ProLLM, including public mirror sets and evaluation code, where the data can be shared. Integrate evaluations into training and release workflows, with dashboards and regression checks that support concrete decisions. Work with portfolio teams to establish whether offline improvements correspond to better outcomes in online experiments. Build tools and agents that help generate candidate tasks, run evaluations and investigate failures, validating their outputs before adoption. Review contributions and mentor engineers so teams can extend the suite consistently. Minimum qualifications At least five years of ML or software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on work building and evaluating ML systems. Experience owning evaluation frameworks, benchmarks or model-quality systems that informed training or deployment decisions. Strong Python and experience with PyTorch, Transformers or comparable ML libraries, alongside reliable production software development. Practical knowledge of experimental design and statistics, including sampling, uncertainty, repeated trials and comparisons across model versions. Experience running inference or evaluation workloads at scale and debugging failures across models, data, scoring code and infrastructure. Clear communication and the ability to turn ambiguous results into defensible recommendations. Preferred qualifications Experience with language-model training or post-training. Experience with agent or gaming environments. Experience with human evaluation, LLM-as-judge calibration, recommendation metrics or online experimentation. Contributions to evaluation frameworks, public benchmarks or research. What we offer Ownership of the evaluation platform and the evaluations that guide LCM’s research, training and deployment. Access to proprietary domain data, GPU infrastructure and external models for comparison. Direct collaboration with researchers, engineers and portfolio teams, with scope to publish methods and benchmarks, including through ProLLM, where the work can be shared. Colleagues who have released Hugging Face models with more than 100 million downloads, authored papers at NeurIPS, created benchmarks and built multiple production AI systems. Current ML frameworks and unlimited access to coding assistants. A base at our Amsterdam office and AI House, with relocation support. We also consider remote arrangements for candidates with particularly strong experience relevant to the role. Competitive compensation and a top-spec MacBook Pro. If you want to build the evaluations that shape what a foundation model learns, we’d like to hear from you. Please include examples of evaluations or platforms you have built, how you established that their results were reliable, and the decisions those results informed. Why Prosus? At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next. Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing. About the role We’re looking for experienced applied scientists in two tracks: pre-training, and post-training and continual learning. Each scientist will own a focused research direction within a track. The areas below describe the team’s research agenda; we are looking for depth in one or more of them. The role involves designing experiments, writing the code to run them, analysing results and developing training methods that other teams can use. Scientists own the research questions, training objectives and evidence needed to decide whether a change works, and work with ML engineers to turn successful experiments into reliable training runs. We are a team of around 30 engineers with a flat structure, working directly with portfolio companies to define problems, evaluate models and bring successful work into production. In the first three months, the expectation is to establish strong baselines in a chosen research area, develop and evaluate an improvement, and work with the relevant teams to test it in a downstream application. Track 1: Pre-training This track focuses on continued pre-training of open-weight models on commerce data, including how we represent that data, allocate training compute and transfer capabilities to smaller models. Research areas include: Studying scaling behaviour, data mixtures and compute allocation to decide what goes into the next training run. Developing mid-training methods, including data refinement, annealing schedules, context extension and alignment between text and semantic IDs for users, items and merchants. Designing training sequences from user histories, merchant catalogues and market data, and studying how representations transfer across companies, languages and commerce categories. Building synthetic data pipelines and measuring their contribution through controlled comparisons with real data. Distilling the base model into smaller models, including through on-policy distillation, and measuring the trade-offs between quality, inference cost and latency. Developing evaluations that help select pre-training runs and predict downstream performance, including checks for temporal leakage, generalisation to new users and items, and retention of existing capabilities. Tabular foundation models are a possible specialisation: pre-training and in-context learning on structured commerce data, using synthetic and real tables and comparing results with established tabular methods. Relevant experience includes continued pre-training or mid-training, data mixture research, scaling laws, tokenisation, entity representations, distillation, or tabular foundation models such as TabPFN and TabICL. Track 2: Post-training and continual learning This track focuses on adapting LCM to commerce tasks and learning from interactions after deployment. The goal is to turn signals from a continuous stream of billions of user sessions across the portfolio into regular updates to model weights, while retaining the capabilities the model has already learned. Research areas include: Developing post-training methods using supervised fine-tuning, preference optimisation such as DPO, and reinforcement learning with verifiable or learned rewards, including GRPO and PPO. Learning from session histories, searches, clicks, purchases, repeat orders and operator feedback. This includes data selection, credit assignment and reward design that account for exposure bias, delayed outcomes and the difference between observed engagement and incremental business value. Studying how to combine new interactions with historical data, how frequently to update models, when an update is ready for deployment, and how to preserve performance as user behaviour and catalogues change. Building RL environments with simulated users, catalogues and multi-step commerce tasks, including inspecting trajectories, validating rewards and testing whether improvements in simulation transfer to real interactions. Developing reward models and LLM-based graders, calibrating them against expert judgments and observed outcomes, and testing for reward hacking, sycophancy and excessive concentration on popular items. Training decision models for rankings, offers and promotions using contextual bandits or offline RL, with off-policy evaluation to estimate value and uncertainty, identify gaps in the available evidence and inform controlled online experiments. Developing automated experiments that propose and test changes to training methods, prompts, tools or agent control flow, evaluated on held-out tasks and regression tests before acceptance. Relevant experience includes language-model post-training, reinforcement learning, reward modelling, agent training environments, continual learning, or offline RL and bandits applied to real decisions. The training experience required will depend on the research direction. Responsibilities across both tracks Define success with portfolio teams and evaluate models against strong baselines, including existing production systems, accounting for inference cost, latency and the business outcome the model is meant to improve. Design reproducible experiments with appropriate ablations, uncertainty estimates and failure analysis, using future-period and held-out evaluations, and test whether offline improvements hold online. Work with data and engineering teams on provenance, permitted use across companies and privacy-aware handling of customer histories. Publish research and contribute models, benchmarks, environments and training methods to open source where the work and data can be shared. Mentor colleagues, review experiment designs and communicate findings clearly enough to support training and deployment decisions. Minimum qualifications A PhD or equivalent industry research experience in machine learning, computer science, statistics or a related field. At least five years of research or applied science experience in machine learning, including doctoral research, with hands-on experience designing and running model-training experiments. For Track 2, it should include language-model post-training, or reinforcement learning and decision-model training relevant to the specialisation. Evidence of original research through papers, released models, public benchmarks, open-source projects or significant research contributions to deployed systems. Strong Python and PyTorch skills, with experience implementing experiments and debugging training runs in a shared research codebase. Work on large language models requires hands-on experience with distributed training. Sound experimental judgment, including strong baselines, statistical analysis and the willingness to report negative results. Clear written and verbal communication. Preferred qualifications Experience implementing and debugging training methods in frameworks such as Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, NeMo RL, verl or OpenRLHF, depending on the chosen track. Research in recommender systems, generative retrieval, semantic IDs or user behaviour modelling. Experience with synthetic data, model distillation or compression for production. Experience working with marketplace or commerce data and evaluating changes through online experiments. We also develop continual learning methods that turn new interactions into regular updates to model weights. Work may include: Developing supervised fine-tuning, preference optimisation and reinforcement learning methods, using verifiable outcomes or learned reward models. Turning session histories, searches, clicks, purchases, repeat orders and operator feedback into training examples and rewards, accounting for exposure bias, delayed feedback and the difference between observed engagement and incremental business value. Studying data selection, replay and update frequency so models learn from new interactions without losing established capabilities. Training and evaluating decision models that choose rankings, offers and promotions, using offline learning and off-policy evaluation to estimate policy value and uncertainty and inform controlled online experiments. Training models for multi-turn conversations and multi-step agent workflows, including understanding user intent, planning, tool use, maintaining context, recovering from errors and verifying outcomes. This includes building RL environments with simulated users and catalogues, and testing whether gains transfer to real interactions within defined permissions and business rules. Calibrating reward models and LLM-based graders against expert judgments and observed outcomes, and investigating reward hacking and other unintended effects. Developing automated experimentation methods that propose and test changes to training recipes, prompts, tools or agent control flow, with held-out evaluations and regression checks. How we evaluate the work Research should produce evidence that supports a training or deployment decision. We use strong baselines, including existing production systems, and weigh model quality against compute requirements, inference cost and latency. Experiments should be reproducible, with ablations, uncertainty estimates and failure analysis. They must account for temporal leakage, changes in the data distribution and differences between companies and markets. Negative results are valuable when they explain a limitation or stop further investment in an approach that does not work. The work also involves data provenance, permitted use across companies and privacy-aware handling of customer histories, together with our data and engineering teams. In the first three months, we expect you to establish a focused research programme, resolve an important training or evaluation question, and work with the relevant teams to test the resulting method in a downstream application. Minimum qualifications A PhD or equivalent industry research experience in machine learning, computer science, statistics or a related field. At least eight years of research or applied science experience in machine learning, including doctoral research, with at least four years leading research directions that were published or reached production. Substantial experience developing and training models, with deep expertise in pre-training, post-training or reinforcement learning relevant to the areas above. A record of original contributions, shown through research papers, released models, benchmarks, open-source projects or significant advances in deployed systems. Scientific leadership: choosing research directions, resolving difficult technical questions and helping experienced colleagues make better decisions. Sound experimental and statistical judgment, including examples where the evidence changed your approach and the ability to recognise when the evidence does not support a conclusion. Strong Python and PyTorch skills and the ability to work independently in a shared research codebase. Research on large language models requires hands-on experience with distributed training. Clear communication and a collaborative approach to disagreement, review and mentoring. Preferred qualifications Experience with recommender systems, generative retrieval, semantic IDs, continual learning, synthetic data, distillation or tabular foundation models. Familiarity with commerce data and online experimentation. We do not expect expertise in every area. What we offer Influence over LCM’s research agenda and which questions the team invests in. title: Accountmanager E-commerce
description: Zie jij commerciële kansen waar anderen ze missen? Krijg je energie van het realiseren van online groei, het opbouwen van sterke klantrelaties en het ontwikkelen van succesvolle e-commerce strategieën? Dan is deze functie iets voor jou. Als Accountmanager E-commerce werk je binnen een innovatief familiebedrijf waar ondernemerschap, samenwerking en duurzame groei centraal staan. Maak het verschil als Accountmanager E-commerce Als Accountmanager E-commerce ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de online omzetgroei van Wijzonol. Je bouwt onze e-commerceactiviteiten verder uit en versterkt de samenwerking met online klanten en verkooppartners. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega’s van marketing, productmanagement en sales om commerciële kansen te signaleren én te benutten. Je ontwikkelt een online salesstrategie, vertaalt deze naar concrete acties en bewaakt de uitvoering. Daarnaast analyseer je prestaties en stuur je bij waar nodig om de online klantbeleving, zichtbaarheid en omzet verder te verbeteren. Kortom, jij bent succesvol in het: ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de online salesstrategie voor Wijzonol; opbouwen en onderhouden van duurzame relaties met online klanten en verkooppartners; signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en vertalen van commerciële kansen naar concrete acties; optimaliseren van assortiment, productinformatie en online content; analyseren van verkoopresultaten, online prestaties en klantgedrag; ontwikkelen en realiseren van promotie- en campagneplannen samen met interne en externe stakeholders. Als gedreven Accountmanager E-commerce kun jij rekenen op: Je komt terecht in een innovatieve en duurzame organisatie waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en samenwerking centraal staan. Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om de online groei van Wijzonol verder vorm te geven. Daarnaast werk je samen met betrokken collega’s binnen een informele organisatie met korte lijnen en volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop: salaris tot € 4.584,75 bruto per maand; Auto, laptop en telefoon van de zaak 8% vakantiegeld én 8% eindejaarsuitkering; 29 vakantiedagen + 11,5 adv-dagen; diverse trainings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden; personeelskorting op het assortiment. Voor deze vacature neem jij mee: Je bent commercieel sterk, analytisch ingesteld en denkt graag vooruit. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen strategie en uitvoering en weet verschillende stakeholders mee te nemen in jouw plannen. Daarnaast werk je gestructureerd, resultaatgericht en krijg je energie van het realiseren van zichtbare groei. Vink jij deze checklist ook af? afgeronde hbo-opleiding in commerciële richting, marketing of bedrijfskunde; ruimschoots ervaring binnen e-commerce en/of accountmanagement; affiniteit met de verf-, bouwmarkt- of doe-het-zelfbranche; sterk commercieel en analytisch inzicht; ervaring met online sales, contentoptimalisatie en digitale groeistrategieën; uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands. Jouw werkgebied Je standplaats is Zwolle, waar je nauw samenwerkt met collega’s van Marketing, Productmanagement en Sales. De locatie is uitstekend bereikbaar via de A28 en A50 en beschikt over ruime parkeermogelijkheden. Ook vanuit plaatsen als Kampen, Meppel, Deventer, Apeldoorn en Almere ben je snel op je werkplek. Werken bij Koninklijke Van Wijhe Verf Koninklijke Van Wijhe Verf is een innovatief familiebedrijf met een rijke historie en een duidelijke missie. title: Public Relations Associate, APJC
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location: Singapore</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is looking for a PR Specialist, APAC + Japan to assist the head of PR, Asia Pacific, in scaling our PR program internally and externally. In this role you’ll get to work with a wide range of Cloudflare executives across technical, legal/policy, marketing, and regional teams. The ideal candidate should have at least 3-5 years of regional tech PR experience, supporting and executing PR programs in Southeast Asia/Asia Pacific. You’ll be a key member of our award-winning in-house communications team, and will work with a wide range of executives and teams to support execution, develop messaging, and report results from concept to completion. You'll also help extend our story beyond earned media across APAC + Japan, using social listening to spot conversations and trends in the region, and posting approved content to amplify Cloudflare news and coverage on social channels.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Assist the Sr. PR Director, APAC + Japan in managing PR operations including editorial calendar, content, execution, reporting, and agency coordination</li> <li>Write press releases, blog posts, and other materials to support regional and local communications initiatives</li> <li>Help manage day-to-day execution for APAC PR programs </li> <li>Maintain strong media relationships across all types of media outlets, develop story ideas, and manage stories</li> <li>Organize media briefings, interviews, and PR-focused events</li> <li>Support and help manage key executive spokespeople</li> <li>Monitor social and online conversations about Cloudflare, competitors, and key industry topics across APAC + Japan, flagging trends, newsjacking opportunities, and emerging issues to the Sr. PR Director, APAC + Japan</li> <li>Track sentiment and share of voice in APAC + Japan around announcements, campaigns, and Internet events, and turn the findings into regular reports and insights for the comms team</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BA/BS in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations or Marketing preferred</li> <li>3-5 years’ experience in regional (APAC) tech PR, either in-house B2B or agency </li> <li>Ability to operate independently and as a team in “the trenches”—we’re a dynamic team and everyone pitches in to get the job done</li> <li>Excellent communication and writing skills </li> <li>Creative, hardworking, and flexible, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and changing environment</li> <li>Strong project management and attention to detail</li> <li>Ability to multitask, manage deadlines, and communicate priorities</li> <li>Ability to understand and operate in a highly technical environment</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Meltwater or similar social listening and media monitoring tools</li> <li>Familiarity with publishing and scheduling content on social platforms such as LinkedIn and X</li> <li>Ability to turn data into clear, practical insights and reports</li> <li>Curiosity about AI and how it's changing the Internet, plus comfort using AI tools in day-to-day work</li> <li>Japanese or another APAC language is a plus</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: RE/RS, Data Understanding - Foundations
description: About The Team The Data Understanding team is responsible for creating the high quality datasets and their quantized representation for OpenAI. This includes synthesizing data, building VQ representations, and processing, filtering, deduplication, quality control, and tokenization so it can be used effectively in big model training runs. About The Role We're looking to advance how OpenAI builds and understands pretraining data at scale. You'll treat data quality and curation as core research problems: developing new methods to select, combine, and transform data; creating datasets that improve model capabilities; and designing rigorous experiments to understand how data choices and interventions affect model learning and downstream behavior. You'll work closely with frontier models and web-scale data to build evidence for which approaches work and why, then translate successful research into scalable data processing pipelines We Expect You To Have a strong track record of new or improved ML ideas, through publications, projects, or applied research. Own and drive a research agenda, from choosing the right problems to carrying long-running work through to impact. Be excited by OpenAI’s empirical, collaborative approach to research. Nice To Have Thoughtfulness about AI’s impact, including privacy, provenance, and data quality. Experience building high-performance deep learning or large-scale data processing systems. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: <p>As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. </p> <p>In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. </p> <p>This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities and Duties</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.</li> <li>Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.</li> <li>Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.</li> <li>Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.</li> <li>Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.</li> <li>Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.</li> <li>Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.</li> <li>Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications and Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field</li> <li>Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts</li> <li>Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)</li> <li>Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level</li> <li>Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field</li> <li>Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on</li> <li>Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments</li> <li>EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools</li> <li>UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments</li> <li>Experience with datalinks and radio systems</li> <li>Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers</li> <li>German language skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible working hours</li> <li>Stock Options</li> <li>Generous holiday allowance</li> <li>Pension plan </li> <li>Extended social security package </li> <li>Enhanced maternity & paternity leave</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Auterion</strong></p> <p>We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.</p> <p>At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: AI Marketing Internship
description: Marketing Intern E-bikes are awesome. They’re also expensive. We started MyBikePlan 7 years ago to fix that. With 0% financing, we make the best e-bikes accessible to everyone, and we’ve become the easiest way to buy an e-bike in Switzerland. We’re motivated and we’re growing fast. Since 2025 we’ve been part of the JobRad Group , Europe’s leading bike leasing company. That gives us the backing to go international, and we’re already doing it. Your role You’ll support our entire marketing team and work across every stage of the funnel, from the first ad someone sees to the newsletter that brings them back. It’s the fastest way to learn how modern performance marketing works from end to end. Paid ads Create ad creatives for Meta (Canva, AI tools) Help manage campaigns: set up, test, monitor and optimise Create print supports for our OOH campaigns (Adobe) Organic social Create content for Instagram, TikTok and more (CapCut, Canva) Support video shoots and community management Ambassadors & partnerships Help manage our ambassador network: outreach, briefings, content coordination CRM & newsletter Write, build and send newsletters Help with email automation and customer journeys Events Support planning and running events AI in our marketing AI is part of our daily workflow, and we expect you to use it from day one. Right now we use it to: Generate and test ad variations at scale (copy, images, short video) Speed up content production, from scripts and captions to first drafts of visuals Translate and adapt content for German, French and Italian Analyse campaign performance and find insights faster Draft newsletters, briefings and ambassador communication You don’t need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to test new tools. You also need the judgement to know when AI output is good and when it isn’t. What you bring Culture fit comes first. We don’t talk about what we could do. We just do it. A strong eye for visuals: you know what looks good, what’s trending and what’s not You know your way around current social media trends and formats Confident with Canva at minimum (Adobe and CapCut are a plus) Hands-on experience with AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, image or video generators), or the motivation to get it fast An interest in numbers: you want to know why an ad works, not just whether it looks good Languages: English and German are mandatory. What we offer A dynamic team in the heart of Zürich Exposure to the full marketing funnel: paid, organic, CRM, ambassadors and events A huge learning curve and real responsibility from day one Hands-on work with the latest AI marketing tools Flexible working Discounts on bikes Free coffee Access to a Felfel machine 6-12 month internship with the option of a long-term contract afterwards Ready to ride? title: Stage Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
description: Wil jij ervaren hoe het is om AI niet alleen technisch te begrijpen, maar ook écht werkend te maken binnen een organisatie? Heb jij interesse in AI, data, technologie én consultancy? Dan is deze stage binnen ons Data & AI-team misschien wel jouw volgende stap! Vanaf februari 2027 zoeken wij een stagiair(e) Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Data Science die gedurende 3 tot 12 maanden meewerkt aan interne AI-initiatieven binnen IG&H. Met deze stage krijg je de kans om jouw technische vaardigheden te combineren met consultancyvaardigheden: van het bouwen of onderzoeken van AI-oplossingen tot het ophalen van behoeften bij stakeholders en het ondersteunen van AI-adoptie binnen onze organisatie. Wat ga je doen? Tijdens deze leerzame stage ga je aan de slag met interne AI-oplossingen en innovatieprojecten. Afhankelijk van de behoefte vanuit de business werk je zelfstandig aan projecten binnen het team. Je kunt bijvoorbeeld bijdragen aan: het ontwikkelen of verbeteren van AI-tools die interne processen efficiënter maken; het in kaart brengen van processen binnen interne teams en onderzoeken waar AI kan helpen/ondersteunen; het ondersteunen van AI-adoptie binnen IG&H, bijvoorbeeld door mee te denken over trainingen, communicatie of praktische toepassingen van tools zoals Copilot; het doen van onderzoek naar nieuwe AI-producten, toepassingen of proposities; het vertalen van technische mogelijkheden naar concrete businesswaarde; samenwerken met andere collega’s binnen Data & AI. Over het team Wij helpen onze klanten innoveren en gebruikmaken van de nieuwste data- en AI-technologie. Ons Data & AI-team bestaat uit ruim 40 data-experts, waaronder Data Scientists, Data Engineers en Consultants. Samen realiseren zij innovatieve data-, analytics- en AI-oplossingen voor klanten in Retail, Financial Services en Health. Het team groeit snel en heeft de ambitie om verder uit te bouwen tot een van de meest toonaangevende Data & AI-praktijken van Nederland. Die groei komt voort uit ons succes: klanten kiezen steeds vaker voor IG&H vanwege onze combinatie van strategisch inzicht, technische expertise en pragmatische executie. We werken aan projecten die direct bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming, efficiëntere processen en nieuwe businessmodellen. Voor professionals die impact willen maken is dit een omgeving waar ondernemerschap, innovatie en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan. Hier bouw je niet alleen mee aan de toekomst van onze klanten, maar ook aan de verdere groei van het Data & AI-team zelf. Wat wij verwachten van jou: We zoeken een leergierig en analytisch sterk persoon die energie krijgt van AI, data science en consultancy. Je vindt het leuk om technologie te begrijpen, maar minstens zo belangrijk: je wilt ontdekken hoe je technologie toepasbaar maakt voor mensen en organisaties. Je brengt mee: Je volgt bij voorkeur een masteropleiding in de richting van Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Econometrie, Natuurkunde, Wiskunde, Engineering of een vergelijkbare technische/kwantitatieve studie; Je hebt ervaring met Python; Je vindt het leuk om met stakeholders in gesprek te gaan en behoeften goed uit te vragen; Je kunt technische onderwerpen helder uitleggen aan mensen met verschillende achtergronden; Je bent sociaal, nieuwsgierig en proactief; Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands en Engels; Je bent vanaf februari 2027 beschikbaar voor 32 tot 40 uur per week. Ervaring met SQL, API’s, Azure of AI-tools zoals Copilot is mooi meegenomen, maar geen harde eis. Belangrijker vinden we dat je nieuwsgierig bent, snel leert en zin hebt om jezelf inhoudelijk te ontwikkelen. Wat wij jou bieden: Bij IG&H krijg je de kans om in korte tijd veel te leren binnen een ambitieus en betrokken Data & AI-team. Je werkt aan een eigen project, krijgt goede begeleiding en maakt kennis met de praktijk van consultancy en technologie. Verder bieden wij jou: Een stage binnen een Great Place to Work met een prettige sfeer en enthousiaste collega’s; De kans om mee te werken aan concrete AI-initiatieven binnen IG&H; Je werkt samen met ervaren collega’s binnen het Data & AI-team; Begeleiding door een buddy en mentor vanuit de organisatie; Veel ruimte om jouw technische én consultancyvaardigheden te ontwikkelen; Een inspirerend kantoor in Utrecht; De mogelijkheid om na enige tijd in overleg deels thuis te werken; Teamactiviteiten, borrels en een open, ondernemende werksfeer; Een contract van 3 tot 12 maanden en een vergoeding tussen de € 700 en € 900,- bruto per maand. Waarom IG&H? Met meer dan 650 getalenteerde collega’s hebben we een unieke cultuur gecreëerd die zowel high caring als high daring is. We dagen elkaar uit om grenzen te verleggen, maar doen dat altijd vanuit vertrouwen, samenwerking en plezier. Als deze stage bij je past, dan is IG&H een mooie plek om je verder te ontwikkelen. Je krijgt de kans om veel te leren in korte tijd, je eigen ideeën in te brengen en te ontdekken hoe het is om te werken binnen een consultancy- en technologieorganisatie waar AI volop in beweging is. Je werkt direct mee aan onderwerpen die relevant zijn voor de toekomst van IG&H en onze klanten. Ben jij enthousiast geworden over deze stage binnen ons Data & AI-team? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met ons recruitmentteam via We willen dat onze medewerkers een afspiegeling zijn van de diversiteit in de samenleving. We werken samen met een opmerkelijke mix van talenten, persoonlijkheden en culturen. IG&H is trots een werkgever te zijn die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in overweging genomen voor een stage of dienstverband, ongeacht nationaliteit, ras, religie, geslacht, genderidentiteit of -expressie, seksuele geaardheid, genetica, handicap of leeftijd. We geven om individualiteit, maar het belangrijkste is dat we trots zijn op onze collectieve prestaties en een Great Place to Work. title: Senior Software Engineer, Network On-Ramps
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Locations: Austin TX, Champaign IL, Lisbon Portugal, London England</strong></p> <p><strong>About The Team:</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is redefining the way networks are run at scale. Our Network Services product suite puts the connectivity, scale, and performance of Cloudflare’s global network in front of customers’ network infrastructure and private networks, providing a single pane of glass for network connectivity, visibility, and operating network functions like BGP, WAN optimization, and more. We are a team of engineers and product managers who obsess over quickly building products that solve real customer problems using innovative technologies and techniques which leverage Cloudflare’s unique architecture and global network footprint.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We are hiring engineers of all experience levels on our teams. Some of the things our teams work on include:</p> <ul> <li>An anycast BGP implementation that sustains sessions that are moved across servers and regions</li> <li>Flow and log collection, correlation, and analytics systems to provide customers with unparalleled visibility into their own networks</li> <li>A Linux kernel-based networking dataplane which ingests and forwards traffic from some of the largest networks in the world</li> <li>Control plane systems which allow customers to simply express complex network configurations</li> </ul> <p>As a Software Engineer on our team, you will work across a wide range of technologies and systems to deliver new features, improve performance, and increase the scalability of our Network Services products. You’ll build, deploy, and operate our team’s systems on top of one of the largest edge networks in the world. You’ll partner with some of the best engineers and product managers to solve big problems that have a meaningful impact in the lives of our customers and users.</p> <p>We’re looking for curious, empathetic engineers who are excited to join us in changing the way networking is done!</p> <h3>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, and experience</h3> <ul> <li>Experience building and shipping large-scale, reliable, highly distributed systems</li> <li>Systems-level programming experience, especially in Go and Rust</li> <li>Expertise in L3 and L4 networking protocols</li> <li>Experience building on top of Linux kernel networking primitives – netfilter, nftables, eBPF, tc, network namespaces, etc</li> <li>Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs and backend systems</li> <li>Experience with large-scale distributed data pipelines, from data structuring to efficient querying to data analysis</li> <li>Excellent debugging and optimization skills</li> <li>Attention to detail and ability to solve complex customer problems</li> <li>Own solutions end-to-end and driving the design, development, and deployment process</li> <li>Able to work across teams and level common, sustainable solutions</li> <li>Creative, open-minded, collaborative problem solver</li> <li>Focus on clarity in written and verbal communication</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0">Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,1,0">For Champaign IL based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - title: System Engineer - Network Systems
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Cloudflare's Network Engineering Team builds and runs the infrastructure that runs our software. The Engineering Team is split into two groups: one handles product development and the other handles operations. Product development covers both new features and functionality and scaling our existing software to meet the challenges of a massively growing customer base. The operations team handles one of the world's largest networks with data centers in 190 cities worldwide and a couple of large specialized data centers for internal needs.</p> <p>About the role</p> <p>Cloudflare operates a large global network spanning hundreds of cities (data centers). You will join a team of talented network automation engineers who are building software solutions to improve network resilience and reduce engineering operational toil.</p> <p>You will work on a range of tools, infrastructure and services - new and existing - with an aim to elegantly and efficiently solve problems and deliver practical, maintainable and scalable solutions. Leverage AI tools and automated assistants to streamline daily workflows.</p> <p>Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience</p> <ul> <li> <p>BA/BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience</p> </li> <li> <p>3+ years of proven experience in developing software components for network automation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Understanding of software development principles, design patterns, and various programming languages (like python and golang)</p> </li> <li> <p>Proficient with modern Unix/Linux operating systems/distributions</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience in MySQL, Postgres, Clickhouse  (or equivalent SQL language)</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with CI/CD, containers and/or virtualization</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with Observability systems like prometheus, grafana (or equivalents)</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated experience working alongside AI assistants or automated tools to augment task execution and project delivery</p> </li> </ul> <p>Bonus Points:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Knowledge of Networking engineering, with competencies in Layer 2 and Layer 3 protocols and vendor equipment: Cisco, Juniper, etc.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building and maintaining large distributed systems</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing internal and/or external customer requirements and expectations</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €45,000-62,000. </span></li> </ul> <div class="cell word-wrap"> </div> <p> </p> <p> </p> <div class="cell word-wrap"> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. title: Security Research Analyst, WAF Managed Rules
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX; San Francisco, CA; New York City </p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>Our team researches web application attacks and turns that research into protections in Cloudflare’s Web Application Firewall (WAF). We build and maintain managed rules that help protect millions of Internet properties from known vulnerabilities, emerging exploits, and new attack techniques.</p> <p>We work at the intersection of vulnerability research, large-scale traffic analysis, and detection engineering. Using threat intelligence and telemetry from Cloudflare’s global network, we identify exploitation patterns, develop mitigations, and measure how well they work against real traffic. We partner with Engineering, Product, and customer-facing teams to improve coverage while minimizing false positives and disruption to legitimate applications.</p> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <ul> <li>You have hands-on experience in web application security, vulnerability research, or detection engineering, including writing and improving WAF rules, exploit signatures, or comparable detection logic.</li> <li>You understand HTTP/HTTPS, how web applications and proxies process requests, and common vulnerability classes such as SQL injection, cross-site scripting, remote code execution, SSRF, and insecure deserialization.</li> <li>You can analyze a vulnerability advisory or proof of concept, reproduce the exploit in a controlled environment, and identify the request characteristics that distinguish exploitation from legitimate traffic.</li> <li>You use SQL to investigate large datasets and a language such as Python, Go, or Rust to build research tools, automate analysis, and validate detections.</li> <li>You make evidence-based tradeoffs between detection coverage, false positives, and performance. You are comfortable investigating ambiguous reports and following issues through to resolution.</li> <li>You work effectively with engineers, product partners, and customer-facing teams, and communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>You use AI fluently in research and coding workflows and have the judgment to know where it accelerates the work and where its outputs need independent validation.</li> <li>You are curious about how attackers exploit web applications and bypass defenses. You do not need to know our exact stack, but you should be eager to go deep in the domain.</li> </ul> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p>We are looking for a Security Research Analyst to research web application threats and develop the managed rules that protect Cloudflare customers. You will turn public CVEs, threat intelligence, customer reports, and internal telemetry into tested, effective mitigations.</p> <p>Your work will span the detection lifecycle: understanding an exploit, designing a rule, validating it against malicious and legitimate requests, and measuring its behavior in production. You will collaborate with engineering and research partners to close coverage gaps and continuously improve the quality of our WAF protections.</p> <h3>Key responsibilities:</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Research vulnerabilities and exploitation.</strong> Analyze public CVEs, proof-of-concept exploits, and observed attacks to understand root causes, exploit chains, and opportunities for WAF mitigation.</li> <li><strong>Develop and maintain managed rules.</strong> Design, test, and deploy WAF managed rules and exploit signatures, keeping protections effective as applications, exploits, and attacker techniques evolve.</li> <li><strong>Investigate false positives and missed attacks.</strong> Analyze customer reports and request telemetry, reproduce issues, and refine detections to improve protection without unnecessarily blocking legitimate traffic.</li> <li><strong>Validate coverage and resistance to bypasses.</strong> Use targeted penetration testing, exploit variants, and adversarial testing to identify detection gaps and evaluate proposed mitigations.</li> <li><strong>Automate research and validation.</strong> Build tools and reproducible test cases that accelerate exploit analysis, rule validation, regression testing, and traffic analysis.</li> <li><strong>Measure detection quality.</strong> Use SQL, dashboards, and production data to assess rule efficacy, track attack trends, and guide improvements to coverage, false-positive rates, and performance.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate across teams.</strong> Partner with Engineering, Product, and other detection teams to deliver reliable protections and resolve recurring customer problems at their roots.</li> <li><strong>Share actionable research.</strong> Document findings, explain mitigation decisions, and contribute to internal research reports and public-facing blogs on vulnerabilities and Internet-wide attack trends.</li> </ul> <h3>Additional Experience We Value</h3> <ul> <li>Experience developing WAF rules or contributing to open-source WAF projects, such as ModSecurity or the OWASP Core Rule Set.</li> <li>Experience finding WAF bypasses, analyzing request parsing and encoding differences, or researching novel exploitation techniques.</li> <li>Experience with large-scale security analytics, advanced SQL, columnar databases such as ClickHouse, and visualization tools such as Grafana.</li> <li>Experience building automated exploit-reproduction environments, detection test suites, or CI pipelines for security rules.</li> <li>Familiarity with Linux/UNIX systems, TCP/IP networking, reverse proxies, and the performance constraints of inspecting production traffic.</li> <li>Published security research, conference presentations, open-source security tools, or demonstrated work through bug bounty programs or CTFs.</li> <li>Experience partnering with data science or machine learning teams to combine rule-based detections with other security signals.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $157,000 - $216,000</li> <li>For New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $206,000</li> </ul> <h4><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h4> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="4">Cloudflare offers a complete title: Hypotheekadviseur
description: Je eigen klantenportefeuille opbouwen, onafhankelijk adviseren en de vrijheid krijgen om jouw vak op jouw manier uit te oefenen. Voor een financieel dienstverlener in Zuid-Limburg zoekt Bommel Uitzendbureau een ervaren hypotheekadviseur die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt. Je helpt klanten bij belangrijke financiële keuzes: van hun eerste woning tot een complexere financiering. Daarbij kijk je verder dan de hypotheekaanvraag. title: Senior Data Collection Operator (FR)
description: About Genesis We are a full-stack general-purpose robot company, born across San Francisco, London and Paris and bound by a single mission: to make general-purpose robots a reality, unlocking infinite physical labor for the world and freeing people for creativity, exploration and the pursuits they love for their own sake. We're building the engine that will teach robots to do real work in the real world. We recently unveiled Eno, our wheeled, dexterous robot powered by our GENE foundation model and we are starting to put it to work with real customers. The role General-purpose robots learn from real, dexterous human work, the kind of data that does not exist on the internet. We capture it with our own collection hardware: a person wears it, does the work, and the robot learns to do it too. You will be a senior member of the team scaling our data collection operation in Paris, working closely with our Paris research and engineering teams and with the operation in the Bay Area. You will help lead the day-to-day execution and quality bar on the Paris floor while remaining deeply hands-on with data collection, teleoperation, task setup, and real-robot testing. You will wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and take ownership of complex collection requests from setup through execution and quality review. You will work shoulder to shoulder with our model engineering and research teams, turning their requests into physical demonstrations and feeding what you learn on the floor back to them. You will be expected to operate autonomously, help guide and train other operators and contribute to how the Paris operation evolves as the team grows. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will not just run existing tasks: you will help shape how they are executed, how quality is measured, and how other operators are trained to deliver consistently. What you will do Help lead the Paris data collection floor. Set the execution and quality bar for day-to-day collection work and help the team scale effectively. Own complex collection setups. Take a loosely defined request and turn it into a working, repeatable collection task, including the setup, fixtures, props, environment, and procedure, with minimal support from engineering. Create high-quality training data. Wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and produce precise demonstrations that can be used to train our models. Own the full collection workflow. Go beyond collecting the data itself: review and quality-check your work, identify unusable episodes, support annotation, and help ensure that what reaches research is trainable data. Build repeatable tasks. Turn new collection requests into clear, repeatable processes that can be executed consistently by other operators. Partner with research and model engineering. Translate their requests into physical collection tasks, share observations from the floor, and iterate with them on setups and collection strategy. Improve the operation. Identify when a fixture, station layout, procedure, or collection method can be improved and proactively help implement those improvements. Write and improve the playbook. Own SOPs, quality checks, and training materials that allow the Paris operation to scale while maintaining a consistent quality bar. Guide other operators. Help onboard, train, and mentor operators and reinforce consistent execution across the team. Run real-robot testing. Partner with reliability and engineering teams to test robots on the floor, document what you observe, and help surface issues. Own quality. Review your own work and the team's, take direct feedback, and keep raising the bar. What we are looking for You have done precise, repetitive physical work to a high quality bar and can explain what made your work good and how you measured it. This could include data collection, teleoperation, motion capture, robotics lab work, assembly, fine craft, or another hands-on technical environment. Hands-on robot or glove-based data collection experience is a strong plus, but not a requirement. This kind of data collection is new, and we will teach you our specific tools and approach. You build, not just run. Give you a vague request and a scrappy setup, and you can turn it into a clean, repeatable task with the right fixtures, environment, process, and written procedure. You can operate autonomously. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex collection tasks with limited day-to-day support from engineering. You understand quality beyond collection. You can review your work, recognize when collected data is unusable or below the quality bar, and understand why. You are ready to lead. You have trained, mentored, or led others doing hands-on work and want to help establish the execution and quality standard for a growing team. You work well with research and engineering teams. You can translate their requests into physical collection tasks and turn what you observe during collection into useful feedback. You have exceptional attention to detail. You notice the moment something about the setup, hardware, environment, procedure, or collected data is off. You are technically handy. You are comfortable with Linux, some Python scripting to automate repetitive work, and hardware assembly and troubleshooting. You are comfortable in a fast-moving environment. Hardware, processes, and collection methods will evolve quickly, and you are comfortable adapting while helping improve how the team works. You communicate well in English. You will work daily with teams in Paris and the Bay Area across time zones. French is a plus. Bonus: reliability testing. You have partnered with a reliability or test team on real-robot testing. Working conditions and role constraints Work takes place in production environments and technical laboratories. Prolonged standing and repetitive hand and arm movements while wearing collection equipment, including gloves, head-mounted cameras, and headsets, for extended periods. Handling and lifting of loads, including props, fixtures, robot equipment, and station equipment, up to 23 kg for station setup and reconfiguration. Why this role Real ownership. You will have meaningful ownership over how the Paris data collection floor operates and help set the standard the team grows toward. Hands-on leadership. You will remain close to the work while helping guide other operators, improve execution, and raise the quality bar. Build, not just execute. You will take ambiguous collection needs and turn them into reliable, repeatable tasks that can scale across the team. A clear growth path. As the operation scales, this role can grow toward leading or supervising teams of operators or toward broader project and program management responsibilities. The front line of the mission. The data you create, review, and improve is what teaches our robots to work. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
