title: Senior HR Adviseur
description: Maak impact op HR, organisatie en medewerkers Wil jij als Senior HR Advisor complexe HR-vraagstukken vertalen naar praktisch en toekomstgericht HR-beleid? En krijg je energie van adviseren, verbeteren én zelf de handen uit de mouwen steken? Bij Priva werk je nauw samen met onze HR Business Partners, HR Director en HR Operations-collega's. Je bent een ervaren sparringpartner voor het HR-team en de business en draagt bij aan complexe HR-casuïstiek, organisatieontwikkeling en strategische HR-projecten. Je combineert een brede HR-expertise met een praktische aanpak. Van arbeidsrecht en verzuim tot HR-processen, beleid, data en systemen: jij weet wat er nodig is om onze HR-dienstverlening continu te verbeteren. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior HR Advisor : adviseer je over complexe HR-vraagstukken, arbeidsrecht, verzuim, arbeidsvoorwaarden en organisatieveranderingen; ondersteun je HR Business Partners en management bij individuele en collectieve HR-casuïstiek; draag je bij aan strategische HR-projecten rondom onder andere cultuur, organisatieontwikkeling, transformatie en HR-beleid; vertaal je HR-strategie en wet- en regelgeving naar duidelijke en werkbare processen en oplossingen; werk je samen met HR Operations aan een professionele en efficiënte HR-dienstverlening; analyseer en verbeter je HR-processen en systemen; zet je HR-data en technologie in om betere beslissingen en procesverbeteringen mogelijk te maken; werk je actief met HR-systemen zoals AFAS en kijk je verder dan alleen de gebruikerskant om processen slimmer in te richten. Wie ben jij? Je bent een ervaren HR-professional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie, advies en uitvoering. Je hebt een stevige inhoudelijke HR-basis, maar kijkt tegelijkertijd verder: waar kunnen processen beter, welke impact heeft een verandering op de organisatie en wat hebben managers en medewerkers nodig? Je bent kritisch wanneer dat nodig is, praktisch wanneer het kan en weet verschillende stakeholders mee te nemen in veranderingen. Daarnaast breng je mee: een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld HRM, Human Resource Management, Bedrijfskunde of Arbeidsrecht; circa 2 tot 6 jaar relevante HR-ervaring, bijvoorbeeld als Senior HR Advisor, HR Adviseur of in een vergelijkbare brede HR-rol; gedegen kennis van het Nederlandse arbeidsrecht en sociale wetgeving; ervaring met complexe HR-casuïstiek, zoals verzuim, reorganisaties en arbeidsvoorwaarden; ervaring met strategische HR-projecten, beleidsontwikkeling of organisatieverandering; het vermogen om strategisch te adviseren én betrokken te blijven bij de operationele HR-praktijk; affiniteit met HR-technologie, HR-data, AFAS en procesoptimalisatie; uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal; beschikbaarheid van 32 tot 40 uur per week. Wat bieden wij? In cijfers: Een bruto salaris tussen €4.000,00 en €5.000,00 o.b.v. 40 uur per week (op basis van je ervaring); Een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé vinden wij belangrijk: 30 vakantiedagen per jaar en de mogelijkheid om meer bij te kopen; 8% vakantiegeld; Voor je eigen duurzaamheid: Maak gratis en onbeperkt gebruik van onze eigen sportruimte "The Box" op de Priva Campus, met diverse lessen in bijvoorbeeld CrossFit, Pilates en Spinning; Deelname aan de pensioenregeling van Priva; Opleidingsmogelijkheden via onze eigen Priva Academy. Klaar om jouw HR-expertise in te zetten én écht invloed te hebben op hoe we HR binnen Priva verder ontwikkelen? Breng je strategische blik, praktische aanpak en verbetermentaliteit mee en bouw samen met ons aan een HR-organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst. Solliciteer als Senior HR Advisor en maak het verschil vanaf dag één. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Interim Senior Consultant Strategy & Transformation
description: Freelance | Hybrid, Netherlands | Interim, immediate start Riverflex supports technology leaders at major organisations, and we're looking for an experienced Senior Consultant to join us on an interim basis. You'll work within a Riverflex team, alongside our in-house consultants and reporting into a Riverflex project lead. The client will know you as part of the Riverflex team, not as a standalone contractor. Current opportunity A leading European retailer is merging its regional technology departments. You'll work with the leadership team that reports to the CTO to shape, document and drive the convergence plan. That includes team changes, the case for funding and how the plan is communicated across the organisation. We're looking for a strong communicator with a top-tier consulting background. You'll pull ideas out of senior people's heads, structure them and turn them into a clear story. You also need to challenge the thinking so the message gets sharper. This is a strategy and storytelling role, not project management. About Riverflex Riverflex was founded in Amsterdam and London in 2018 and is now a global team of consultants helping courageous leaders drive intelligent transformation. We work across three pillars: strategy and transformation consulting, talent services, and AI products. www.riverflex.com What you'll do You'll own a clear workstream within the wider Riverflex project, working daily with the project lead and the team and reporting on progress several times a week. You'll interview senior stakeholders and turn what you hear into a structured plan, a narrative and executive-ready materials. You'll run workshops that help client leaders agree on decisions, priorities and next steps. You'll challenge client thinking constructively, asking “what do you mean by that?” and “have you considered X?” so the final message holds up. You'll build storylines and slide decks for different audiences, from C-suite updates to communications for project teams. You'll re-plan quickly when priorities shift, and add value from week one. You'll uphold Riverflex's quality standards: your work is reviewed and joined into the wider team's deliverables before it reaches the client. Job requirements 5-7 years' experience, including strategy or technology consulting at an MBB or Big 4 firm, Accenture or similar Excellent PowerPoint and storytelling skills: you can turn complex, unstructured input into a sharp storyline Experience running workshops and stakeholder interviews Business change or change communications experience A collaborative, low-ego style, and comfortable working within a team and reporting into a project lead Available immediately; based in the Netherlands and able to be on site in Amsterdam around two days a week Fluent English and the right to work in the EU Nice to have Experience with a post-merger integration or a reorganisation of technology teams Experience designing or running communications programmes Comfort using AI-enabled ways of working Why this role You'll do senior-level strategy work for a technology leadership team, with real input into the thinking from day one and the support of a Riverflex team around you. We have several engagements in progress, so strong delivery can lead to further interim work, and we're open to talking about permanent roles for the right people. Apply now Send us your CV and a short note on your most relevant experience, through Recruitee or by contacting our talent team. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to share three or more anonymised slide decks they created themselves before the interview. Riverflex is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on any protected characteristic. If you don't meet every requirement but are excited about the role, we'd still love to hear from you. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Inside Sales Representative
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way. Team Our Growth team is a transversal entity aiming to maximize and deliver the potential of any mobile product. It combines user acquisition, creative content production, monetization, and the tech capabilities required to turn applications into global hits. With over 150 experts, we operate at the forefront of mobile marketing and ad tech. Today, our Creative team makes 10K+ ads a month, mostly by hand. We are rebuilding that process with AI to multiply both our output and our hit rate. The challenge is to produce at massive scale, with quality that holds up. Design and implement AI workflows: build pipelines that automate variations and repetitive production steps, and roll them out so the whole team can ship more, faster. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Warum wir tun, was wir tun Unsere Psyche ist das Fenster, durch das wir die Welt sehen – mal grau, mal hell. Wer lernt, dieses Fenster zu verstehen, kann jeden Tag eine neue Perspektive gewinnen. Aus psychischen Herausforderungen können Chancen zum Wachsen werden. Und weil Glück ansteckend ist, verändert sich so die Gesellschaft: one mind at a time. Warum es diese Rolle braucht Immer mehr Arbeitgebende und Versicherungen machen Aepsy für ihre Mitarbeitenden zugänglich – vom KMU bis zum Grossunternehmen. So erhalten mehr Menschen frühzeitig Zugang zu passender psychologischer Unterstützung. Doch ein Angebot allein reicht nicht. Mitarbeitende müssen Aepsy kennen, verstehen und ihm vertrauen. Sie müssen wissen, wie sie das Angebot nutzen können, wenn sie Unterstützung brauchen. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Partnerschaften echte Wirkung entsteht. Dafür entwickelst du Aktivierungsmassnahmen, koordinierst Projekte und arbeitest eng mit HR-Verantwortlichen sowie unseren Teams aus Sales, Marketing, Operations und Product zusammen. Was du bewegen wirst Partnerschaften gestalten: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und verstehst, was deine Ansprechpersonen bewegt. Menschen erreichen und aktivieren: Du entwickelst Kommunikations- und Aktivierungsmassnahmen, die Mitarbeitende auf Aepsy aufmerksam machen und zur Nutzung motivieren. Projekte ins Rollen bringen: Du planst und koordinierst Projekte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, behältst Deadlines im Blick und bringst alle Beteiligten zusammen. Wirkung sichtbar machen: Du analysierst Aktivierungs- und Nutzungszahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungsmassnahmen ab. Dinge besser machen: Du hinterfragst Abläufe, bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst unsere Partnerschaften, Prozesse und das Produkt weiter. Was du mitbringst Du musst nicht bereits alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, wie du denkst, wie du mit Menschen umgehst und was dich antreibt. Erste Berufserfahrung in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, HR oder einem verwandten Bereich. Einen Hintergrund in Psychologie oder Gesundheitsförderung ist ein Plus aber kein Muss. Freude am Aufbau von Beziehungen, Begeisterungsfähigkeit und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick zu behalten Analytisches Denken, Interesse an Zahlen und Freude daran, Prozesse zu hinterfragen und zu verbessern Freude an einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem nicht immer alles vorgegeben ist und Eigeninitiative gefragt ist Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Bereitschaft, in einem 100-%-Pensum zu arbeiten und mehrheitlich vor Ort in unserem Büro im Herzen von Zürich tätig zu sein. Eine reine Remote-Tätigkeit ist nicht möglich. Was wir dir bieten Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt. Deine Arbeit hilft Menschen, psychologische Unterstützung zu finden, wenn sie sie brauchen. Du trägst dazu bei, mentale Gesundheit zugänglicher zu machen. Ein Team, das dich stärkt. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Marketing, Product und unserer Psycholog:innen-Community zusammen. Unterschiedliche Perspektiven, viel Know-how und eine gemeinsame Mission prägen unseren Alltag. Raum, Dinge zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns weiter. Deine Ideen sind willkommen, deine Verantwortung ist real und du kannst direkt mitgestalten, wie wir unsere Partner betreuen und Mitarbeitende erreichen. Gemeinsam mit uns Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen und Überzeugungen. Wir lieben Gespräche über das grosse Ganze genauso wie über die kleinen Details. Wir glauben an das, was wir tun, und arbeiten hart für eine etwas bessere Welt. Gleichzeitig sind wir Mütter, Väter, Ehemänner und Ehefrauen, Weinliebhaber, Stand-up-Comedians, Musiker, Tänzer, Yoga-Begeisterte und Zen-Mönche, die das Leben schätzen und geniessen. Bereit, etwas zu bewegen? Schlaf darüber. Lies das Inserat nochmals. Und wenn du das Gefühl hast, dass du zu Aepsy passen könntest, freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein persönliches Bewerbungsschreiben. Erzähl uns, was dich antreibt, warum dir unsere Mission wichtig ist und weshalb dich genau diese Rolle anspricht. Wir lesen jedes Schreiben aufmerksam. title: Responsable HSE F/H/X
description: À propos de Symrise Symrise est un fournisseur mondial de fragrances, de parfums, d'arômes, d'ingrédients actifs cosmétiques et d'ingrédients fonctionnels. L'entreprise compte parmi les leaders mondiaux de son secteur et dessert des fabricants de parfums, de cosmétiques, de produits alimentaires et de boissons, ainsi que l'industrie pharmaceutique et les producteurs de compléments nutritionnels et d'aliments pour animaux. Vos missions Rattaché(e) au Secrétaire Général , avec un rattachement fonctionnel au Regional Head of Safety EAME , vous définissez, pilotez et faites évoluer la stratégie EHS du site de Clichy. Véritable partenaire de la Direction du site et des responsables opérationnels, vous veillez à intégrer pleinement les enjeux EHS aussi bien dans les activités quotidiennes que dans les projets de transformation, de développement et d'investissement du site. Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes : Définir et déployer la stratégie EHS du site de Clichy , en cohérence avec les objectifs EHS globaux de Symrise et les priorités du business. Manager et développer l'équipe EHS , en définissant les priorités et en veillant à disposer des compétences et ressources nécessaires. Identifier, évaluer et prioriser les principaux risques environnementaux, santé et sécurité , et assurer la mise en œuvre de plans de prévention adaptés. Développer une véritable culture de la sécurité et de la prévention auprès de l'ensemble des activités du site : laboratoires, bureaux et fonctions support. Accompagner la Direction dans ses prises de décision en apportant votre expertise sur les risques EHS, les contraintes réglementaires et leurs impacts opérationnels . Intégrer les exigences EHS dès les premières étapes des projets de transformation, immobiliers, laboratoires et de développement du site . Piloter la conformité réglementaire et anticiper les évolutions de la réglementation française et européenne en matière d'EHS susceptibles d'impacter les activités du site. Développer et entretenir des relations constructives avec les autorités et parties prenantes externes, notamment l'Inspection du travail, la CRAMIF, les services de santé au travail ainsi que les autorités environnementales et locales . Représenter le site lors des inspections et audits réglementaires et assurer le suivi des plans d'action associés. Piloter les analyses d'incidents et garantir la mise en œuvre d'actions correctives et préventives durables. Suivre la performance EHS, les indicateurs clés et le reporting associé, dans une logique d' amélioration continue . Être l'interface privilégiée entre le site de Clichy et les équipes EHS régionales et globales de Symrise . Profil recherché Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'une formation supérieure en Hygiène, Sécurité et Environnement (HSE/EHS), sciences environnementales, ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous justifiez d' au moins 10 ans d'expérience progressive dans une fonction EHS , idéalement acquise au sein d'une organisation internationale et dans des environnements complexes combinant activités industrielles, laboratoires ou opérations. Au-delà de votre expertise technique, nous recherchons un profil capable d'allier vision stratégique et pragmatisme opérationnel . Vous vous distinguez notamment par : Une solide expertise en management EHS, évaluation des risques et conformité réglementaire . Une expérience confirmée dans le management et le développement d'équipes EHS . Une expérience significative dans l'accompagnement de projets de transformation, de développement ou d'investissement . Une bonne maîtrise des relations avec les autorités réglementaires et les parties prenantes externes. Une capacité à anticiper les risques et à transformer des problématiques EHS complexes en recommandations concrètes et pragmatiques pour le business . De solides compétences en leadership, en influence et en accompagnement du changement dans une organisation matricielle et internationale . Une excellente capacité à communiquer et à interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés, notamment avec le senior management. De fortes capacités d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et d'aide à la décision. Une expérience en conduite du changement et en gouvernance de projets. Une maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais . Avantages Ce poste vous offre l'opportunité de prendre la responsabilité des enjeux EHS au sein d'un site stratégique de Symrise , en collaboration étroite avec la Direction locale ainsi qu'avec les équipes régionales et globales du Groupe. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement en transformation, où l'EHS joue un rôle essentiel dans la continuité des activités, le développement du site, l'excellence opérationnelle et la croissance durable . Au-delà des enjeux de conformité, vous aurez l'opportunité de façonner la feuille de route EHS du site de Clichy , d'influencer des décisions structurantes et de contribuer directement au développement d'une culture forte et proactive de la sécurité. Localisation : Clichy (92) Intitulé : EHS Manager – Site de Clichy Rémunération La rémunération proposée pour ce poste est de EUR 60,000–72,000 par an. Vos premiers mois chez Symrise Vous prenez en main la gestion des dossiers HSE du site de Clichy et collaborez étroitement avec les équipes opérationnelles. Votre période d'essai de 3 mois vous permet de vous familiariser avec nos standards de sécurité et nos exigences réglementaires. Vous disposez de 25 jours de congés payés par an pour organiser votre équilibre personnel. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior AI Consultant / KI-Berater
description: Über TTMS Wir bei TTMS lieben Technologie. Noch mehr begeistert es uns, wenn daraus Lösungen entstehen, die im Alltag einen echten Unterschied machen. Als Schweizer Technologieunternehmen mit Sitz in Zürich und Teil der internationalen TTMS Gruppe entwickeln wir digitale Plattformen, innovative Softwareprodukte und AI-basierte Lösungen für Startups, etablierte Unternehmen und öffentliche Organisationen. Wir verbinden unternehmerisches Denken mit technologischer Expertise und begleiten unsere Kunden von der ersten Idee bis zur produktiven Lösung. AI ist für uns längst mehr als ein Zukunftsthema. Deshalb bauen wir unser AI-Geschäft in der Schweiz weiter aus und suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die diesen Bereich aktiv mitgestalten möchte. Deine Aufgaben Du berätst Unternehmen und öffentliche Organisationen bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung ihrer AI-Strategie. Du analysierst Geschäftsprozesse, identifizierst geeignete AI-Anwendungsfälle und bewertest deren Machbarkeit, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Risiken. Du konzipierst und moderierst Workshops mit Fachabteilungen, Führungskräften und Entscheidungsträgern. Du entwickelst AI-Roadmaps, Umsetzungskonzepte und Entscheidungsgrundlagen. Du leitest Beratungsprojekte und begleitest Proofs of Concept bis zur produktiven Umsetzung. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren internationalen AI Engineers, Data Scientists und Solution Architects zusammen. Du berücksichtigst Datenschutz, Informationssicherheit und Responsible AI. Du gestaltest unser AI-Portfolio und den weiteren Aufbau unseres AI-Geschäfts aktiv mit. Was Du mitbringst Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Beratung und Umsetzung von AI-, Machine-Learning- oder datengetriebenen Projekten. Fundiertes Verständnis von Generative AI, Large Language Models und klassischem Machine Learning. Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Leitung von Beratungsprojekten sowie im Umgang mit Führungskräften und technischen Teams. Fähigkeit, komplexe geschäftliche Herausforderungen in realistische technologische Lösungen zu übersetzen. Erfahrung in der Moderation von Workshops und der Erstellung von Strategien und Umsetzungskonzepten. Verständnis für Datenarchitekturen, Systemintegration und produktive AI-Anwendungen. Selbstständige, strukturierte und unternehmerische Arbeitsweise. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Von Vorteil: Erfahrung in der Schweizer öffentlichen Verwaltung, AI Governance, Schweizer Datenschutzrecht, RAG, AI Agents, Open-Source-AI oder Französischkenntnisse. Uns ist besonders wichtig, dass Du AI nicht nur theoretisch verstehst. Du hast bereits konkrete Projekte begleitet, kennst die Herausforderungen aus der Praxis und kannst auch kritisch beurteilen, wann der Einsatz von AI sinnvoll ist – und wann nicht. Was Dich bei TTMS erwartet Anspruchsvolle AI-Projekte für Unternehmen und öffentliche Organisationen. Viel Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau unseres AI-Geschäfts. Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen internationalen AI- und Engineering-Teams. Ein unternehmerisches Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und Eigenverantwortung. Ein modernes Office in der Swiss Life Arena in Zürich sowie flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten. Eine langfristige Perspektive in einem internationalen Technologieunternehmen. Bereit, mit uns etwas zu bewegen? Du möchtest AI nicht nur diskutieren, sondern Organisationen dabei helfen, daraus echten Mehrwert zu schaffen? Dann möchten wir Dich kennenlernen. Bewirb Dich mit Deinem Lebenslauf und einer kurzen Übersicht Deiner bisherigen AI-Projekte. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Location Data engineer
description: We are seeking a highly skilled Location Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated by our products and turn raw data into meaningful signals, insights, and features. You will work across the entire data lifecycle: building reliable pipelines, exploring and understanding complex datasets, developing features from them, and creating the tools and visualizations needed to understand their quality and impact. This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems. As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include: Making Sense of Data Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals. Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams. Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions. Building Data Products Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably. Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale. Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and machine learning models. Work with technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar tools depending on the problem at hand. Exploring & Analyzing Use data to investigate hypotheses, understand behaviors, and answer ambiguous questions. Develop metrics and evaluation frameworks to understand whether the signals and features we build actually work. Create analyses, dashboards, and visualizations that make complex datasets understandable and help the team make better decisions. Build tooling that makes it easier to inspect individual examples, debug data pipelines, and understand why a system produces a particular result. From Data to Intelligence Work closely with engineers and product teams to identify opportunities where data can make our products smarter. Use statistical methods, heuristics, experimentation, or machine learning depending on what is most appropriate for the problem. Iterate on features and models based on real-world data and continuously improve their accuracy and reliability. Help bridge the gap between exploratory data work and robust systems running in production. Continuous Improvement Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of our data infrastructure. Monitor data quality and proactively investigate unexpected changes or anomalies. Stay up to date with developments in data engineering, analytics, and machine learning, and bring relevant ideas and technologies into our stack. Contribute to a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and learning. Your Skills & Experience Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience working with data-intensive systems. Very comfortable with SQL and manipulating large datasets. Experience with one or more modern data technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or equivalent tools. Strong analytical skills: you enjoy digging into data, testing hypotheses, and understanding why something behaves the way it does. Ability to turn exploratory analysis into reliable, production-ready data pipelines and features. Familiarity with data modeling, pipeline orchestration, and large-scale data processing. Ability to communicate findings clearly through metrics, visualizations, dashboards, or other tools. Preferred Qualifications Experience building data products or features directly used by consumer-facing products. Experience working with high-volume event, behavioral, sensor, geospatial, or time-series data. Familiarity with statistics, machine learning, or feature engineering. Experience taking a data problem from an ambiguous question through exploration, prototyping, evaluation, and production. Experience building internal tools or visualizations for exploring and debugging complex datasets. Life at amo To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week. We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you: We chose a location in central Paris, near Opéra (Metro lines 3, 8, 9 and RER A). We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light! Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover: Health care (100% coverage). Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%). Vacation days: 8–9 weeks (total) per year: 5 weeks of paid time off; 1–2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract); ~11 bank holidays. We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter, to allow everyone to truly recharge and avoid prolonged slowdowns. These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO. We love the diverse perspectives we get from having people from all over the world join us (68% of our team is international), and so we of course support relocation to Paris with: Help and sponsored visa process. 1 month of Airbnb 100% covered by amo upon arrival. Assistance from a trusted relocation agency to find your permanent home. Help with French paperwork like opening a French social security account, tax forms, getting your carte vitale (free healthcare), and more. French lessons to be fully set with your new Parisian life. description: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. When a drone fails a test on our production floor, you're the first person we call. As Production Quality Control Specialist (Software/Electronics), you're the first line of technical support for production. You troubleshoot, diagnose and fix failures across our VTOL drones, their sub-systems, sensors and in-process quality tests. That way every aircraft we ship meets the standard our customers rely on in the field. You also step back from single failures and look at the data. You analyze yields and quarantine trends, find the root causes behind repeat problems and decide which fixes to tackle first. You work closely with Production, Engineering and Supply Chain, and your work shows up directly in product quality and output. Responsibilities First on the scene. You're the first-line technical support for production issues, from test failures and assembly defects to nonconforming units. Fix what's broken. You troubleshoot and repair electrical, electronic and system-level failures on drones, sub-assemblies, payloads and sensors. Keep the test benches honest. You help investigate issues with our software and electronics test benches. Decide what happens to quarantined material. You choose whether it gets reworked, repaired, scrapped or returned to the supplier. Find the real cause . You lead root cause analyses (5 Whys, Ishikawa, 8D) on recurring and high-impact failures. Let the data point the way. You analyze yields and quarantine Paretos to spot the biggest quality drivers. See fixes through. You turn your findings into prioritized corrective actions (CAPA) and follow them until they are closed. Keep failure, test and repair records traceable. Share what you learn. You feed findings back to Engineering and suppliers, and you train assembly staff on failure modes and workmanship defects. Requirements You've spent 4+ years as a quality technician, quality inspector or assembly technician on a complex mechatronic product. You understand at system level how mechanics, electronics, sensors and firmware work together. You're at ease with data. You can build yield and failure Paretos and draw sound conclusions from them. You're motivated and able to get to know our test software stack. You're methodical and keep good records, and you make sound calls under production pressure. You have a technical apprenticeship or technical diploma in Engineering, Manufacturing or Mechatronics, or equivalent practical experience. You communicate excellently in English and enjoy working together on the shop floor. Plus Experience with UAVs, RC aircraft or avionics Familiarity with batteries, GNSS, IMUs, cameras or LiDAR Experience designing electronics PCBAs Experience in software programming SPC, Cp/Cpk, MSA or a Six Sigma Green Belt Python, SQL, BI or AI tools for data analysis Experience with non-conformance tracking, quality management systems or manufacturing ERP/PLM software Familiarity with inspection tools, measurement equipment, technical drawings and CAD Hands-on work with assembly line operators, manufacturing engineers and quality teams Continuous improvement methods such as 8D, 5S and CAPA Speaking or understanding German Joining Wingtra, you gain deep insight into applied robotics and aerial photogrammetry. You work in a startup, so you make a personal impact on both the technology and the organization itself. Please send your CV in English. If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you. title: Développeur Nouveaux Projets (F/H/X)
description: Localisation Poste basé à Lyon ou Dijon. Vous êtes passionné(e) par le développement des énergies renouvelables et vous connaissez bien le tissu économique et territorial de l’Est de la France ? Rejoignez Novar et devenez un acteur clé de la transition énergétique ! En tant que Développeur Nouveaux Projets , vous serez en première ligne pour identifier et sécuriser de nouveaux sites solaires et/ou de stockage en régions AURA et Bourgogne, tout en construisant des relations solides avec les acteurs locaux (collectivités, propriétaires fonciers, entreprises, partenaires). Grâce à votre sens du terrain et votre capacité à fédérer, vous participerez activement au développement de projets qui font sens pour le territoire et ses habitants. Vos missions · Assurer une veille active des opportunités de marché (appels à projets, appels d’offres) sur votre territoire. · Construire et maintenir un réseau local solide, incluant partenaires, collectivités et apporteurs d’affaires. · Identifier de nouveaux sites à potentiel grâce à votre réseau, aux outils cartographiques et à vos actions de terrain. · Réaliser l’analyse technico-économique des sites, en intégrant contraintes et risques. · Approcher les propriétaires fonciers, agriculteurs, collectivités et clients C&I afin de présenter Novar et ses solutions. · Préparer et présenter des réponses à des appels à projets. · Négocier et contractualiser les accords fonciers et commerciaux. · Assurer le suivi des opportunités jusqu’à leur concrétisation et leur passage en phase de développement. · Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des outils, process et connaissances internes liés au développement territorial. Votre profil · Formation Bac+5 : école de commerce, master en aménagement du territoire, urbanisme ou droit rural. · Expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans un rôle similaire (prospection foncière, développement ENR ou aménagement territorial). · Excellentes capacités relationnelles et de négociation. · Goût prononcé pour le terrain et le contact direct avec les acteurs locaux. · Esprit d’analyse, rigueur et autonomie dans la gestion de projets. · Motivation à évoluer dans un secteur porteur et en pleine transformation. Ce que NOVAR vous offre Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables. Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte ? 💰 Un salaire attractif, compris entre 48 060 € et 62 383 €, en fonction de votre expérience et de votre parcours. 🎁 Un système de primes basé sur la performance. 🌴 Une prime vacances. 🩺 Mutuelle famille financée à 50% 🚗 Une voiture de fonction. 🏠 Un mode de travail flexible et hybride – dans nos bureaux modernes ou confortablement depuis chez vous. 📚 Des opportunités de développement professionnel dans le domaine du stockage d’énergie par batteries (BESS). 🏆 Un voyage collectif annuel avec l’ensemble du groupe Novar, une expérience inoubliable – travailler dur et célébrer ensemble. À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 150 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse. Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation. Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 4 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2030. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. Nos avantages Chez Fastned, on travaille avec ambition pour avoir un impact réel, et on prend le temps de reconnaître et célébrer nos réussites, qu’elles soient grandes ou petites. On valorise l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso, on t’offre une vraie flexibilité de travail et nous mettons en place des initiatives family-friendly. Nos avantages : Un budget formation et développement de 3 000€ brut par an par collaborateur, car le développement et la formation sont importants pour nous et notre secteur offre des opportunités infinies. Voiture de fonction électrique avec frais de recharge couverts. Carte Ticket Restaurant, 12,20€ par jour. 25 jours de congés + RTT + 2 jours de Mission Days que tu peux utiliser pour contribuer aux missions de Fastned et soutenir une cause associative qui te tient à cœur. Fastned prend en charge 60 % de ta mutuelle Alan et 100 % de ton salaire pendant les 30 premiers jours d’absence pour maladie/incapacité de travail. Un abonnement Gymlib avec accès à un large réseau de salles de sport et studios. Plan de stock options -> nous croyons à la création de valeur partagée. Bien-être mental avec nilo health : accès à une plateforme de santé mentale confidentielle offrant des séances de coaching individuel avec des psychologues, des sessions de groupe et une variété d’outils. Des événements festifs: Ski trip, Fastned Days, team buildings - des temps forts pour se retrouver, échanger et célébrer nos réussites. Envie d'en savoir plus ? On serait ravis d'avoir une conversation avec toi ! Envoie-nous ton CV et dis-nous en plus, pourquoi Fastned, et pourquoi toi. Le processus de recrutement se déroule en 4 étapes : Entretien vidéo avec notre recruteuse ; Entretien vidéo avec la Lead Expansion France et un Expansion Manager Case study vidéo avec la Lead Expansion France, et deux membres de l’équipe ; Team coffee chats dans nos locaux parisiens pour rencontrer les collègues de l’équipe France. title: Customer Success Public Sector
description: 🪐 Discover our galaxy Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different: - A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries - A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth - Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI - A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐 At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive. You will join Malt as a Customer Onboarding & Success Manager - Public Sector , based in Paris Manager Customer Success - Global, Public sector & SMB, you will work hand-in-hand and transversally with our Account Managers dedicated to the Public Sector. Your main mission will be to ensure the smooth deployment and flawless execution of framework agreements ( accords-cadres ) and public tenders throughout their lifecycle. You will be the guarantor of compliance with public procedures and tracking commitments, acting as the primary operational point of contact for public beneficiaries and freelancers. Key responsibilities ✨ Onboarding & Pedagogy: Pitch platform benefits, lead training sessions, and perform product demos to drive user independence within ministries, local authorities, and public institutions. Public Tender Execution & Tracking: Anticipate the end of purchase orders or contracts, and provide proactive follow-ups to ensure business continuity and secure renewals (contract renewals, new market lots). Public Administrative & Budgetary Management: Pilot operational processes specific to the public sector (management and compliance of quotes/purchase orders, tracking Legal Commitments ( Engagements Juridiques ), validating activity reports/CRA for non-autonomous clients), and monitor budget consumption. Beneficiary Relations & Satisfaction: Act as the dedicated go-to person to centralize requests from public decision-makers and resolve operational incidents. Contractual Expertise (SLAs & CCAG): Master the specificities of technical/administrative specifications (CCTP, CCAP, CCAG) and service level agreements (SLAs) unique to each framework agreement to align our internal ways of working. Continuous Improvement: Identify operational pain points unique to public administrative processes and collaborate with Ops, Product, and Tech teams to automate and adapt our platform to public sector constraints. About you 🧑‍🚀 Experience: A previous public sector experience is mandatory for this job ! Solid background in managing complex client relationships, onboarding large accounts, or operational contract management Administrative Rigor: A keen sense of organization and familiarity with the inner workings of public administration (notions of public procurement, purchase orders, Chorus Pro, and budgetary validation workflows). Solution-Oriented: Excellent interpersonal skills, diplomacy, and the ability to resolve disputes or complex situations with a variety of stakeholders (from Procurement Directors to technical Project Managers). Tools & Data: Advanced proficiency in collaborative and analytical tools (Gsheet/Excel, Notion, Looker) and an appetite for AI applications. Languages: Native/fluent level of French (essential for dealing with the French administration) and professional level of English (as internal processes and the Malt team are international). Interview with your future manager to delve into your experience and the specifics of the role (45-60 minutes). Home assignment to complete, which will be evaluated to assess your management logic and analytical skills. Final interview with a C-level executive to discuss Malt’s long-term vision. title: Product Marketing Manager (F/H)
description: At Younited, we believe credit and banking should feel as simple, fast and transparent as everything else in your digital life. So we build financial services that way. We combine technology, data and automation to rethink the way people borrow, pay, save and manage their money. Today, more than 1.5 million customers trust us, and nearly 500 employees contribute to our growth across 4 European countries . What we build Younited Credit – instant consumer credit, directly accessible to customers. Younited Pay – instalment payment and financing solutions embedded into our partners' customer journeys. Younited Cashback – cashback and personalised offers, enhanced by open banking data. Younited Bank – our everyday banking offering, currently available through helios by Younited and being expanded. Our ambition is to build a financial partner people genuinely trust, combining simplicity, transparency and responsible finance. As a certified B Corp, we integrate social and environmental considerations into the way we build our business. The 5 values we work by Make it simple - in the product, in the customer experience and in how we organise. Be transparent. Act as an entrepreneur - take ownership, play as a team, dare to try and accept failure. Innovate or die - challenge the status quo, however impossible it may seem. Faster is better - speed over perfection, alignment over debate. No limit - shoot for the moon, stay humble. We give passionate problem-solvers the space to do their best work in diverse and inclusive teams across Europe, because that is how we build better financial products for our customers and partners. Context 📄 How do you turn complex credit and payment products into propositions that customers understand, partners value and teams can sell? As Product Marketing Manager at Younited, you will shape the insights, narratives and tools that help our products stand out and grow. You will work across Younited’s product portfolio, with Younited Pay as your initial priority given its strategic importance and the competitiveness of its market. Within Marketing Central, you will join the Customer Engagement team and work with Product, Sales, Partnerships, Data, Brand & Communications and local marketing teams. Depending on business priorities, your scope may evolve across different Younited products, audiences and customer journeys. Your mission will be to understand the audiences we want to reach, clarify what makes our products valuable and turn market, customer and field feedback into concrete recommendations for Sales, Partnerships, Product and Marketing. You will connect market reality, commercial priorities and product decisions by turning research, customer insights and field feedback into clear messages, useful tools and actionable recommendations. You will also work closely with the PRM/CRM teams to connect these insights with customer journeys, engagement and retention initiatives. Key responsibilities 🚀 1) Build market and customer understanding Conduct market research, competitive analysis and customer data analysis to identify target audiences, understand their needs, uncover opportunities and bring the voice of the customer into business and product decisions. Work across several products, audiences and business priorities, with Younited Pay as the initial priority. Work with the PRM/CRM and Customer Engagement teams on segmentation, use cases and customer journeys across acquisition, activation, repeat usage and retention, including merchant onboarding for Younited Pay and other priority journeys across the Younited portfolio. 2) Define positioning and support commercial teams Clarify the benefits, differentiators and key messages of Younited products, making complex topics compelling and easy to understand for customers, merchants, partners and internal teams. Turn market and customer insights into sales pitches, presentations, enablement materials, partner tools and practical recommendations that help Sales and Partnerships teams explain and sell our products. Contribute to strategic RFPs by understanding requirements and shaping the response narrative, value proposition, differentiators, proof points and presentation materials. 3) Partner with Product teams and support product evolutions Bring market feedback and customer insights into product discussions and roadmaps, and influence product decisions based on market and customer feedback. Support product launches and evolutions with the necessary materials, including demos, training materials, operational guides, FAQs and sales enablement documents. Work across Product, Sales, Partnerships, Data, Brand & Communications and local marketing teams to turn insights into clear messages, useful tools and actionable recommendations. About you 👇 You have at least 5 years of experience in B2B Product Marketing, Product Marketing or a related role. You know how to conduct market research, analyse competition and turn customer and market insights into clear, actionable recommendations. You are comfortable working across several products, audiences and business priorities. You understand Sales and Partnerships teams’ challenges and know how to create useful, practical materials that support commercial teams. You are comfortable contributing to strategic RFPs and tailoring a value proposition to different business and partner contexts. You are comfortable working with Product teams and influencing product decisions based on market and customer feedback. Experience in payments, banking, credit, fintech, e-commerce or another complex or regulated industry is a plus. You know how to make complex topics simple and compelling, both in writing and verbally. You are fluent in French and English. You are autonomous, structured, proactive and able to manage several projects in parallel. You know how to adapt your approach to different audiences and switch between strategic thinking and hands-on execution. You know how to influence stakeholders without relying on hierarchical authority and deliver concrete results. Hiring process 📅 First video interview with Arthur, Lead Talent Acquisition Manager, to discuss the role, your motivations and Younited. Second interview with Lise, Head of Customer Engagement, to explore the expectations of the role in greater depth. Business case, followed by a debrief and conversations with members of the team. Final interview with Ricardo, Growth & Business Operations Director, to validate overall alignment with the role and potential development opportunities. 🎁 Other benefits from joining Younited ? Offices located in the heart of Paris (9th arrondissement) An international work environment and the opportunity to go on assignments in our offices abroad (Barcelona, Lisbon, Rome) An entrepreneurial mindset and strong team spirit Personalized managerial and HR support during onboarding and throughout your Younited journey A continuous learning environment with access to internal and external training, an e-learning platform, and “Friday workshops” within the Tech team to support everyone’s development A strong focus on work-life balance A parenthood charter to support all family-related projects, with key measures Special leave for major life events, often more generous than legal requirements An hybrid remote work policy: 2 to 3 days of remote work per week depending on the team, and the option to work fully remotely for one week twice a year 33 days paid holiday, i.e. 8 more than the statutory 25 days (instead of the traditional RTT) Access to the Wellpass platform (formerly Gymlib) with over 4,000 fitness and wellness activities across France at a discounted rate Meal vouchers (€10 per day, 60% covered by the company) Team buildings in France (Summer Party & Winter Party), abroad, and within your team Younited is an Equal Opportunity Employer for any minority, disability, gender identity or sexual orientation. title: Head of FP&A (F/H)
description: About Younited At Younited, we are reinventing credit and payments to make banking simple, transparent, and inclusive. European leader in instant credit, we serve over 1 million customers and partner with major brands like Apple, N26, Bouygues Telecom. Operating in 4 countries with 500 employees, we are proud to be B Corp certified, placing social and environmental impact at the heart of our strategy. Our mission: become the trusted financial partner for millions of Europeans by promoting transparency and financial well-being. We leverage cutting-edge technology and innovation to redefine lending and payment practices, delivering exceptional user experience. Our solutions include credit and payment services for consumers and partners. We empower passionate problem-solvers to collaborate, innovate, and act as entrepreneurs in a fast-growing environment. In January 2025, we reached a major milestone in our history by becoming a publicly listed company on Euronext Paris and Amsterdam. Join us and shape the future of finance in an inclusive, dynamic, and ambitious company. Be part of an adventure that is only beginning! About the Finance team The Corporate Finance team reports to the Finance Director. The Corporate Finance team oversees the financial reporting of Younited within a regulated banking environment. Its mission is (i) to deliver accurate accounting, tax, and regulatory reporting, (ii) provide reliable performance analyses to guide strategic decisions, partnering with business units to optimize resource allocation and support key growth initiatives, and (iii) drive the continued digital transformation of the overall finance function while working closely with teams across the company. The FP&A team is being reorganised into an end-to-end function of 4 people, including the Head of FP&A. Each FP&A controller owns both the forecast and the actuals on their scope, across the full management cycle — budget, business plan and capital plan, monthly closing anticipation, and post-closing analytics analytics. Context 📄 Reporting directly to the Finance Director, the Head of FP&A leads the newly structured FP&A function (a team of 3 FP&A controllers). He / She owns the management cycle and the calendar, arbitrates priorities and ad hoc requests, and acts as the guardian of the method and of the single planning model. He / She is accountable for the quality of the figures and for the development of the team. This role comes at a pivotal moment: Younited is moving to a market-standard, end-to-end FP&A organization and the Head of FP&A will be responsible for shaping his/her team target operating model, formalise scopes and ways of working, and progressively automate and strengthen the reliability of the whole planning and reporting chain — while partnering closely with the business to turn financial analysis into better decisions. Key responsibilities 🚀 Build the team target operating model, define the set of FP&A procedures (scopes, calendar, controls, documentation) and make its organisation resilient by design with clear back-ups and shared standards. Own the budget process, business planning and reforecasts: annual budget (build, iterations, defence), multi-year business plan and periodic reforecasts, under one method and one single model. Own the monthly closing process: pre-close anticipation of closing topics so that issues are spotted before the accounts are closed, post-close analysis of variances to budget, and capital plan. Deliver timely, clear financial reporting tailored to each audience — leadership, local management and business partners — including management accounts, variance analyses and ad hoc studies, and act as a business partner to the divisions on strategic initiatives and performance improvement. Lead, develop and coach the FP&A team, ensuring skills development, back-up and high performance across the scope. About you 👇 Seasoned finance professional with 8+ years of experience, including team management: with proven experience in both FP&A / controlling and Audit / TS at a leading international firm with exposure to financial institutions, regulated environments and complex data structures, with a good understanding of a market standard full management cycle — budgeting, multi-year business planning, forecasting and management reporting, experienced with EPM tools is a plus, Solid understanding of accounting standards and their strategic implications for financial planning and reporting (IFRS & French GAAP & regulatory), A structured leader able to build method and process, set standards and drive change and continuous improvement in an evolving environment, Demonstrated ability to work under tight deadlines while ensuring accuracy and reliability, Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact confidently with business partners and top management (CEO, COO, CFO) and board, A proactive, hands-on and detail-oriented mindset, with strong analytical skills and a genuine commitment to team development, Full professional proficiency in English and French, both written and spoken, is required. Why makes the role so exciting 🌟 A rare opportunity to build and lead a market-standard end-to-end FP&A function in a listed company. High autonomy and visibility: you own one of the most critical processes of the company and partners directly with Senior Management personnel of the Company. Recruitment process 📅 The process begins with an interview with Arthur, Lead Talent Acquisition Manager, to discuss the role, your motivations, and how you align with Younited's values and culture (30 min). This is followed by an interview with Arthur, Finance Director, for a discussion about the position (1h). Next, you'll have one week to prepare a technical case study on an FP&A topic (management cycle, planning and business partnering), and then present your approach during a dedicated session (1h) with Arthur and a member of the Finance team. You will then meet Rémi, BU France CEO for a conversation about the banking business (1h). Finally, the process concludes with a closing conversation with Naren, Group CFO (1h). title: Research Engineer
description: Do you believe the path to general-purpose physical AI runs through noisy, real-world factory deployments? Are you excited by the challenge of turning the classical robotic stacks into the foundational training data for physical AI? Do you want to bridge the gap between world-class ML research and industrial-scale robotic execution? If your answers are yes, we should talk. At Nomagic, we are executing a humble pivot for general-purpose physical AI. We believe that physical AI is fundamentally a knowledge transfer problem - we are leveraging the "internet data" of robotics - massive deployment logs from real systems operating in production environments - to bootstrap our efforts. We are looking for Research Engineers who will help us to build, train, and deploy foundational models that bring our fleet from a classical control stack to generalized AI mastery. Offer essentials Play with real robots, solving real problems, every day. Relocation package. Flexible working hours. English-speaking environment. Here is why we love this job ourselves, and hope you will enjoy it too: We combine world-class research with top-notch engineering and apply it to solve real problems The data already exists. We have robots in production at scale. We aren't waiting for datasets to be collected; the byproduct of our machines doing useful work is being created right now. We measure what matters. We test our code in unit tests, simulations, and directly on real robots. Grounding our models in deployment allows us to truly measure performance. High leverage, high impact. We’re still a highly focused team. If your training recipes improve our agents, you directly change the economics of the company. World-class peers. Our team has built Google Warsaw, unicorn startups, led research in DeepMind, tested rocket engines, and worked at top companies like Nvidia and ByteDance. Now, we are shaping the reality of Physical AI together. We are building the bridge. We aren't a new startup looking for an application; we are an established player bootstrapping physical AI. We believe that this will be the first true proof-of-concept for scaled physical AI. What you will do Your focus will be defined by the intersection of Robotics and ML and large-scale multimodal model training - expertise in both is optimal and alternatively eagerness to learn. Expect challenges across two main pillars with the opportunity to specialise: Core Research & Large-Scale Infrastructure Own the Training Stack: Design, implement, and maintain the core infrastructure for large-scale VLA model training, including scheduling, distribution, job management, checkpointing, and rigorous logging. Enable Rapid Iteration: Build the critical tools and abstractions necessary for launching, monitoring, debugging, and seamlessly reproducing complex, multi-variant experiments. Train from Deployment Logs: Utilize our massive repository of offline, classical stack data to pre-train robust robot foundation models. Drive the Software Feedback Loop: Translate core research needs into concrete infra capabilities, track experiments, analyze results, and close the loop directly with ML researchers to unblock model progress Real-World Evaluation & Operations Design Physical Benchmarks: Design new robotic tasks and build lightweight physical setups to systematically evaluate model capabilities far beyond the limits of simulation. Execute Structured Evaluations: Ensure robots are properly configured, calibrated, and ready for rollouts. You will coordinate data collection efforts and run structured, on-robot evaluations to measure real-world success rates. Close the Physical Feedback Loop: Analyze real-world evaluation results to guide the ML research direction. You will identify operational bottlenecks across software, hardware, and deployment systems to continuously improve our iteration speed. Scale the Workflows: Beta test internal and third-party tools for teaching robots new skills, and write clear, structured documentation so the broader team can reproduce your workflows and scale your impact. What skills we’d like you to have: Experience: Deep experience and understanding at the intersection of machine learning, systems engineering, and robotics. Proven Track Record: Experience training, fine-tuning, and deploying modern deep learning architectures (Transformers, VLMs or VLAs, Imitation Learning, RL) for robot control, ideally with policies validated on real hardware. Engineering Excellence: Strong software engineering and infrastructure skills. You are highly proficient in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch/JAX) and can write clean, scalable code for training and evaluation. Robotics Intuition: Comfort working hands-on with hardware. You understand the robotics full stack (perception, controls, state estimation) and how to debug failures when software meets the physical world. Pragmatic Research Mindset: You possess the ability to move seamlessly between research and implementation. You prefer execution, iteration speed, and real-world robustness over theoretical purity. What should you expect once you apply? A phone screen with the hiring manager to discuss your background and our technical direction. A half-day of on-sites (cultural fit & deep-dive technical interviews). A final decision made within 2-3 days after the on-site interview. Important: Expect detailed, honest feedback after completing the process, regardless of our decision. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive (Enterprise)
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . Summary Every large group in Europe has bought an AI assistant, or is buying one this year. The next decision is harder: how their teams' own work runs on agents, across their own systems, governed, on top of what they already pay for. That is what Dust sells, and this role owns that decision inside a handful of France's largest groups. You will be one of our first Strategic Account Executives. We are looking for people who have been at the top of every team they have joined, wherever they started. The Role 5 to 8 named groups, 5,000+ employees, mostly headquartered in France. You own each relationship globally, across subsidiaries and countries. Some are already customers. They started with one team and grow as more teams build their own agents. Their renewals are where your account grows, and you run them. The others you open. We go in through the executive who owns the group's AI programme, before any tender is written. Our founders and executives work your accounts with you, and so do the consulting firms that run these programmes. Deals of €300K to €1M+ a year, decided by the executive committee, with IT, security, procurement and the business in the room. You run the deal team: solutions engineers, customer success, partners and founders, brought in when you decide. You write the playbook. How Dust sells to large groups is being built now, by the people in this seat. What success looks like 90 days: an account plan for each group, the owner of the AI programme identified in all of them, and a first executive meeting held in at least half. 12 months: a first group-level deal signed, and one existing account growing across new teams. Who we are looking for You have been at or near the top of every team you joined. Tell us your rank in each role, and where you started. We care more about how far you have come than about the logos on the way. You have opened large accounts yourself, without a big brand or an inherited list doing the work. You have led a deal decided at executive level, with procurement and legal involved, and you can walk us through every step of it. You have grown an account after the first deal, and you think in what an account is worth in three years. You use AI in your own work. If you have built an agent, show us. Fluent French and English. Based in Paris or moving here, with regular travel in France and Europe. We do not screen on years of experience or on the size of your last employer. If you have been the best at what you did and want a bigger game, apply. What is hard Our brand is smaller than the labs'. You will win on what Dust does next to the assistant a group already chose, not on our name. Large groups move slowly and decide at the top. A unit that loves the product does not make a group deal; you will learn to find the person who does. The playbook is unfinished. You will be writing it while you use it. What you get OTE €180k OTE 50/50 split, uncapped accelerators, and a significant equity package in a Sequoia-backed company. Founders on your accounts, a small team that decides fast, and room to lead as the Strategic team grows. We are not promising a title; we will look here first when we need one. Health cover, relocation support, Paris office, regular trips to San Francisco. description: About us Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed. Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity. K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners. Position is based in our Paris office or remotely in France, UK, Germany. Please submit your CV in English About the role: We are seeking a driven Research Scientist with hands-on expertise in Foundation Models (FMs) and Multimodal AI to help drive the next phase of our machine learning platform. In this role, you will bridge cutting-edge AI research and practical application. Rather than training massive base models from scratch, your focus will be on fine-tuning, adapting, and aligning open-weights foundation models across diverse data modalities (e.g. structured tabular data, single-cell scRNA-seq, image representations, and natural language) to build multimodal systems. In particular, you will be responsible for: Model adaptation and optimization: Adapt, fine-tune, and evaluate state-of-the-art open-source foundation models (e.g., domain-specific transformers, vision-language models) using fine-tuning and transfer learning strategies. Multimodal integration: Design and implement cross-modal alignment architectures (e.g., contrastive learning, projection heads, unified embedding spaces) to fuse structured, sequential, and text/image data layers. Pipeline and evaluation engineering: Build rigorous, domain-tailored benchmarking frameworks and evaluation pipelines to validate model reliability, generalization, and downstream task performance. Applied R&D collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams (data engineers, domain specialists, and software engineers) to integrate adapted models into scalable production and inference workflows. Low-hanging fruit innovation: Identify high-impact, incremental improvements in data pre-processing, embedding representation, and fine-tuning to maximize model performance without unnecessary computational overhead. About you Required qualifications / experience: Education: Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics or a related quantitative field. Experience: 2-4 years of post-degree experience applying deep learning and foundation models to complex datasets. Foundation models: Demonstrated experience adapting and fine-tuning foundation models. Multimodal learning: Proven experience with cross-modal representation learning, joint embedding alignment (e.g., CLIP-style architectures), or vision-language models. Technical stack: Advanced proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks ( PyTorch , Hugging Face ecosystem). Hands-on experience with fine-tuning techniques. Familiarity with data engineering tools for handling large-scale or multi-modal datasets (Parquet, AnnData, HDF5). Preferred qualifications/bonus: Experience working with biological or omics data (e.g., scRNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, clinical and/or histology data). Experience deploying or scaling models using containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP). description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Overview Harmattan AI is developing new hardware products within the Launcher module: field-deployable drone launchers designed to be deployed and operated autonomously in demanding field environments. These products require dedicated electronics design with complex architecture in a constrained environment – PCBs integrating power conversion, energy management, control and communication interfaces – optimised for cost at volume. The Launcher team is seeking a dedicated hardware engineer to own electronics design end-to-end and accelerate the path to production milestones. Ideal candidate A senior hardware engineer who has designed and shipped complex PCBs, ideally mixing digital and significant power (hundreds of watts), into production. They are rigorous on schematics, layout, and bring-up, and have a strong instinct for cost and manufacturability. They design with real-world operating conditions in mind - temperature, moisture, surges - and an interest in battery thermal management; direct experience of outdoor-deployed equipment is a plus rather than a prerequisite. They are comfortable working autonomously in a small team and can bridge hardware and firmware. Skills required PCB schematic and layout design (Altium Designer preferred) Power electronics design: ~300 W DC/DC conversion, protection, derating, efficiency and thermal budgets Thermal regulation: temperature sensing and control loops, battery storage temperature management, heatsinking Power over Ethernet (IEEE 802.3af/at/bt): combined power and data delivery, isolation, cable budgets Mixed-signal design: power management, MCU interfaces, communication buses (SPI, I2C, UART, USB, CAN, Ethernet) Hardware bring-up and debug: bench equipment proficiency DFM/DFA for PCB manufacturing and assembly Component selection and BOM management Experience in lightning and surge protection is a plus Responsibilities: Schematic Design - Design complete schematics for mixed-signal and power boards, from power stages to digital and communication sections. PCB Layout & Routing - Perform or lead board placement and routing with attention to signal integrity, EMC, and power-path constraints. Power & Thermal Architecture - Define and validate the power architecture of the product and the thermal strategy, including battery temperature management. Environmental Robustness - Ensure the electronics withstand outdoor deployment conditions and define the associated qualification plan. Component Selection & BOM Optimization - Select components with cost, availability, and reliability in mind; drive BOM cost reduction for mass production volumes. Hardware Bring-up & Debug - Lead board bring-up, debug issues with oscilloscopes, power bench equipment, and other bench equipment; write bring-up scripts when needed. EMC & Safety Compliance - Address EMC challenges; ensure signal integrity across the board and electrical safety of the power and battery sections. title: Senior Manager, Integrated MarComms, France & Benelux
description: Tinder exists to help people meet, connect and create a spark. After 13 years of leadership in the dating industry, culture is what keeps that mission relevant to each new generation of daters. Product is central to this shift. Every new feature is a chance to tell a human story about how people connect, and culture is where those stories land. To make that shift real, we’re bringing our Tinder MarComms regional EMEA strategy together: one unified in-country team in each key market and one regional structure. Communications now sits within Marketing, so both work toward the same KPIs and growth objectives. The Integrated MarComms role is where culture meets brand relevance, with one holistic objective: driving MAU growth. Social Media is the true D2C MarComms engine for Tinder, and creator and influencer led activations play a central role in driving registrations, reactivations and cultural relevance. The regional MarComms team owns the full paid, earned and owned media cycle across key markets. The Integrated MarComms Senior Manager leads the earned and influence dimension of that ecosystem, with a strong influence on owned social channels and brand partnership storytelling. The role reports to the Director of Marketing of France & Benelux. It works in a matrix with the Snr. Director of Social Media, Snr. Manager of Brand Partnerships, and closely with the Global Comms team. Key Responsibilities 1. Creator & Influencer Ecosystem Engagement Build and nurture a diverse network of community voices: creators, influencers, podcast hosts, cultural commentators and community leaders. Develop collaborations rooted in a strong audience insight and shared creative idea, giving partners a meaningful role beyond content distribution. Work closely with social, influence and brand partnership teams to connect local opportunities with broader brand priorities. Create opportunities for audiences to participate and share their own stories, turning campaigns into conversations that extend beyond launch. 2. Social-First Integrated MarComms Strategy Translate market priorities into integrated MarComms plans for France & Benelux, in close partnership with the market lead, marketing manager and EMEA teams. Develop compelling creative ideas with the potential to travel across paid, owned and earned channels, giving each channel a clear role in building relevance, consideration and action. Build strategies around how Gen Z discovers, shares and participates in culture, across various formats, creators, podcasts, digital communities and emerging platforms. Help raise the creative and strategic standard of Tinder’s organic social channels, building distinctive formats and stories that audiences want to be part of. 3. Creating Cultural Narratives for Gen Z Turn audience insights, cultural tensions and dating behaviours into locally relevant narratives that strengthen Tinder’s role in modern dating, particularly among young women. Make product innovation meaningful through human stories and creative experiences that show how Tinder helps people meet, connect and create a spark. Broaden the representation of dating success to reflect the connections, experiences and stories Gen Z values, building a more positive and credible perception of Tinder. Anticipate cultural moments and emerging conversations, using data, cultural understanding and creative judgment to identify where the brand can make a meaningful contribution. Own a quarterly and annual activation calendar, balancing planned campaigns with timely opportunities, and contribute local insights and ideas to EMEA initiatives. 4. Earned Impact & Measurement Connect MarComms activity to clear objectives, supporting registrations and reactivations as contributions to the overarching goal of MAU growth. Own measurement of earned and social impact, including share of conversation, message uptake, sentiment and meaningful engagement, moving beyond coverage volume and impressions. Partner with Insights and Analytics to assess contributions to brand consideration, trust, relevance and perceptions of the dating experiences Tinder enables. Use results to sharpen creative choices, improve distribution and recommend where to scale, adapt or stop activity. 5. End-to-End Campaign & Agency Management Own campaigns from brief to launch to wrap-up in France & Benelux, making sure paid, owned and earned moments work as one story. Brief, steer and hold agency partners to the bar on creative quality, timelines and budgets, so their work feeds the integrated plan. Keep workflows with EMEA and Global teams clear, so local executions stay on brand and on time. Coordinate crisis and issue management with Comms leadership, anticipating sensitive topics and keeping responses fast, aligned and on brand.
