title: AI Growth Engineer
description: About Voodoo Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000+ people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. title: Director, Satellite Business International | Directeur(trice), Développement Commercial International - Satellites
description: <div class="content-intro"><div style="font-family: 'Instrument Sans', 'Segoe UI', Trebuchet MS, Tahoma, sans-serif;"> <p style="line-height: 1.4;">Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and capital-efficient approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to support a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and supporting a growing space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to design, build, and operate its own spacecraft in orbit. Next, Haven-1 is targeted to become the world’s first commercial space station, with launch anticipated in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced two new offerings leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo: Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line; and Vast Lunar Systems, power, communications, and habitats for the Moon.<br><br>Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities capable of manufacturing America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for Mars, dedicated modules for government partners, and other crewed systems designed to unlock the expanding long-term space economy.</p> </div></div><p>Vast recherche un(e) <strong>Directeur(trice), Développement Commercial International - Satellites</strong>, sous la responsabilité du <strong>SVP, Satellite Business Development & Commercialization</strong>, pour diriger le développement commercial axé sur le commerce (communications, observation de la Terre, détection, défense et applications de calcul en orbite) et les gouvernements internationaux pour Vast Satellites. Ce rôle est centré sur les marchés hors États-Unis — notamment l'Europe, le Moyen-Orient et l'Asie — et dirigera l'engagement client, le développement des opportunités, la stratégie de capture, l'engagement gouvernemental/défense et les efforts de partenariat qui font progresser les initiatives de Vast pour développer, fabriquer et exploiter des plateformes de bus satellites avancées.</p> <p>Il s'agit d'une petite équipe commerciale fondatrice de haut niveau : le rôle exige à la fois des instincts de « hunter » en développement commercial (créer des marchés et de la demande là où il n'en existe pas encore) et des compétences avérées de « closer » (négocier et exécuter des contrats allant de quelques millions à des centaines de millions de dollars).</p> <p>Ce poste sera à <strong>temps plein, exempté</strong>, ouvert à un lieu de travail international flexible comme décrit ci-dessus.</p> <p><strong>Responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Élaborer et exécuter une stratégie globale de marché commercial et gouvernemental international couvrant l'Europe, le Moyen-Orient et l'Asie, alignée sur les objectifs commerciaux de Vast.</li> <li>Établir et maintenir une veille stratégique sur le marché et la concurrence concernant les clients spatiaux commerciaux et gouvernementaux internationaux, en distinguant le positionnement de Vast de celui de ses concurrents dans chaque région.</li> <li>Piloter la planification interne pour la priorisation des opportunités internationales, la stratégie de capture et le développement du pipeline sur de multiples marchés alliés et partenaires.</li> <li>Diriger l'engagement client à travers l'identification d'opportunités, la définition du périmètre des missions, les présentations de capacités et le développement de concepts précoces avec les opérateurs commerciaux internationaux, les sociétés d'observation de la Terre, les ministères de la défense et les entités gouvernementales.</li> <li>Tirer parti d'un solide réseau préexistant de haut niveau au sein de la chaîne de valeur internationale de l'espace et de la défense pour ouvrir des portes auprès de clients potentiels et identifier précocement les menaces concurrentielles.</li> <li>Diriger l'élaboration des propositions et coordonner les contributions interfonctionnelles des équipes d'ingénierie, de gestion de programme, de finance, juridique et de contrôle des exportations/conformité, avec le soutien de l'analyste BD et de l'ingénieur avant-vente de l'équipe.</li> <li>Assumer la responsabilité du développement du pipeline, des prévisions et des rapports pour tous les comptes commerciaux et gouvernementaux internationaux.</li> <li>Négocier et conclure des contrats pour des missions commerciales et gouvernementales/défense internationales et les services associés, en naviguant à travers divers cadres nationaux de passation de marchés, de contrôle des exportations (ex. ITAR/EAR) et de partenariat.</li> <li>Se coordonner avec l'équipe de sécurité nationale de Vast lorsque les programmes internationaux croisent des parties prenantes ou des enjeux liés au gouvernement américain.</li> <li>Représenter Vast lors d'événements de l'industrie spatiale, aérospatiale et de défense internationale en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et en Asie.</li> <li>Faire des présentations, participer à des panels et fournir des briefings de haut niveau/C-suite communiquant les capacités et la valeur des plateformes satellites de Vast aux audiences commerciales, gouvernementales et de défense internationales.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications Minimales :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Plus de 12 ans d'expérience pertinente dans le développement commercial spatial/aérospatial, les ventes, la gestion de capture ou les contrats gouvernementaux/défense, avec un succès avéré en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et/ou en Asie.</li> <li>Historique avéré d'origination et de conclusion personnelle de contrats, y compris des transactions de plusieurs dizaines de millions de dollars ou plus.</li> <li>Relations établies et vérifiables avec des clients potentiels au niveau cadre et exécutif, et connaissance du paysage concurrentiel sur de multiples marchés spatiaux et de défense internationaux.</li> <li>Expérience dans la chaîne de valeur spatiale/aérospatiale (lancement, bus satellite, charge utile, intégration maître d'œuvre ou opérations), idéalement complémentaire des opérations satellites — par ex. observation de la Terre ou défense internationale.</li> <li>Compréhension approfondie des structures de passation de marchés et de partenariat gouvernementales internationales pertinentes pour les programmes d'espace et de défense.</li> <li>Solides compétences techniques et capacité à communiquer des systèmes complexes à des audiences commerciales, de défense et gouvernementales internationales.</li> <li>Excellentes capacités de communication, d'analyse, de collaboration et de relations interpersonnelles ; à l'aise pour opérer à travers diverses cultures et langues.</li> <li>Capacité à opérer de manière autonome, à hiérarchiser les priorités efficacement et à gérer title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctoral researcher (12 months) Mathematics of energy-efficient AI: diffusion models on emerging hardware
description: The question Generating one image with a diffusion model means evaluating a large neural network tens to hundreds of times. That repetition is where the energy goes, and it is part of why data-centre demand is now visible at grid scale: the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory puts US data-centre electricity use at 176 TWh in 2023, 4.4 % of national consumption, a figure that more than doubled since 2017 largely because of AI servers, and projects 325–580 TWh by 2028. Emerging hardware attacks exactly this primitive: analog in-memory computing, silicon photonics, ferroelectric devices and stochastic computing perform the underlying matrix–vector products at lower energy than digital CMOS, under conditions on scale and precision, but return a perturbed result. The usual objection is that nobody can say in advance how much perturbation a model tolerates. In EMMA, this opportunity is pursued through a PCM-based photonic matrix–vector engine as the primary demonstrator, complemented where appropriate by FeFET-based analog computing, so that device-level non-idealities are treated as explicit design parameters rather than as after-the-fact implementation losses. Diffusion models are an unusual case in which that question has a mathematical answer: their convergence theory bounds the discrepancy between the generated and target distributions by three terms, of which only one, the L 2 error of the learned score, depends on the hardware. That side is now in good shape: for stochastic samplers, bounds linear in the dimension under minimal assumptions on the data; for deterministic samplers, a matching theory under regularity. What is missing is the bridge. The theory is parameterised by a score error, the hardware literature by conductance noise, effective number of bits and photons per multiply–accumulate; nobody has written the map between them, in either direction. The quantisation literature for diffusion models reports image-quality scores; the induced L 2 score error, in the form the convergence theory needs, is directly measurable and goes unreported. One open sub-question sets the direction: the distinction between an error redrawn at each evaluation, as in stochastic computing, and an error frozen at write time, as in deterministic quantisation, has been settled in one setting only, and not the one hardware lives in; carrying it over is what this position exists to do. The work is judged on one concrete outcome. For at least one architecture, we want to show that theenergy gain from moving the score evaluation off digital CMOS is real, measured where it survives integration and not extrapolated from a single tile, and that it is paid for by a loss in sample quality that is small and, above all, tunable: a knob the designer sets, whose position the theory predicts rather than discovers afterwards. What you will do The work is organised in four packages, summarised below; the full research programme is available from the supervisors on request. 1. Make the score error measurable, starting from Gaussian targets where the whole error decomposition is closed-form. You will report the induced score error for a given perturbation of the network’s arithmetic, the number the theory needs and the quantisation literature does not report. 2. Map device physics onto the theory. Propagate the published error models for the technologies INL works on through the score network into an explicit score-error budget, separating what is proved from what is measured. 3. Extend the guarantees. Existing bounds assume a deterministic oracle, or a benign randomised one; extend them to error that is part frozen at write time and part redrawn at each call, and settle, on the way, which process the score error should be controlled along. 4. Co-design with INL, and deliver the proof of concept. Turn the score-error budget into an energy– accuracy frontier for INL’s PCM-based photonic matrix–vector engine, using device-calibrated circuitlevel models; a FeFET-based analog alternative may be considered where appropriate. Jointly vary sampler steps, stochastic bitstream length and effective precision to identify an operating point predicted to yield a real energy advantage over digital CMOS at a small, tunable loss in sample quality. The result is a frontier predicted from mathematical and hardware models, then verified against calibrated measurements. A clear negative answer is more useful to us than a vague positive one: a negative result on point 3 leaves points 1 and 2 intact and turns point 4 from a prediction into a measurement. Who we are looking for Required • A PhD in applied mathematics, statistics, machine learning, electronic engineering, computer science or a closely related field, obtained (or with the defence scheduled) before the start of the contract. • A strong foundation in probability and stochastic analysis, numerical analysis, optimisation, or machine learning: SDEs, Girsanov’s theorem, time reversal of diffusions, with the ability to apply it rigorously to diffusion or other generative models. • Familiarity with the convergence theory of sampling algorithms, or the demonstrated capacity to acquire it quickly, for example through Langevin/MCMC analysis, optimal transport or concentration of measure. • Solid scientific computing (PyTorch or JAX), and the habit of writing code others can run. Ability and motivation to work across mathematical modelling and hardware-aware AI. • Working English; French is not required. Valued, not required Prior work on diffusion or score-based generative models; numerical analysis of finite-precision arithmetic. Familiarity with hardware-aware machine learning, approximate or stochastic computing, analogue in-memory computing, device modelling, circuit simulation, photonics, ferroelectric devices, or energy modelling. Experience linking model accuracy or robustness to implementation non-idealities, such as quantisation, noise, drift, variability, finite precision, or correlated errors. Evidence of interdisciplinary research, for example work at the interface of mathematics, machine learning, devices, circuits, architectures, or electronic-design automation. No hardware experience is expected or needed to apply. What matters most We are seeking a researcher who wants to explore how to turn physical constraints into mathematical and architectural design parameters. The project does not require prior laboratory hardware experience: INL provides device expertise, measured characteristics and modelling infrastructure. However, the successful candidate must be prepared to engage critically with non-ideal analog, photonic and ferroelectric accelerators, and to work with both supervisors to connect device-level error mechanisms, score-error guarantees and the energy–quality trade-off of diffusion-model inference. Candidates with a primarily mathematical background and strong curiosity for hardware are welcome, as are candidates from AIhardware, device-modeling, circuit, architecture or EDA backgrounds who have the stochastic-analysis maturity needed to develop the theory. The decisive criterion is the ability to make the mathematics and hardware inform one another, producing predictions that are quantitative, testable and relevant to an energy-efficient accelerator demonstrator. What we offer • A real double supervision, with weekly meetings that alternate between ICJ and INL. The two laboratories are on the same campus, five minutes apart on foot. • A question publishable on both sides: mathematics journals for the theory, design and hardware venues for the co-design. • Involvement in INL’s design–technology co-optimisation work through the PEPR Électronique CHOOSE project, and contact with the group’s ferroelectric and photonic device work (FVLLMONTI, Ferro4EdgeAI). • Support for conference travel and open-access publication, funded by the two host laboratories, and the career-development measures the establishment provides for post-doctoral researchers. • Practical help for international recruits through Espace ULYS, the EURAXESS service centre for Université de Lyon: visas, housing, health cover, banking, schooling. Conditions Twelve-month fixed-term contract under French public law, full time (1 607 h annual reference), 25 working days of annual leave plus the RTT days of the establishment’s scheme. Affiliation to the régime général for health and to IRCANTEC for supplementary pension; employer contribution to complementary health cover under the scheme in force at the establishment; 75 % reimbursement of publictransport season tickets, up to the statutory ceiling. The exact number of RTT days is set by the establishment. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Security Architect
description: Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products. Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: Physical/embedded device security. OT (operational technology) network security. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines. What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. What you will be doing As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. Security standards, policies, and design patterns library Security architecture review process Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work. To succeed in this role: You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security " You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. In addition, you have the following technical expertise: Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries Zero trust architecture principles Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) The following competence is desired: OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) Container and Kubernetes security Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) Priva's technical stack is C#/C++/.NET and Angular. title: Principal Solutions Architect, APJC (Developer Platform) - Mandarin Speaking
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. Rather than focusing on a single account, you will operate across a dynamic portfolio of strategic engagements, ensuring broad, ecosystem-wide impact.</p> <p>A central part of your role involves translating your field experience into reusable organizational knowledge. Developer Platform customers and partners across the region.</li> <li><strong>Design & Translate:</strong> Transform complex business, application, security, and operational requirements into secure, scalable, and highly maintainable architectures on Cloudflare.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate & Advise:</strong> Partner with engineering executives and senior stakeholders to advise on application modernization, distributed systems, AI architecture, and platform strategy.</li> <li><strong>Facilitate Discovery:</strong> Lead architecture discovery sessions, technical workshops, proofs of concept, design reviews, and production-readiness discussions in a supportive, consultative manner.</li> <li><strong>Create Frameworks:</strong> Establish reference architectures, architectural standards, and governance patterns that empower our customers and the broader APJC field organization.</li> <li><strong>Stay Hands-On:</strong> Build, review, and troubleshoot representative entire team.</li> <li>Empowered the field organization’s ability to position, architect, and deliver Cloudflare’s developer and AI solutions.</li> <li>Cultivated the technical leadership of your colleagues through active mentorship and enablement.</li> <li>Provided product teams with consistent, evidence-based insights into regional customer requirements and adoption barriers.</li> <li>Become recognized as a supportive, authoritative Principal Developer Platform architect across APJC.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Meaningful <li><strong>Language Skills:</strong> Professional fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese, with the ability to comfortably lead technical and executive discussions in both languages to support clients in the Greater China region, which form a significant part of your portfolio.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Collaboration:</strong> A track record of guiding complex technical strategies involving developers, infrastructure teams, security stakeholders, and senior executives.</li> <li><strong>Technical Depth:</strong> Deep working knowledge of distributed application architecture (compute, storage, networking, security, reliability, and observability).</li> <li><strong>Hands-On Capability:</strong> Software-development experience, including the ability to build or review production-quality applications and proofs of concept (preferably in JavaScript or TypeScript).</li> <li><strong>Ecosystem Knowledge:</strong> A strong understanding of modern web technologies, serverless/cloud-native architectures, modern software-delivery practices, and at least one major public cloud platform.</li> <li><strong>Influential Leadership:</strong> A proven ability to influence without direct authority, thoughtfully mentor colleagues, and turn individual solutions into shared organizational capabilities.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Excellent written, communities in Greater China.</li> <li>A background in public speaking, technical writing, open-source contribution, or community leadership.</li> <li>Relevant cloud or architecture certifications.</li> <li>A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, OR equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Important Note: </strong><em>At Cloudflare, we title: Sr. Engineering Manager - Developer Ecosystem
description: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">RDQ427R369</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.</span></p> <p>Our Developer Ecosystem organisation shapes how developers and the AI agents working for them build on the Databricks Data and AI Platform, from within the product to the tools they already use.</p> <p>We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our declarative deployment framework, which turns data and AI projects into versioned, reviewable, repeatable software. It is one product with two entry points. Third-party developers use our open-source CLI from their IDEs, terminals, and CI/CD systems. First-party, they author, deploy and inspect the same projects inside the Databricks workspace. In both, AI agents increasingly do the work: coding agents drive the CLI, and our in-product AI assistant authors and deploys projects alongside the developer. Thousands of organisations run their CI/CD on it, and it is one of the fastest-growing parts of the platform.</p> <p>The team owns the deployment engine and CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and the metadata service and deployment history that record every deployment. The hard problems are real infrastructure-as-code problems: reconciling declared and live state, making plans safe for humans and agents to approve, keeping visual authoring and code in sync, and shipping weekly releases that remain backwards-compatible for our largest customers.</p> <p><strong>The impact you will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and grow the team:</strong> Manage a team of senior engineers across three closely connected areas (the deployment engine and open-source CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and deployment history and metadata), working with strong tech leads. Hire, coach and promote, and grow engineers into tech leads.</li> <li><strong>Make agentic development the default path:</strong> Shape how developers and AI agents author, validate and deploy projects, both inside the workspace and from the developer's own coding agent. Design the tools, skills and guardrails so agents get the same safety and auditability as humans.</li> <li><strong>Own the strategy and roadmap:</strong> Partner with Product and Design to set a multi-quarter roadmap for declarative deployment: agentic development, governed deployments and deployment history, enterprise CI/CD, and new resource coverage. Make the trade-offs explicit when the demand is larger than the team.</li> <li><strong>Raise the bar on execution and operational excellence:</strong> Run a predictable delivery process for a fast-moving, open-source product with frequent releases. Own reliability, on-call health, incident response and the quality bar for a tool customers depend on to ship to production.</li> <li><strong>Treat backward compatibility as a product feature:</strong> Lead engine and configuration migrations without forcing customers through a flag day, and communicate change clearly to customers, the community and field teams.</li> <li><strong>Lead across the platform:</strong> Drive alignment with the many platform teams whose resources and services the framework deploys, and with our sibling teams in Developer Ecosystem (SDKs, CLI, IaC provider, IDE). Make the whole toolchain feel like one product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years managing software engineering teams, and 8+ years of software engineering experience overall.</li> <li>A track record of building and shipping developer tools or platforms used by many external developers or internal teams, such as infrastructure-as-code, deployment or CI/CD systems, CLIs, SDKs, or internal developer platforms.</li> <li>A deep understanding of declarative systems and deployment workflows: plan/apply, state management, drift and reconciliation, environment promotion, GitOps.</li> <li>Enough technical depth to engage on architecture and trade-offs with senior and staff engineers, and to hold a high-quality bar for public, versioned interfaces.</li> <li>Experience leading teams through ambiguity, with competing priorities from customers, partners and platform dependencies, and making clear calls.</li> <li>Strong product sense and a customer-first mindset. You enjoy talking to developers, reading their issues, and turning feedback into roadmap.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication, including with executives, partner teams and an external developer community.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Stand-out experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Built or led teams on infrastructure-as-code or deployment platforms, e.g. Terraform, Pulumi, AWS CDK / CloudFormation, Kubernetes controllers, Argo CD / Flux / Helm, or Vercel / Netlify-style deploy platforms.</li> <li>Managed an open-source developer tool with an active community and a frequent release cadence.</li> <li>Shipped developer workflows for AI coding agents (CLI-first tooling, agent skills, MCP), or AI-assisted authoring.</li> <li>Have managed managers or multiple teams (~15 to 20+ engineers), owned a multi-year platform strategy, and grown tech leads and managers.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/databricks">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://x.com/databricks">X</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@Databricks">YouTube</a>, and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/databricksinc/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong></span>At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/154un3e8Xav4BceOSlcYFZRGEuQI54xMxVydRwQn54eQ/edit?usp=sharing">here</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p> <p>At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.</p> <p><strong>Compliance</strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.</span></strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Data Governance Director F/H (CDI)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><h3>Who Are We?</h3> <p>WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build a better future for our people, planet, clients, and communities. For more information, visit <a href="https://wpp.com/" target="_blank">wpp.com</a>.</p> <p>WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a media-rich world, we bring together the best platform, the best talent, and the best partners to develop the most innovative solutions, delivering unparalleled growth for our clients. For more information, visit <a href="https://wppmedia.com/" target="_blank">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It is through this synergy that we create truly exceptional experiences, both for our clients and for our internal teams. To succeed in this role, it is fundamental to embody the core values that unite WPP and WPP Media:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Extraordinary:</strong> Fostering collective leadership that inspires truly transformational creativity.</li> <li><strong>Create an Open Environment:</strong> Striking the perfect balance between employee fulfillment and client satisfaction, all built on mutual trust.</li> <li><strong>Lead with Optimism:</strong> Actively driving growth and development to energize our entire organization.</li> </ul> <h3>Missions & Responsibilities</h3> <p>The Data Governance Director enforces global data standards, taxonomy integrity, and compliance across all luxury Maisons and markets, while ensuring data directly serves business and media performance objectives. Moving beyond purely operational data checks, this role bridges data control and strategic activation. The Director is responsible for transitioning data operations into an automated Prevention–Monitoring–Correction framework, challenging and simplifying existing processes, and leading/up-skilling the Data & Tech team to ensure data is structured, trusted, and actionable for global reporting, Optimus dashboards, and WPP Open integrations.</p> <p>As the Data Governance Director, you will enforce global data standards, taxonomy integrity, and compliance across all luxury Maisons and markets. You will bridge data control and strategic activation by transitioning data operations from manual checks to an automated Prevention–Monitoring–Correction framework. You will lead and elevate the Data & Tech team to guarantee clean, structured, and actionable data for global reporting, Optimus dashboards, and WPP Open integrations.</p> <h4>1. Data Governance & Strategy</h4> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Alignment:</strong> Align data collection directly with business and media objectives, ensuring data is consistent, structured, and actionable across all activation and analytics teams.</li> <li><strong>Critical Thinking & Process Simplification:</strong> Actively challenge existing processes, taxonomies, and naming conventions to eliminate complexity and propose simpler, more scalable, and effective approaches.</li> <li><strong>Framework & Model Ownership:</strong> Build, own, and execute the end-to-end Prevention–Monitoring–Correction data model.</li> <li><strong>Annual Taxonomy Review:</strong> Lead the yearly cycle for global taxonomy review, cleanup, and integration of new data dimensions across all Maisons.</li> <li><strong>Naming Conventions:</strong> Enforce standardized naming conventions globally, including unique Campaign IDs to enable automated campaign record aggregation via Accutics or internal systems.</li> </ul> <h4>2. title: Growth Director
description: <p><strong>Growth Director<br></strong>Amsterdam/Rotterdam, hybrid</p> <p><em>DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.</em></p> <p><strong>JOB PURPOSE</strong></p> <p><em>This role is part of our</em><strong><em> Experience & Engineering</em></strong><em> team based in the Netherlands. We combine our skills in developing future-ready technical solutions with our expertise in creating beautiful designs to deliver exceptional and engaging digital experiences that build lasting relationships with our clients like Gant, Inter Milan, bol.com and Just Eat Takeaway.</em></p> <p>We are looking for a Growth Director who is hungry to build something. In this role, you will identify and develop new business opportunities for our Netherlands team, helping ambitious brands solve complex digital challenges through the combined power of technology, design, and strategy.</p> <p>If you thrive on finding the right clients, crafting compelling pitches, and seeing your work turn into lasting partnerships, this role is for you.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO:</strong></p> <p><strong>Client Engagement & Relationship Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and nurture relationships with marketing and technology decision-makers at prospect organisations, translating their challenges into clear, compelling solutions.</li> <li>Represent DEPT® with confidence in client conversations, demonstrating knowledge across digital experience, engineering, and emerging technologies like AI.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Sales & Pipeline Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proactively identify and qualify new business opportunities through direct outreach, events, partnerships, and collaboration with the marketing team.</li> <li>Manage your own pipeline end-to-end, from first contact to signed proposal.</li> <li>Use CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) to track activity, report on progress, and develop good habits around forecasting and pipeline hygiene.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Collaboration & Pitching</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work closely with delivery leads, solution architects, and strategists to build proposals and pitches that showcase DEPT®'s strengths.</li> <li>Develop familiarity with our key technology partners (e.g., Shopify, Adobe, Optimizely) and understand how those partnerships create opportunities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU BRING:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Previous experience in business development, consultative sales, or a client-facing role with a strong commercial component, within a digital agency, tech consultancy, or related environment.</li> <li>Experience selling project-based work, with exposure to digital experience, content management and publishing, ecommerce, or technology services. Familiarity with solutions like CMS, PIM, DAM, or content supply chain is a plus.</li> <li>Comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders at manager and director level, with the ambition to grow into C-level conversations over time.</li> <li>A structured approach to prospecting and pipeline management, you know how to keep deals moving.</li> <li>Strong communicator who can explain complex ideas in straightforward, client-friendly language.</li> <li>Collaborative by nature, you enjoy working across teams and bringing people together around a pitch.</li> <li>Fluency in Dutch and English language </li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exposure to digital experience platforms, ecommerce solutions, or cloud/technology services.</li> <li>Familiarity with multi-stakeholder sales cycles and how to navigate them.</li> <li>Interest in how AI and emerging technology are reshaping digital services.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WE OFFER:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A flexible, hybrid working policy (2-3 days from the office, depending on location) and the opportunity to work from abroad for 13 weeks a year. </li> <li>24 vacation days per year and the possibility to buy an unlimited number of extra vacation days.</li> <li>DEPT®/YOU Learning Menu and DEPT®/YOU Special Programs. Develop your skills with courses and programs tailored to your needs.</li> <li>Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform, gym and wellness discounts, and healthy lunches at the office.</li> <li>Get a discount on your lease bike and ride in style. You can also enjoy hassle free-commutes with an NS Business Card. </li> <li>A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021, has been named a <a href="https://www.greatplacetowork.nl/en/certification/certified/dept">Great Place To Work since 2022</a> in the Netherlands and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.</li> <li>Awesome clients. Whether big, small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with all of them. And we celebrate all of our successes together!</li> <li>You can discover even more employee benefits <a href="https://www.deptagency.com/nl-nl/employee-benefits/">here</a>.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHY DEPT®?</strong></p> <p>We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.</p> <p>We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.</p> <p>At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.</p> <p><strong>DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION </strong></p> <p>At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.</p> <p>Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.</p> <p>We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.<br><br>Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts <a href="https://www.deptagency.com/the-good-company/">here</a>.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.</p> <p>Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is open to candidates residing in Netherlands</p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world:</strong> Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.</li> <li><strong>You thrive the most when solving problems:</strong> Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.</li> <li><strong>You are a natural relationship builder:</strong> Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.</li> <li><strong>You are the architect of your own career:</strong> If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.</li> <li><strong>You want to be with the best: </strong>At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.</li> </ul> <p><strong>In this role, you will: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts</li> <li>Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident</li> <li>Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives</li> <li>Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat</li> <li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices</li> <li>Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response</li> <li>Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal</li> <li>Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara’s investigation processes, with proficiency in Python</li> <li>Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis</li> <li>Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams</li> <li>Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux</li> <li>Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews</li> <li>Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services</li> <li>Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.</li> <li>This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations</li> <li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience</li> <li>GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification</li> <li>Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p> <p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p> <p><strong>Flexible Working </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.</span></p> <p><strong>Belonging at Samsara</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations </strong></p> <p>Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email <a ---------- or <a href="https://forms.gle/DrM6DFQUiSgfPtCVA">click here</a> if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Authenticity</strong></p> <p>We use <a href="https://hiretofu.com/privacyPolicy">Tofu</a>, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s <a href="https://www.samsara.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice">Candidate Privacy Notice</a> for more information.</p> <p><strong>Fraudulent Employment Offers</strong></p> <p>Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our <a href="https://samsara.com/blog/avoiding-fake-job-offers">blog post here</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer. Eindelijk kun je de theorie in de praktijk toepassen: jij hebt er zin in, en wij ook! Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam krijg jij de kans om midden in de actie te staan. Geen koffie halen of papierwerk, jij duikt samen met onze projectleider in de praktijk van energietransitie en energie-armoede. Of het nu gaat om het uitvoeren van inspecties of meedenken over interventies: jij maakt impact. Dit wordt jouw stage Wil jij meedenken over een maatschappelijk vraagstuk dat steeds urgenter wordt? Tijdens deze stage duik je in het thema energiearmoede: wat is het precies, waar speelt het en wat betekent dit voor ons als organisatie? Je werkt op het snijvlak van sociaal en technisch en helpt ons om richting te bepalen: hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Je werkt mee binnen één van onze teams en wordt begeleid door een ervaren collega. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om echt impact te maken. Op dit moment hebben wij één afstudeerstageplek rondom het thema energietransitie en energie-armoede Wat ga je doen? Je gaat onderzoeken wat energiearmoede inhoudt en hoe dit zich uit in de praktijk, met name in stedelijke gebieden zoals Amsterdam waar veel (sociale) huurwoningen zijn. Je houdt je bezig met: Het in kaart brengen van wat energiearmoede betekent; Inzicht krijgen in waar het speelt en welke doelgroepen geraakt worden; Gesprekken voeren met corporaties en marktpartijen (interviews, ophalen van ervaringen en data); Onderzoeken welke oplossingen er zijn, zoals passief bouwen, minder installaties of slimme energieoplossingen; Vertalen van jouw inzichten naar een duidelijke visie: waar moeten wij ons op richten en hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Het gaat hierbij niet om de techniek alleen, maar juist om de combinatie van sociale impact, marktontwikkelingen en strategie. Dit is jouw team Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam is een ontwikkelende bouwer met zo'n 220 enthousiaste collega’s. Wij zijn onderdeel van de Divisie Bouw en Vastgoed en herkenbaar in groen en geel. Onze ambitie is groot en met veel enthousiasme ontwikkelen en bouwen we gezonde en fijne leefomgevingen, waar mensen zich thuis voelen. Benieuwd waar wij ons mee bezig houden? Bekijk hier een paar van onze huidige projecten: Projecten Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam Dit bieden wij jou Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week; Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven; Tijd voor je schoolopdrachten/examens; De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer; Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan! Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijnvisie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. title: Data Platform Manager

The data you will work with is physical — parts, build progress, shortages, non-conformances — and the questions asked of it get harder each year as we grow. If you want a platform you can still shape rather than one already set in concrete, this is a good moment to arrive. What You'll Do Own the architecture of our Microsoft Fabric estate end to end — OneLake, our lakehouses and their bronze, silver, and gold layers, workspace and domain structure, naming conventions, and the standards that keep it coherent as it grows. Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of data engineers: set priorities, review code, raise the technical bar, and develop the people. Stay hands-on. You will build pipelines, notebooks, and Delta tables yourself, not only direct others who do. Own the integrations that land data in OneLake from our source systems — ERP, HR, shopfloor, quality, and the business applications that come after them — choosing sensibly between Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, shortcuts, and mirroring for each source. Own the gold layer and the semantic models built on it, so that Power BI reads from one governed source rather than from copies scattered around the business. Work closely with our Business Operations & Data Specialists, who represent the business owners of each domain: turn their requirements into the right gold tables, agree definitions with them, and give them a platform they can query, validate, and explain to the business with confidence. Own lineage across the estate: know what feeds what, be able to prove it to an auditor, and make dependencies visible rather than tribal knowledge. Build the data foundation for our AI programme — the lakehouse structures, pipelines, and knowledge graph behind our Fabric data agents and our Company Brain — and deliver it to a standard that can be trusted with a real question. Design and maintain the OneLake security and access model together with your team: workspace roles, access groups, and the controls that decide who sees what in the lake. Keep the platform reliable, observable, and cost-aware: monitoring, alerting, recovery, and disciplined use of our Fabric capacity — including knowing what a runaway notebook costs us. If your depth is in Azure Synapse, Databricks, or Data Lake Storage Gen2 and you have since moved onto Fabric in earnest, we will take that seriously. Strong command of the medallion pattern and of Delta Lake in practice: partitioning, schema evolution, table maintenance, and why a gold table behaves the way it does. Genuinely hands-on. Strong SQL, solid PySpark, and comfort building and orchestrating pipelines yourself. This is not a role that stops at diagrams. Practical understanding of Fabric capacity: how workloads consume it, how to spot what is burning it, and how to keep the platform inside its envelope. title: Business Operations & Data Specialist (Finance)
description: About the role Every number that reaches our leadership team, our board, and our auditors has to be right the first time — and that is where you come in. Automate what is manual today: turn recurring spreadsheet work, audit packs, and month-end routines into repeatable processes that largely run themselves. Improve the finance processes and system configuration that create the data, working with the finance team and our ERP specialists, so that issues are fixed at source rather than corrected every month. Help the finance team get more from the tools through training and self-service, so they can answer their own questions. Requirements What You’ll Need Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, Economics, or a related field. A track record of simplifying or automating a process, not only reporting on it. Experience supporting an external audit, or working in a multi-entity, multi-currency international group, is a strong advantage. Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus. Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is preferred. Who You Are You are precise, and you are curious about where a number came from before you are comfortable reporting it — whether that means reading the ledger or querying the lakehouse. You know the difference between a figure that looks right and a figure that can be traced back to its source, and you care about the second one. You are not content to rebuild the same report every month. When something is manual, repetitive, or fragile, your instinct is to go upstream and fix it rather than absorb it. title: Head of Product
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. The opportunity Our engineering teams build a product that enterprises run their purchase-to-pay and order-to-cash processes on every day. Much of the product knowledge behind it sits with our founders and domain experts. As we grow, we are moving from a project-oriented model, where features come top-down and success is measured by output, to a product-oriented one: empowered teams that own problems end-to-end and are measured by their impact on customers and the business. As Head of Product, you lead that shift. You build the product management practice for the BLP Platform from an early stage. Our first product managers are joining stream-aligned teams, starting with Invoice and Procurement, and the team will grow to 4–5 PMs as we expand. You hire them, coach them, and set the standard for what great product work looks like at BLP. You report to the CTO and work closely with Engineering, Projects, Sales, and our founders. What you’ll do Build and lead the product management practice for the BLP Platform: hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers as we scale. Move the product organization from an output-driven model to an outcome-driven one. Establish the product management craft at BLP: discovery practices, evidence-based decision making, and a clear standard for what “good” looks like in the role. Transfer product knowledge out of the experts’ heads and into the teams, without losing the domain depth that got us here. Build the direct line between our teams and our customers. Make our data usable for product decisions. We have BigQuery, PostHog, and prediction-rate analytics available, and we want product managers who reach for them by default. Shape how the product organization works as we grow: intake, prioritization, roadmapping, and the operating rhythm. Contribute directly to product strategy for the platform. What you bring 10+ years in product management, including experience leading or formally coaching product managers, with a real point of view on how product people are developed. Experience working in an empowered product model, where teams were assigned problems to solve rather than features to build. A track record of shipping enterprise B2B software that customers actually adopted. Experience moving an organization toward an empowered product model, including the political and cultural side of it. The ability to hold a position with engineers, sales, and executives, and to say no in a way that keeps the relationship. Entrepreneurial judgment: comfortable operating with incomplete information, choosing a direction, and owning the result. Fluent English. Enterprise ERP or finance exposure, experience with AI or agentic products in production (particularly reliability, evaluation, and trust in enterprise settings), and German are a plus. Why BLP Build a function: you shape how product management works at BLP while the team grows. Direct work with the CTO and founders on product strategy for the platform. A product with deep domain substance and a large enterprise customer base to learn from. Employee participation plan. How we work Impact: We create measurable business outcomes. Transparency: We build trust through openness. Ownership: We take responsibility for outcomes. Excellence: We relentlessly strive for greatness. Practical information Location: hybrid from our Zurich, London, Munich or Cologne offices, or remote elsewhere in Europe. Employment: full-time, permanent. title: Senior R&D Engineer/Projectleider Flight Test and Certification (m/v/x)
description: Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende baan in de wereld van de lucht- en ruimtevaart? En.....ben je die R&D engineer die helpt civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Door aan vliegtuigen te meten en te testen om alles te weten te komen? Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie, veiligheid en duurzaamheid? Dan spreken we je graag! Wat ga je doen? Als Senior R&D engineer Flight Test en Certificatie werk je mee aan het veiliger, duurzamer en competitiever maken van de militaire en civiele luchtvaart. Je werkt aan vliegtuigen, helikopters en onbemande vliegende systemen. Om onze binnen- en buitenlandse opdrachtgevers te ondersteunen in het bereiken van hun doelen voer je testen uit en analyseert de resultaten, je toetst wijzigingen aan vliegtuigen aan de regelgeving in het kader van veilig vliegen en je ontwikkelt nieuwe regelgeving om innovatieve technieken te implementeren. Je bedenkt en werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen samen met collega’s en andere R&D instituten in een (inter-) nationale setting. Je leidt projecten, hebt veel klantcontact (intern en extern) en werkt met zelfsturende teams, in wisselende samenstelling. Je voert projectwerk uit, je coördineert werkpakketten en je initieert met je collega’s nieuwe projecten. Het werken bij Koninklijke NLR kenmerkt zich door variatie en dynamische werkverbanden. Onze missie is om nieuwe technologie praktisch en veilig toepasbaar te maken en daarmee de Nederlandse (en Europese) industrie en overheid te helpen om voorop te lopen. We geven goed onderbouwde adviezen aan beleidsbepalers, ontwikkelaars en gebruikers. Wat breng je mee? Afgeronde WO master in een technische richting zoals luchtvaarttechniek, elektrotechniek of informatica; Tenminste 5 jaren relevante werkervaring; Ontwikkeling van lucht- en ruimtevaarttuigen en klimaat neutrale luchtvaart spreken je aan als werkgebieden; De ambitie om expert te worden op het gebied van flight test en certificatie; Affiniteit met werken voor Defensie, en liefst kennis van de Defensie organisatie; Bewezen capaciteiten als projectleider voor grote projecten; In staat zijn om klantenwensen te vertalen en een brug te slaan tussen techniek en operationele impact; Positieve instelling, initiatiefrijk, flexibel, resultaatgericht; Communicatief vaardig in het Nederlands en Engels (tenminste op C1 niveau) Wat bieden wij jou? Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightech omgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé. Verder bieden wij jou onder anderen: 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek); 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer; Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA, als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden; De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken. Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving De afdeling Flight Test en Certificatie (ASTC) richt zich op het ondersteunen van de Nederlandse overheid (Defensie, EZK, IenW) en markt waarin thema’s als "bescherming van de samenleving" en “Klimaat neutrale luchtvaart” belangrijke uitgangspunten zijn. We voeren experimenten en vliegproeven uit met onze eigen vliegtuigen, geschaalde vliegtuigen en drones. We ondersteunen vliegproeven met vliegtuigen van klanten. Dit kan zijn voor een onderzoeksprogramma’s of om te bewijzen dat we radicale en nieuwe concepten op een veilige manier effectiever en sneller kunnen certificeren. We zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor modificaties aan onze research vliegtuigen en bewijzen dat deze veilig zijn. We zijn georganiseerd in twee marktgeoriënteerde teams, Flight Test Support en Certification Support. Veel collega’s zijn in beide teams actief en werken vaak buiten de afdeling in multi-disciplinair verband. Er worden goede mogelijkheden geboden om je eigen ontwikkeling vorm te geven. Wat betekent werken bij NLR? Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving. Wil jij meer weten? title: Senior Program Manager, EL2 European Tour

At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. title: Sales Development Representative

Willingness to roll up your sleeves and “Leave your ego at the door” mentality Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced startup environment. From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy. How we use AI at Tebi We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.
