title: Defense Success Manager, France
description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As a Defense Success Manager, you own what happens to our most strategic defense and sovereign accounts after the build: you make deployed AI stick in real workflows — often in restricted or disconnected environments — keep production commitments healthy, defend renewals, and source the expansion signals that Sales closes. Mistral's Solutions teams (Deployment Strategists and Forward Deployed Engineers) co-create high-value AI use cases with customers in these environments. Your job is to make those investments successful beyond delivery — adopting what has been built, operating it with confidence, demonstrating its impact, and scaling value across the institution. You will work with mission owners, program stakeholders, end users, security and IT teams, and across Mistral with Solutions, Product, Engineering and Support. This is not a high-volume, ticket-queue customer success role. Portfolios are small and deep — typically one or two flagship accounts plus a small number of adjacent programs. It calls for a strategic account mindset, the technical judgment to navigate complex and constrained deployment environments, and the energy to build the customer success function as Mistral grows. Travel to customer sites, including secure facilities, is a regular part of the job. You will join on one of two tracks (and can move between them): Adoption track — embedded in flagship programs while Solutions is still delivering. You own the adoption and change-management motion around the build: user waves, enablement, champions, training programs, and the evidence that proves value is landing. Operational track — you take accounts through a structured handover once Solutions completes delivery, and own the run phase end-to-end: operational health, value realization, renewals, and expansion signals. In both tracks you operate in close partnership with Solutions: they deliver and hand over; you own post-handover; they re-engage on expansion signals. Occasionally, account teams will also pull you into late-stage pre-sales — authoring the customer training and scale-up plan that gives a buyer confidence in the rollout. What You Will Do Own the customer success and value plan Build a clear view of each account's objectives, stakeholders, deployed use cases, commitments and risks. Translate it into a shared success plan with owners, milestones and measurable outcomes. Establish a practical operating cadence with customer sponsors, business owners, IT and delivery teams. Lead success reviews that make progress, risks, decisions and next steps clear. Define a baseline and track the outcomes that matter for each use case: adoption and usage against entitled seats, customer satisfaction, operational health and business impact. Turn the evidence into a clear value narrative. Make deployment realities part of the success plan Understand how each customer's deployment model — on-premises, VPC or serverless — affects the products and use cases they can access, operate and scale. Validate the specifics with the technical teams rather than assuming feature parity or identical operating models. Identify the practical implications of deployment choices: security and data requirements, access and integrations, release and upgrade cadence, available features, capacity, observability and support processes. Explain the trade-offs clearly to customer and Mistral stakeholders. Translate those constraints into an actionable adoption plan: align enablement and release communications with the version the customer actually runs, account for security approvals and upgrade windows, and agree how to measure usage when telemetry is limited. Spot risks early, qualify their impact on adoption, renewal or value, and coordinate the right Solutions, Product, Engineering or Support owners to resolve them. Set clear expectations without making unvalidated technical or roadmap commitments. Drive adoption, autonomy and sustained value Help customer teams move from a delivered use case to regular, effective use. Identify the users, workflows and change-management needs that determine whether it sticks. Coordinate onboarding, training, product updates and hands-on enablement with the right Mistral and customer teams. Develop customer champions and train-the-trainer motions so adoption scales beyond direct Mistral involvement. Prepare the transition from delivery to run: clarify operational ownership, support and escalation paths, and the resources users need to succeed independently. Monitor adoption and customer health, investigate where usage or value is falling short, and lead a coordinated plan to address the causes. Defend and grow the commercial relationship Own the renewal motion for your accounts: know every renewal date, the auto vs non-auto renewal terms, and the risk story behind each one. Run the renewal play early — no surprises at renewal time. Track and improve account NRR. Identify new use cases, teams and expansion opportunities, and share them with the account team grounded in demonstrated value. Lead business reviews with the account team: value delivered, risks owned, decisions needed, roadmap asks. Bring the customer voice into Mistral Gather and qualify feedback from users, technical teams and sponsors. Distinguish enablement needs from product gaps, deployment constraints and support issues, and route each to the right owner. Track important requests and communicate progress and limitations back to the customer, while Product and Engineering retain ownership of product and technical decisions. Build the company as well as the account Create the playbooks, success plans, handover practices and measurement approaches that are missing. Test them with customers, improve them, and make them reusable across accounts. Bring structure to ambiguity: identify what needs to happen, make a plan, mobilize the right people and follow through — without waiting for a perfect process or detailed instructions. Roughly a fifth of your time is protected, rotating build time for exactly this work; it is part of the job, not extra to it. What We're Looking For 5+ years of experience owning outcomes for enterprise or institutional customers of technical products or deployed solutions — adoption and commercial outcomes (retention, renewal, expansion), not relationship management or activity reporting. Strong technical fluency in secure enterprise deployment models. You can identify what a deployment type (on-premise, disconnected, air-gapped) means for available features, telemetry, upgrades and accreditation, and you validate specifics with technical teams instead of assuming parity. Ability to engage credibly with architects, engineers, IT and security stakeholders, while translating technical trade-offs into clear implications for mission owners and executives. You know when to bring in a deeper technical expert. Comfort operating under security, compliance and confidentiality constraints , including restricted or classified environments and strict information-handling rules. Strong ownership and builder energy. You have created structure or improved a process in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and are motivated to build a company, not wait for clear directions. Excellent communication, stakeholder management and execution skills. You align teams without formal authority, surface risks early and drive decisions through to completion Analytical and commercially minded: you can define meaningful success metrics with imperfect data, assess customer health, and are comfortable carrying renewal and NRR accountability. Nice to have Experience serving defense, public sector or critical infrastructure customers, including sovereign or classified programs. Experience with AI, machine learning, data platforms or complex enterprise software, including production deployments in regulated or security-sensitive environments. Experience working alongside deployment, engineering or professional services teams on custom use cases, and the transition from implementation to ongoing operation. Familiarity with public procurement, framework agreements and multi-year option structures. Security & Compliance criteria Eligibility: must hold citizenship in the target territory (France for now). Clearable: must meet all local requirements for high-level security clearance (e.g. no criminal record, fulfillment of national service obligations). Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. Partnership development: You help build relationships with important players in the ecosystem, such as rating agencies, registries, NGOs and other opinion leaders. We are looking for a dynamic and dedicated candidate who is comfortable with multi-tasking and prioritization in a fast-paced, product-first environment with close attention to detail, accuracy, and timeliness. </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Calendar & Conflict Management:</strong> Proactively manage complex calendars with a strong understanding of business priorities. Independently resolve scheduling conflicts and anticipate meeting requests and logistical needs before they are explicitly stated. </li> <li><strong>Travel & Logistics:</strong> Manage and coordinate complex international and domestic travel, including visa and passport needs, as well as end-to-end logistical arrangements for executives and teams.</li> <li><strong>Executive Support & Business Context:</strong> Develop a deeper understanding of the managers' roles, our products, and the broader market and context for Cloudflare. Recognize where operational processes can be improved and actively suggest and implement those process improvements.</li> <li><strong>Meetings & Event Planning:</strong> Coordinate and assist with large meetings, external stakeholders, and event planning with precision.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Requirements</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>6+</strong> years experience as an Administrative Assistant, in Ops, or equivalent experience.</li> <li><strong>Scope & Judgment:</strong> A seasoned professional with proven experience handling problems of diverse scope and demonstrating excellent judgment in selecting administrative and operational methods.</li> <li><strong>Proactiveness & Autonomy:</strong> Strong sense of urgency, proactiveness, and the ability to manage your own time with limited or no supervision.</li> <li><strong>Communication & Networking:</strong> Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to network and build strong relationships with executives and team members.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Skills:</strong> Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.</li> <li><strong>Mindset:</strong> A "no task is too small" attitude combined with the strategic mindset needed to anticipate executive needs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Drive: Experience working in a tech and AI-native, product-led environment.</strong></h2> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level.</p> <p>Estimated Salary for New York:  $114,000 - 157,000</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. As part of our explosive growth, we are looking for a Principal, Platform Storytelling to shape how developers, technical leaders, and the broader AI ecosystem understand our platform, and why they should build on it.</p> <p>This is a high-impact, foundational individual contributor role within Developer GTM. You can move from a conversation with an engineer to a positioning brief to a keynote opening, and make each one better because you understand the others. As an early member of this team, you will have the autonomy to experiment, learn what resonates, and establish repeatable ways to turn our product momentum into market momentum.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Platform Positioning & Narrative:</strong> Develop the overarching positioning for Cloudflare’s Developer Platform. Develop keynotes, presentations, essays, and other executive communications that express a distinctive, technically grounded point of view. Build credibility through substance.<br><strong>Sales & Partner Enablement:</strong> Translate platform positioning into compelling pitch narratives and competitive differentiation for field and partner teams. Partner with Customer Strategy & Storytelling to ground our claims in customer proof, and with enablement teams to make the strongest narratives repeatable.</li> <li><strong>Market & Developer Insights:</strong> Stay close to developers, customers, the field, and the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem. Understand what people are building, where they get stuck, and how they evaluate alternatives. Turn those insights into messaging and recommendations that inform product and GTM strategy.</li> <li><strong>Impact & Measurement:</strong> Establish success measures to evaluate whether our work improves message comprehension, earns relevant developer engagement, supports cross-product activation and usage, and helps the field win.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <p><strong>First 30 days:</strong><strong><br></strong>Establish key relationships, use the products, consume an inordinate amount of content about our platform and the market, and listen to developers and field teams. You can explain where our story is compelling and where it breaks down. You’ve shipped your first meaningful piece of writing.</p> <p><strong>First 6 months:</strong><strong><br></strong>Establish a clear platform narrative and put it to work across priority launches, executive communications, and developer-facing channels. Product and GTM teams are using your positioning because it makes their work sharper. We are hitting a new level of clarity for the platform story that makes each product’s story stronger.</p> <p><strong>First year:</strong><strong><br></strong>Cloudflare’s Developer Platform has a more recognizable point of view and a clearer place in the developer and AI ecosystem. Our launches build on one another rather than telling disconnected product stories. Executive voices reinforce the same strategy without sounding scripted. Your work is measurably helping developers understand, choose, and build on the platform, and helping our field teams turn that interest into commercial impact.</p> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <p><em><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don’t need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</span></em></p> <ul> <li><strong>Product Marketing Experience:</strong> 8–10 years of experience in product marketing, technical marketing, or a related role, including meaningful ownership of positioning and adoption for developer-first products. You have an instinct for which value propositions we should lead with, for which audiences, and why. You have a demonstrated ability to turn a complex portfolio into a clear, differentiated platform story.</li> <li><strong>Technical Fluency:</strong> 5+ years working with developer tools, APIs, cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML products. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable trying products, reading technical documentation, understanding architectural tradeoffs, and asking questions that earn engineers’ trust.</li> <li><strong>Writing & Editorial Excellence:</strong> Exceptional writing, editing, and presentation skills, with work that demonstrates range across technical, commercial, and executive audiences. Strong judgment about what to say and what to leave out.</li> <li><strong>Developer & AI Instincts:</strong> Curiosity about how software is being built and how AI is changing it. You naturally follow products, competitors, and developer conversations. An instinct for what will “hit” on Hacker News and X.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Builder:</strong> Proven ability to work cross-functionally without direct authority and to navigate ambiguity. A love of chaos and comfort doing unscalable things.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $164,000 - $200,000</li> <li>For NYC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $156,000 - $190,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Graduate Risk Analyst
description: <p>Your IMC journey begins with a three-week Global Trainee Program led by our seasoned engineers and traders, during which you’ll link up with graduates from all IMC regions: Europe, the United States, India and Asia-Pacific. During this traineeship, you’ll learn more about IMC, the basics of trading and options theory. Training continues back at your local office, where you’ll receive support from a dedicated mentor. As a Graduate Risk Analyst, you operate at the beating heart of our business: in the dealing room of IMC’s Amsterdam office. Your work supports IMC’s critical day-to-day risk management activities, including the monitoring and analysis of our markets, as well as our credit, liquidity, and operational risks. What happens next is up to you!</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>YOUR CORE RESPONSIBILTIES </strong></p> <ul> <li>Become an expert in options, financial markets, and how IMC applies algorithmic trading as a market maker</li> <li>Contribute to the ongoing development of IMC’s proprietary risk management systems, together with our Engineers</li> <li>Analyse developments in the markets in which we trade and identify risks and opportunities</li> <li>Be an integral part of your team by advising on limit requests, monitoring intraday and overnight risks, and discussing key exposures with our trading desks</li> </ul> <p><strong>YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recent or upcoming graduates seeking to join IMC full-time in February 2027</li> </ul> <ul> <li>An academic background in Mathematics, Physics and/or Econometrics or a related field</li> <li>Proficiency in a programming language is preferred (Python, MATLAB or R)</li> </ul> <ul> <li>First-class analytical skills and a desire to solve complicated problems creatively</li> <li>A genuine interest in financial markets</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Please note: If you have already applied for this position during the current recruitment season and were not selected, you may reapply when the next recruitment season begins in Summer 2027. We encourage you to focus on enhancing your skillset before reapplying.</p> <p> </p> <p>Due to current U.S. immigration and visa restrictions, some candidates may not be eligible to obtain the U.S. business visa required as part of our Global Traineeship Programme. As the programme includes mandatory training in the United States shortly after joining, we are unfortunately unable to proceed with applications from candidates who are unable to obtain the required visa within the programme timeline.</p> <p> <br>If you are a dual passport holder of another nationality or a European citizen who wants to relocate back to Europe, you remain welcome to apply and should inform our campus recruitment team of your situation: <a ---------- class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Us</strong></p> <p><em>IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.</em></p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Cassandra, Timescale) and key-value stores (eg., Redis) </li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $157,000 - $196,000</li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For New York based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $187,000 </span></li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Director of Finance - Ecosystem
description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover. Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale. The Opportunity The Strategic Finance, Planning & Analysis team drives financial performance management across Prosus's global ecosystems - partnering with operating companies and Group Finance to ensure targets are met and capital is deployed effectively. The EU ecosystem team sits at the centre of Prosus's ambition to build a leading lifestyle e-commerce platform in Europe, and this Director role is the financial engine behind that ambition. You'll own the full Strategic FP&A function for Prosus's European portfolio, managing the annual budgeting, planning, and forecasting cycle across a multi-entity, multi-country ecosystem, and leading the operating cadences that keep business unit CFOs, ecosystem leads, and Group Finance aligned. Within your first 60 days, you'll have established a working rhythm with every BU and minority investment finance team in the region. Within your first quarter, you'll hold full ownership of the EU ecosystem budgeting and forecasting cycle. This is an active moment for the portfolio. M&A and divestiture activity is ongoing, and you'll be a direct contributor to at least one strategic transaction within your first year, not as a reviewer, but as a hands-on partner to the ecosystem leads driving those decisions. The team you'll lead is five to six direct reports; developing their capabilities and raising the bar on finance practice across the BU finance teams is as much a part of the role as the numbers themselves. This isn't a reporting function. This is financial leadership for one of Prosus's most strategically significant regions. Who You Are You think in systems and act with precision. You're comfortable holding the full picture of a complex, multi-entity portfolio while also rolling up your sleeves on the analysis that makes a business case credible or a forecast defensible. Ambiguity doesn't slow you down - you move forward with the information available, surface the brutal facts clearly, and adjust as the picture sharpens. You've built trust with senior stakeholders before - CFOs, business leads, Group Finance counterparts, not just by managing up but by being the person in the room who brings clarity. You give direct, evidence-based points of view and create space for the people around you to do the same. You care about the growth of your team as much as the quality of the output, and you understand that both are how a finance function earns its seat at the table. What You Bring - Deep experience in finance or FP&A at group or multi-entity level, with a background in digital economy, e-commerce, consumer internet, or a closely adjacent sector - Proven ability to lead end-to-end budgeting, forecasting, and planning cycles across complex, matrixed organisations - coordinating multiple finance teams toward a single, coherent view - Hands-on track record analysing financial statements, business cases, and performance data to surface actionable insight for senior decision-makers - Comfortable partnering directly with business unit CFOs and ecosystem leads on strategic projects including M&A, divestiture, and performance benchmarking with the credibility to challenge and the judgement to know when to align - Experience managing and developing a finance team, with a genuine investment in building capability at every level - Fluent English communication, written and spoken, with the ability to translate financial complexity into clear, concise narratives for diverse audiences - Familiarity with Group Finance functions (tax, treasury, reporting, consolidation) and how a finance function at this level interfaces with each - Experience with Hyperion or OneStream is a plus - Background in minority investment oversight or portfolio company finance is a plus - Exposure to multi-country or cross-border finance environments in Europe is a plus Your Typical Day Your day might begin with a performance review call with a business unit CFO - working through the latest actuals, flagging variances, and agreeing on the narrative before it reaches Group Finance. From there, you're likely in the detail: a forecast model that needs stress-testing, a business case for a potential acquisition, or a consolidation question that cuts across tax, treasury, and reporting. Throughout the day, your team is moving in parallel - running analyses, preparing materials, coordinating with BU finance counterparts across the EU. You check in, unblock, and give direct feedback. By afternoon, you might be in a working session with an ecosystem lead on a live strategic project, or preparing the ecosystem performance summary that feeds into the Group FP&A cycle. What We Offer - Global Impact: Play a crucial role in shaping the future of global commerce. - Growth Opportunities: Expand your expertise through diverse global challenges and unique opportunities. - Innovative Culture: Join a forward-thinking team that values strategic insights and fosters continuous innovation. - Creative Environment: Engage in work that encourages creativity and constant improvement. - Collaborative Atmosphere: Benefit from autonomy and self-management in a supportive and positive workspace. - Hybrid Work: Experience the satisfaction of our flexible model tailored to balance work and life. - Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a salary package that reflects your skills and contributions. - Comprehensive Benefits: From health and wellness to learning, and everyday perks, we offer a well-rounded package designed to help you thrive at work and beyond. Why Prosus? At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next. Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing. Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page . Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have. Want to know more about life at Prosus? title: Senior Product Manager LogicSteel
description: Senior Product Manager LogicSteel Ben jij een ondernemende Product Manager die kansen ziet waar anderen ze nog niet zien? Krijg jij energie van het doorgronden van complexe productieprocessen en weet je deze te vertalen naar slimme, innovatieve softwareoplossingen? Wil jij de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, richting te geven aan productontwikkeling en écht impact te maken binnen een internationale, dynamische organisatie? Dan is dit jouw kans! Wat ga je doen? Als Senior Product Manager LogicSteel ben jij dé drijvende kracht achter het doorgronden van productieprocessen en het vertalen daarvan naar slimme oplossingen binnen LogicSteel. LogicSteel is ons cloud-based software platform voor de staalverwerkende industrie. Middels LogicSteel wordt de ontwerpfase, werkvoorbereiding en productie naadloos met elkaar verbonden. Wat kunnen klanten uit LogicSteel halen? Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het automatisch plannen en inkopen van al het materiaal voor productie, het optimaliseren van het proces voor nesting op basis van voorraad en beschikbaarheid, het realtime volgen van het volledige productieproces én het aansturen van onze machines. In deze sleutelrol duik jij in de productieprocessen van staalbouwers. Je kijkt verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk, staat dicht bij de klant en verdiept je in de stappen en randvoorwaarden voor hun productieproces. Door regelmatig klanten in binnen- en buitenland te bezoeken, krijg je scherp inzicht in de productieprocessen, knelpunten en kansen voor optimalisatie. Hierbij doorgrond je welke stappen bepalend zijn, welke beperkingen een limitatie vormen en waar liggen kansen om slimmer te werken? Deze inzichten vertaal je naar generieke, herbruikbare product-capabilities die in verschillende processen waarde toevoegen – van 3D-modeling tot machinebewegingen. Vervolgens werk je initiatieven uit tot concrete productrequirements waarmee Product Owners aan de slag kunnen. Hierbij werk je intensief samen met multidisciplinaire teams om te zorgen dat software, processen en machines naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. In deze rol houd je continu grip op de voortgang, kwaliteit en impact van LogicSteel-oplossingen, en stuur je waar nodig bij om het beste resultaat te behalen. Maar dat is nog niet alles. Als Product Manager LogicSteel bewaak jij de samenhang binnen het platform. Je zorgt ervoor dat processen, knelpunten, afhankelijkheden en product-capabilities goed worden vastgelegd en gecommuniceerd, zodat Product Owners, engineering en consultancy vanuit hetzelfde beeld werken. Je communiceert helder over de gemaakte keuzes, stemt af met betrokken teams en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een samenhangend LogicSteel-platform. Daarnaast draag je actief bij aan productintroducties en de doorontwikkeling van onze software-oplossingen. Samenvattend bestaan jouw verantwoordelijkheden uit het: doorgronden en structureren van complexe productieprocessen bij staalverwerkende organisaties; bezoeken van (internationale) klanten om processen te begrijpen en nieuwe kansen te identificeren; vertalen van pijnpunten en klanbehoeften naar generieke herbruikbare product-capabilities, van 3D modeling tot machinebewegingen; identificeren waar vergelijkbare capabilities in verschillende processen kunnen worden toegepast; bepalen welke functionaliteiten en innovaties worden ontwikkeld; opstellen van een helder werkpakket met productrequirements voor de Product Owners en het bewaken van de voortgang; intensief samenwerken met Product Owners, Engineers en Consultants om software, processen en machines optimaal op elkaar te laten aansluiten; bewaken van de samenhang binnen LogicSteel en het consistent vastleggen van klantprocessen, knelpunten en capabilities; bijdragen aan succesvolle productintroducties en doorontwikkeling. Wat maakt deze functie zo bijzonder? “Je bent een ondernemer binnen onze onderneming”, aldus collega Luc. Jij verdiept je in de productieprocessen van staalbouwers en ontdekt waar complexe stappen, beperkingen en afhankelijkheden om slimme oplossingen vragen. Je weet die processen te doorgronden en te vertalen naar herbruikbare capabilities die niet alleen één klant helpen, maar binnen het gehele LogicSteel-platform van waarde zijn. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met verschillende disciplines en bouw je dagelijks aan oplossingen die er écht toe doen! Warm en professioneel bad Bij ons werk je niet zomaar voor een bedrijf, maar voor een familiebedrijf waar mensen centraal staan. Je merkt het in alles: de korte lijnen, de betrokkenheid en de ruimte om zelf initiatief te nemen. Ondernemerschap zit in het DNA van de organisatie. Heb je een goed idee? Dan krijg je de vrijheid en het vertrouwen om dit verder te brengen en écht impact te maken. Daarnaast kennen we elkaar, nemen we verantwoordelijkheid en staan we voor elkaar klaar. Dat zie je terug in de manier waarop we samenwerken: teams trekken veel met elkaar op, denken over domeinen heen en zoeken actief de verbinding. Die open en ondersteunende houding zorgt niet alleen voor sterke resultaten, maar ook voor een werksfeer waarin je je snel thuis voelt. Zoals een collega het mooi zegt: “Doordat we er voor elkaar zijn, kunnen we kwaliteit leveren én zorgen we voor een prettige werksfeer – met ruimte voor een gezonde dosis humor en gezelligheid.” Tegelijkertijd is er veel aandacht voor jouw persoonlijke groei. We kijken naar talent, potentie en kwaliteit, en bieden ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en stappen te zetten. Of zoals collega Luc het verwoordt: “Ik ben als stagiaire begonnen en heb de kans gekregen om door te groeien tot eindverantwoordelijke voor de business unit LogicSteel. Kortom, binnen ons bedrijf is veel mogelijk.” Wij vragen Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in Industrial Engineering & Management / Technische Bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Software Engineering, Business IT & Management of een vergelijkbare richting; Relevante werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie; Het vermogen om complexe (productie)processen te ontrafelen, te structureren en inzichtelijk te maken; Een sterk abstractievermogen en het talent om generieke capabilities te herkennen die ook in andere processen bruikbaar zijn; Sterke analytische vaardigheden en het vermogen om processen en afhankelijkheden te vertalen naar heldere, concrete productrequirements; Het vermogen om de samenhang tussen verschillende onderdelen van een softwareplatform te overzien en te bewaken; Het talent om overzicht te behouden omtrent de productontwikkeling; Het vermogen om helder af te stemmen, intern draagvlak te creëren en effectief samen te werken met Product Owners, engineers en consultants; Kennis van productieprocessen in de staalbouw, werkvoorbereiding en/of calculatie is een sterke pre; Een nieuwsgierige, proactieve mindset en de drive om complexe processen steeds slimmer in te richten; Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal; Wij bieden Een brutosalaris tussen €5.301 en €7.460 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring; 40 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband; Flexibele werktijden voor een goede werk-privébalans; Een sleutelrol in het realiseren van onze commerciële productstrategie met internationale impact; Werken in een moderne omgeving op onze Voortman Campus in Rijssen; Ruimte voor eigen ideeën en initiatieven binnen een ambitieus team; Dagelijks een heerlijke lunch in bedrijfsrestaurant Steely’s; Uitstekende doorgroeimogelijkheden en ontwikkelkansen. Ben jij dé Senior Product Manager MRP die we zoeken? Solliciteer dan nu en bouw mee aan onze producten! We are looking for a leader to partner across our organization and own the go-to-market strategy for this business.</p> <p data-path-to-node="5">As Head of GTM, AI Inference, you will serve as key connective tissue between our cutting-edge AI infrastructure, our product teams, and the global market. with the broader developer platform (Workers, R2, D1, Agents SDK).</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="9,2,0">Identify and evaluate customer and partner segments where Cloudflare's inference model economic advantages of our approach.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="11,2,0">Collaborate with Sales and Developer GTM leadership to build repeatable qualification frameworks and deal structures for inference revenue.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Market Intelligence & Cross-Functional Leadership</h3> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="13,0,0">Serve as Cloudflare's primary listener and synthesizer for inference market signals: pricing shifts, competitive moves, model ecosystem changes, and emerging workload patterns.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="13,1,0">Facilitate internal alignment across Gateway / Models Marketplace team to align strategy across both the hosting and consumption sides of the model ecosystem—ensuring our GTM motion is coherent across all channels.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Analytics & Business Rigor</h3> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="15,0,0">Build the analytical foundations for the inference business: unit economics models, customer segmentation frameworks, growth, product-market fit, and revenue quality.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="15,2,0">Utilize data-informed insights to guide strategy, test hypotheses, and adapt approach as market dynamics evolve.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <p>At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. description: ACQUA Basel | Gastronomie, Events & Lifestyle | Basel | Eintritt nach Vereinbarung Du hast Ideen. Du hast ein Auge für Ästhetik. Und du setzt um. Das ACQUA Basel ist mehr als ein Restaurant. In einem ehemaligen Wasserwerk verbinden wir italienische Lebensfreude mit urbanem Lifestyle. Osteria, Bar, Lounge, Garten und Events schaffen einen einzigartigen Ort mitten in Basel. Aufgaben Von der ersten Idee bis zur fertigen Umsetzung. Marketing & Kommunikation: Du planst und koordinierst unsere Marketingaktivitäten, entwickelst Kampagnen und sorgst für einen einheitlichen, hochwertigen Markenauftritt. Social Media: Du betreust unsere Social-Media-Kanäle, entwickelst Contentideen, erstellst Redaktionspläne und veröffentlichst Beiträge, Stories und Reels. Foto & Video: Du stehst selbst hinter der Kamera, fotografierst unsere Gerichte, Drinks, Menschen und Events und produzierst eigenständig ansprechende Videos inklusive Schnitt und Nachbearbeitung. title: Senior Visual Designer
description: At Dyflexis, we help millions of employees worldwide with our workforce management software. From the bakery around the corner to international hotel and retail chains. We move quickly, learn by doing, and continuously improve how we support our customers. As our Senior Visual Designer, you'll take our visual identity and our website to the next level, and help build a brand that matches our ambitions. Nothing is set in stone, and there's a lot we want to build. This is what you'll do Your work is often the first thing a hotel chain or a bakery sees of us, usually on a screen: our website, a campaign, a landing page. You'll shape how Dyflexis looks and feels everywhere and take the brand from consistent to unmistakable. You'll work closely with our Brand Designer, the Marketing team, and UX/UI colleagues. You bring creative ideas, design thinking and a strong eye for digital. You turn business goals into concepts, carry one strong idea through every touchpoint, and know how to win people over with your work. Take our visual identity further: typography, colour, imagery, illustration and motion, into a bold language that works in every market and language we're in. Bring dyflexis.com to the next level: layouts, landing pages and the visual side of the user journey, together with the Product team. Design campaigns, social, ads, landing pages and sales materials that are on brand and on point. You keep the brand sharp in the everyday work, and you make it better every time. Turn business goals into creative concepts and help shape where the brand goes next. Bring design thinking to the table and help shape where the brand goes next, together with marketing, sales and product. Win people over. Present your ideas to colleagues and leadership, and handle feedback from many stakeholders without losing the idea. title: Senior Medewerker Financiële Administratie
description: GGZ inGeest zoekt een senior medewerker Financiële Administratie in Amsterdam. Als senior medewerker Financiële Administratie ben je verantwoordelijk voor een zorgvuldige uitvoering en bewaking van diverse financiële administratieve processen. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in het waarborgen van de juistheid, volledigheid en tijdigheid van de financiële administratie. Naast de uitvoering van de dagelijkse werkzaamheden analyseer je financiële gegevens, onderzoek je afwijkingen en signaleer je mogelijkheden om processen te optimaliseren. Met jouw expertise draag je bij aan een betrouwbare financiële bedrijfsvoering en een adequate ondersteuning van de organisatie. Waar ga je werken? De afdeling Financiële Administratie bestaat uit 10 enthousiaste medewerkers, inclusief de manager Financiële Administratie, en maakt onderdeel uit van de Directie Financiën. De afdeling is verantwoordelijk voor de controle op en de tijdige, juiste en volledige verwerking van financiële gegevens in het financiële systeem. Vanuit jouw financiële expertise ondersteun je de organisatie bij administratieve en financiële vraagstukken. Hiermee ontlast je behandelaren en andere zorgprofessionals, zodat zij zich kunnen richten op hun primaire werkzaamheden. Wat ga je doen? Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering en bewaking van de debiteurenadministratie. Hieronder vallen onder andere het verzorgen van facturatie, het controleren van openstaande posten, het versturen van aanmaningen en het bewaken van de volledigheid van de facturatie. Je controleert financiële gegevens in AFAS en voert, indien nodig, correcties door. Je stelt financiële informatie beschikbaar voor interne rapportages en levert een bijdrage aan periodieke afsluitingen en aansluitingen met het grootboek. Je analyseert de financiële en projectadministratie, signaleert onvolkomenheden en doet voorstellen ter verbetering van de administratieve processen. Je voert de financiële administratie van samenwerkingsprojecten in het kader van het Integraal Zorgakkoord (IZA) en van subsidieprojecten. Je analyseert verschillen tussen administratieve gegevens en gerealiseerde resultaten en draagt zorg voor een adequate opvolging. Je fungeert als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor financiële vraagstukken met betrekking tot debiteuren, IZA-samenwerkingsprojecten en subsidieprojecten. Wat breng je mee? Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in de richting van financiële administratie, Finance & Control of een vergelijkbare studierichting. Aantoonbare ervaring met debiteurenadministratie en projectadministratie. Bij voorkeur ervaring met de financiële administratie en verantwoording van subsidieprojecten en samenwerkingsprojecten. Kennis van financiële verslaglegging en ervaring met het controleren en analyseren van financiële gegevens. Een nauwkeurige en analytische werkwijze, waarbij je oog hebt voor detail en deadlines. Het vermogen om zelfstandig financiële afwijkingen te analyseren, oorzaken te achterhalen en passende oplossingen te realiseren. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een servicegerichte, professionele houding. Een proactieve instelling en affiniteit met het optimaliseren van financiële administratieve processen. Ook belangrijk Je komt in het team Financiële Administratie op de Overschiestraat in Amsterdam. Een afgeronde HBO-opleiding richting financiële administratie is vereist. De functie is ingeschaald in FWG45 conform CAO GGZ. Je salaris hangt samen met je ervaring We bieden: Een meerkeuzesysteem aan arbeidsvoorwaarden; Een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%; Flinke korting op een sport abonnement; Een fietsregeling; Korting op één van de collectieve ziektekostenverzekeringen; Een gratis abonnement op Cultuur Werkt; Bekijk hier alle arbeidsvoorwaarde n . Als tester speel je een belangrijke rol in de kwaliteit van software. Je onderzoekt applicaties, voert testen uit en kijkt kritisch naar de werking ervan. Kom je iets tegen wat niet klopt? Dan analyseer je wat er aan de hand is en zorg je ervoor dat jouw bevindingen duidelijk bij de juiste mensen terechtkomen. Je hoeft nog geen ervaring te hebben als tester. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je leergierig, analytisch en nauwkeurig bent en graag wilt ontdekken hoe je software steeds beter kunt maken. Wat ga je doen als Junior Tester? Als Junior Tester houd je je bezig met het controleren en beoordelen van de werking en kwaliteit van applicaties en systemen. Je werkt samen met ontwikkelaars, analisten en andere betrokken collega's om ervoor te zorgen dat software goed functioneert en voldoet aan de verwachtingen. Je leert stap voor stap hoe je verschillende soorten testen uitvoert en hoe je bevindingen op een duidelijke manier rapporteert. Concreet zijn jouw werkzaamheden: Opstellen van testscenario's Uitvoeren van testgevallen Controleren of applicaties werken zoals bedoeld Signaleren van fouten, afwijkingen en verbeterpunten Analyseren van testresultaten en bevindingen Registreren en duidelijk communiceren van bevindingen Samenwerken met developers, analisten en andere stakeholders Meedenken over de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van software Leren werken met verschillende testmethodieken en tools Je krijgt gedurende het traineeship de ruimte om praktijkervaring op te doen en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Zo groei je stap voor stap van trainee naar een zelfstandige tester. Binnen het traineeship Business & IT ontwikkel je jezelf in twee jaar tijd tot een echte IT-professional. Je doet direct praktijkervaring op, volgt trainingen en behaalt relevante certificaten die je de rest van je carrière kunt gebruiken. In het eerste jaar leg je een sterke basis in IT, systemen, processen en communicatie. Vanuit daar ontwikkel je jezelf steeds verder binnen jouw vakgebied. Je start met een onboarding op ons kantoor in Bunnik, waar je trainingen volgt en je mede-trainees leert kennen. Daarna start je in je rol als Junior Tester. Gedurende het hele traject krijg je begeleiding van een persoonlijke people manager die je helpt om stappen te maken in je ontwikkeling. Dit bieden wij jou Een startsalaris tussen de €2600 en €2800 Direct een vast contract 25 vakantiedagen & vakantiegeld Reiskostenvergoeding op maat Talloze trainingen en erkende certificaten waarmee je verder bouwt aan je cv Eén-op-één begeleiding gedurende het hele traject Leuke borrels, teamuitjes en evenementen Een fulltime functie van 36 tot 40 uur per week De mogelijkheid om jezelf in twee jaar tijd te ontwikkelen tot een zelfstandige IT-professional Hybride werken is mogelijk, waarbij Assen de vaste werklocatie is en je incidenteel ook op de locaties in Zwolle of Den Haag werkt Voor deze functie vinden we jouw motivatie en ontwikkelpotentieel belangrijker dan een uitgebreid cv. Specifieke werkervaring als tester is dan ook geen vereiste. We zoeken iemand die: Minimaal een HBO diploma heeft Affiniteit heeft met IT, applicaties en digitale processen Analytisch en probleemoplossend kan denken Gemotiveerd is om nieuwe kennis en vaardigheden op te doen Proactief is en graag initiatief neemt Zich wil ontwikkelen binnen het vakgebied softwaretesten Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Electrical Engineer
description: Ben jij een ervaren Electrical Engineer met een passie voor complexe technische gebouwen in de onderzoeks-, onderwijs- en cultuursector? Als Senior Electrical Engineer binnen de Unit Real Estate werk je aan uitdagende en innovatieve projecten waarin techniek, duurzaamheid en maatschappelijke waarde samenkomen. Met jouw technische expertise neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor complexe elektrotechnische ontwerpen, adviseer je opdrachtgevers en deel je jouw kennis met collega’s. De uitdaging Als Senior Electrical Engineer ben je onderdeel van de Unit Real Estate en werk je aan het elektrotechnisch ontwerp binnen uitdagende projecten in de onderwijs-, onderzoeks- en cultuursector. Van nieuwbouw en renovatie tot complexe transformatievraagstukken: jij vertaalt de wensen en eisen van de opdrachtgever naar slimme, duurzame en technisch hoogwaardige oplossingen. Je werkt binnen multidisciplinaire projectteams nauw samen met collega’s vanuit onder andere werktuigbouwkunde, bouwfysica en duurzaamheid. Vanuit jouw ervaring overzie je de samenhang tussen verschillende disciplines, denk je mee over conceptuele keuzes en neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor de technische kwaliteit van het elektrotechnisch ontwerp. Je bent daarnaast een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt binnen projecten. Je adviseert opdrachtgevers en projectteams, begeleidt minder ervaren engineers en draagt actief bij aan het delen en verder ontwikkelen van kennis binnen Deerns. Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: Je ontwikkelt zelfstandig elektrotechnische concepten en ontwerpen voor complexe gebouwen. Je ontwerpt installaties op het gebied van onder andere energievoorziening, verlichting, sterk- en zwakstroom, data, communicatie en beveiliging. Je maakt complexe technische berekeningen en beoordeelt berekeningen en ontwerpen van collega-engineers. Je voert zelfstandig technisch overleg met opdrachtgevers, architecten, uitvoerende partijen en andere betrokken stakeholders. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit en voortgang van jouw werkzaamheden en signaleert tijdig afwijkingen in planning, kwaliteit of budget. Je stelt technische rapportages, bestekken en andere ontwerpdocumenten op en controleert deze. Je begeleidt en coacht minder ervaren engineers binnen projecten en helpt hen zich inhoudelijk verder te ontwikkelen. Je signaleert kansen binnen projecten, denkt mee over aanvullende dienstverlening en levert waar nodig een bijdrage aan offertes en klantgesprekken. Je volgt ontwikkelingen en innovaties binnen het vakgebied en deelt jouw kennis actief met collega’s. Het team Je komt te werken in een hecht team van jong tot oud. Dit team is onderdeel van de Unit Real Estate, die in totaal uit circa 40 collega’s bestaat.Samen werken we aan nieuwbouw-, renovatie- en transformatievraagstukken voor overheden, bedrijven en instellingen van uiteenlopende schaalgrootte. Geen project is hetzelfde. Daarbij werken we veel samen met andere disciplines en expertisegroepen binnen Deerns, zowel in Nederland als daarbuiten. Juist van integrale en technisch complexe vraagstukken worden wij enthousiast. Als Senior Electrical Engineer speel je hierin een belangrijke inhoudelijke rol. Met jouw ervaring help je niet alleen projecten verder, maar draag je ook bij aan de ontwikkeling van collega’s en het team Dit ben jij Je bent een ervaren engineer die technische diepgang combineert met een praktische en oplossingsgerichte instelling. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt tegelijkertijd actief de samenwerking met collega’s en andere disciplines. Je bent in staat om complexe technische vraagstukken te doorgronden, keuzes goed te onderbouwen en deze helder over te brengen aan opdrachtgevers en projectteams. Daarnaast: Heb je een afgeronde technische opleiding, bijvoorbeeld HIT-E, Elektrotechniek, Electrical Engineering, Energy Technology of een vergelijkbare richting, op minimaal hbo werk- en denkniveau. Beschik je over meerdere jaren relevante werkervaring als Electrical Engineer, Engineer Elektrotechniek of in een vergelijkbare functie binnen de gebouwgebonden installatietechniek. Heb je brede kennis van elektrotechnische installaties en kun je complexe ontwerpen zelfstandig opzetten en uitwerken. Kun je technische vraagstukken vanuit een integraal perspectief bekijken en begrijp je de afhankelijkheden tussen verschillende disciplines. Ben je gewend om met opdrachtgevers, ontwerpteams en externe partijen te overleggen en kun je jouw technische keuzes overtuigend onderbouwen. Neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit, voortgang en het resultaat van jouw werkzaamheden. Vind je het leuk om jouw kennis te delen en minder ervaren collega’s inhoudelijk te begeleiden. Ben je analytisch, kwaliteitsgericht, resultaatgericht en werk je graag samen. Heb je een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Een goede beheersing van het Engels is eveneens belangrijk. Dit bieden wij Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.192 en € 5.891 (op basis van 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van jouw ervaring, kennis en expertise. Een functie van 32-40 uur per week met een bijpassend salaris. Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal. Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagelijks in de praktijk worden gebracht. Aandacht voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling en vitaliteit met ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, fiets- en sportregelingen, flexibele werkuren, 33 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen. Hybride werken, waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om afwisselend thuis en op kantoor in Den Haag te werken. Een team waar samenwerking en collegialiteit voorop staan en waar we informeel met elkaar omgaan. Duurzaamheid zit in onze genen. Dit uit zich bijvoorbeeld in een mobiliteitsbeleid waar gezondheid en duurzaamheid voorop staan. Veel van onze kantoren liggen bij OV-knooppunten, fietsen wordt aangemoedigd en je reiskosten worden 100% vergoed op basis van OV. Over Deerns Deerns is als onafhankelijk ingenieursbureau gespecialiseerd in advies, ontwerp en uitvoeringsbegeleiding op het vlak van installatietechniek, bouwfysica, energievoorziening en duurzaamheid. Onze expertises dragen bij aan duurzame, intelligente en toekomstbestendige gebouwen die de processen van onze opdrachtgevers optimaal ondersteunen. We zijn verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp van de installaties en het realiseren van een goed comfort en een prettig klimaat in de meest uiteenlopende gebouwen; van kantoren, tot luchthavens en van ziekenhuizen tot datacenters. Daarnaast is Deerns benoemd als Great Place to Work! Kennis maken? Wil je meer weten over werken bij Deerns? Neem dan contact op met Maarten Borgmeijer (Corporate Recruiter) via +31 6 11 66 75 44. Wil je meer weten over de inhoud van de functie? Neem dan contact op met Rik Maaijen (Unit Director) van Real Estate via +31 6 10 47 21 16. Ben je enthousiast geworden? title: Technical Support Engineer, Zero Trust
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Lisbon, Portugal </p> <h4><strong>About the Department</strong></h4> <p>The Cloudflare Customer Support Team solves complicated problems and answers technical questions via phone, email, chat and social media. Whether it is a Wordpress blogger using our services for free or a global Enterprise business with petabytes of web traffic, we are always eager to assist. We are the eyes and ears of Cloudflare, acting as the real-time voice of the customer to help communicate their needs and real-world use cases back to the rest of the company - for better service and future product development.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Do you love solving complex technical issues and interacting with people? Are you passionate about providing premium-level support to customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking an experienced <strong>Technical Support Engineer for Zero Trust </strong>to join our team. You will work with our largest and most technically sophisticated customers on a variety of technical support issues to ensure they can deploy and operate Cloudflare's Zero Trust solutions with confidence.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted technical advisor, providing advanced support for enterprise customers using Cloudflare’s Zero Trust platform, including products like Access, Gateway, Cloudflare Tunnels, Cloudflare WAN and the Cloudflare One client (formerly known as Cloudflare WARP client).</li> <li>Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to identity, device security, and secure application access.</li> <li>Communicating and working directly with the customers via phone, video conference (ie Zoom, Google Meet), chat and tickets in Salesforce</li> <li>Work directly with customers to diagnose and remediate configuration and integration challenges with authentication protocols (e.g., SSO, SAML, OIDC) and network security settings.</li> <li>Create and maintain knowledge base articles, technical guides, and troubleshooting documentation for internal and customer use.</li> <li>Partner with Cloudflare’s Product, Engineering, and Security teams to escalate and resolve advanced customer issues.</li> <li>Provide feedback based on customer interactions to drive product improvements and ensure alignment with user needs.</li> <li>Assist customers in identifying and responding to security incidents, leveraging Cloudflare’s threat intelligence and security tools.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Availability to work the weekend shift (Saturday & Sunday)</li> <li>You have a minimum of 3 years experience working as a Support Engineer / Sr. Support Engineer supporting networking or web security products.</li> <li>Exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for customers.</li> <li>Strong customer service orientation and communication skills, both written and verbal.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.</li> <li>You have experience supporting and troubleshooting multi-factor mechanisms (TOTP, SMS, FIDO, U2F, WebAuth, EMAIL, Push MFA, etc).</li> <li>Hands-on experience with identity and access management (IdP, IAM, SCIM) systems, such as Okta, Microsoft Entra, Ping, etc. Strong knowledge of authentication protocols (SAML, OIDC)</li> <li>Proficiency in networking fundamentals, including DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and traffic routing.</li> <li>Experience supporting cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SaaS application integrations.</li> <li>You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL or other database servers.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience). This may also include specialized bootcamps. </li> <li>Relevant certifications such as Cloudflare Certified Zero Trust Specialist, CISSP, or CCSP.</li> <li>Experience with building projects on Cloudflare or using Cloudflare Products.</li> </ul> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €37,000 - €51,000.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="2"><strong data-path-to-node="2" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="3"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="3,0,0">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Recruitment Manager
description: Wil jij op operationeel niveau bouwen aan de mensen die het onderwijs van duizenden leerlingen versterken? Een baan met directe impact, veel verantwoordelijkheid en volop ruimte om recruitment en capaciteitsmanagement verder te professionaliseren. Taken Maak het verschil als Recruitment Manager Als Resource Manager zorg je ervoor dat Lyceo nu en in de toekomst beschikt over de juiste begeleiders om scholen en leerlingen tijdig te ondersteunen. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor hun beschikbaarheid, kwaliteit en inzetbaarheid. Je maakt deel uit van het MT en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de directie van Lyceo. title: Staff Engineer - Fintech
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>You will own the agents, skills and standards that let a tribe of product builders move quickly on payments without the architecture fragmenting. Hotels take payments across regions and through providers that each behave differently, and Payment Interfaces exists to give customers one coherent payment experience on top of several PSPs. Embedded payments at this depth is rare among European SaaS companies, so the problems here are ones few engineers get to work on.</p> <p>You will be a Staff Engineer in the Payment Interfaces team, part of the Fintech tribe. You will report to the Director of Product and Engineering, sit in the tribe’s leadership group, and work alongside product builders, other staff engineers and product managers. No one reports to you, so your influence comes from the architecture, tools and standards that other people choose to work in.</p> <p>The team integrates several PSPs depending on region and conditions. When integrations drift apart, builders slow down and quality suffers. This role exists to keep them coherent by encoding what good looks like into tools and agents, so every builder meets the standard by default.</p> <h4><strong>What you would do</strong> </h4> <ul> <li>Own the tribe’s engineering agents, skills and context, and encode architectural standards, review logic and quality gates into them so the standard is met by default.</li> <li>Build an AI first responder for customer tickets about payment issues, with clear rules for when it answers and when it hands over to a person.</li> <li>Stay hands-on for the hardest technical problems: migrations, system-wide refactors and long-lived architecture decisions across PSP integrations.</li> <li>Keep Payment Interfaces integrations coherent as PSPs and regional requirements change, collaborating with builders who own their own work.</li> <li>Coach builders and fix off-standard outcomes at the cause, so the lesson sticks.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Fluency Level 4:</strong> in this role, that means you build the AI systems the tribe works in, not only use them. You design the agents, skills and evaluations that builders rely on every day, make the engineering decisions about how they behave, and set the rules for when an AI answer can stand and when a person must step in.</p> <p><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to “<a href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/external/YWI5ZGUyMGQ3MjU2NGRmNjlkZGEyYTg2NTVmZGE0OTU">AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates</a>” on Confluence.</em></p> <h4><strong>What you would bring</strong> </h4> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience integrating with payment service providers or payment processors.</li> <li>Deep engineering craft and architectural judgment, including a sense of what is worth codifying and what is a one-off.</li> <li>AI Fluency Level 4 or the equivalent hands-on experience: you have built agents, skills, evaluations or tooling that other engineers use, and you can explain where human oversight stays non-negotiable.</li> <li>A systems mindset that turns hard-won knowledge into reusable architecture and tooling rather than documentation.</li> <li>Comfort with influence as your main way of getting things done, working with builders, product managers, principals and senior leaders without anyone reporting to you.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Nice to have</strong> </h4> <ul> <li>Experience in hospitality, travel or another operationally complex B2B SaaS environment.</li> <li>Experience publishing or speaking externally about your work.</li> <li>A track record of coaching other engineers and multiplying their effectiveness.</li> </ul><div
